===== FILE: .backup/dev-snapshot-v25/src/log.ts =====
import * as fs from 'fs';
import * as path from 'path';
import { AgentName, LogEvent, LogRecord } from './types';

export interface LogSink {
  appendLine(text: string): void;
}

export class Logger {
  private seq = 0;
  private stream: fs.WriteStream;
  private sink: LogSink | null;

  constructor(cwd: string, sink: LogSink | null = null) {
    const dir = path.join(cwd, '.pingis');
    fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
    this.stream = fs.createWriteStream(path.join(dir, 'session.log'), { flags: 'a' });
    this.sink = sink;
  }

  event(who: AgentName | 'orchestrator', event: LogEvent, payload: object = {}): void {
    const record: LogRecord = {
      seq: ++this.seq,
      ts: new Date().toISOString(),
      who,
      event,
      ...payload
    };
    this.stream.write(JSON.stringify(record) + '\n');
    this.sink?.appendLine(`[${who}] ${event} ${shortSummary(record)}`);
  }

  raw(text: string): void {
    this.sink?.appendLine(text);
  }

  close(): void {
    this.stream.end();
  }
}

function shortSummary(r: LogRecord): string {
  switch (r.event) {
    case 'task_start':
      return `name="${r.name}"`;
    case 'system_prompt':
      return `${String(r.text ?? '').length} chars`;
    case 'request':
      return `${r.is_first ? 'first' : 'follow'} files=${r.files ?? 0}`;
    case 'response': {
      const calls = (r.tool_calls as any[] | undefined) ?? [];
      return calls.map(c => c?.name).join(',');
    }
    case 'exec':
      return `exit=${r.exit_code} ${r.duration_ms}ms`;
    case 'route': {
      if (r.kind === 'tool_results') {
        return `${r.from} → ${r.to}: tool_results(${r.count})`;
      }
      return `${r.from} → ${r.to}: ${String(r.message ?? '').slice(0, 60)}`;
    }
    case 'retry':
      return `${r.agent} HTTP ${r.http_status} left=${r.retries_left}`;
    case 'error':
      return `${r.stage}/${r.code}: ${String(r.detail ?? '').slice(0, 80)}`;
    case 'stop':
      return `reason=${r.reason}`;
    // Matches LogEvent 'chat_new'. No emitter in src/ currently;
    // kept in step with the union member until step31 decides.
    case 'chat_new':
      return r.restore ? 'restore' : 'new chat';
    case 'api_spawn':
      if (r.reason === 'build_deployment') {
        return `build deployment at ${r.target ?? r.script ?? '?'}`;
      }
      return `start agents at ${r.agents_dir ?? '?'}`;
    case 'api_ready':
      return `agents ready at ${r.agents_dir ?? '?'}${r.reused ? ' (reused)' : ''}`;
    case 'api_exit':
      return `agents stopped (${r.reason ?? '?'})`;
    case 'help': {
      const phase = String(r.phase ?? r.kind ?? '?');
      const extra = r.enriched ? ' (enriched)' : '';
      const initiator = r.initiator ? ` [${r.initiator}]` : '';
      return `${phase} ${r.from} → ${r.to}${extra}${initiator}`;
    }
    case 'artifact': {
      const action = String(r.action ?? '?');
      const kind = String(r.kind ?? '?');
      const filePath = r.path ? path.basename(String(r.path)) : '';
      if (action === 'fallback' || action === 'write' || action === 'delete') {
        return `${action} ${kind}: ${filePath}`;
      }
      return `${action} ${kind}${r.reason ? ': ' + r.reason : ''}`;
    }
    case 'agent_phase':
      return `${r.from} → ${r.to}${r.reason ? ` (${r.reason})` : ''}`;
    case 'context_transition':
      return `${r.who}: ${r.from_percent}% → ${r.to_percent}% ` +
             `(chat switched)`;
    case 'agent_phase':
      return `${r.from} → ${r.to}${r.reason ? ` (${r.reason})` : ''}`;
    case 'context_transition':
      return `${r.who}: ${r.from_percent}% → ${r.to_percent}% ` +
             `(chat switched)`;
    case 'context': {
      const p = r.percent_used;
      const used = r.chars_used;
      const lim = r.chars_limit;
      const warn = r.warning_present ? ' [WARN]' : '';
      return `${r.agent}: ${p}% (${used}/${lim})${warn}`;
    }
    case 'api_spawn':
      return `spawn ${r.agent} on port ${r.port}`;
    case 'api_ready':
      return `${r.agent} ready on ${r.port}${r.reused ? ' (reused)' : ''}`;
    default:
      return '';
  }
}

===== FILE: .backup/dev-snapshot-v25/src/orchestrator.ts =====
import {
  AgentName,
  AgentPhase,
  AgentStatus,
  ChatMessage,
  ContextStatus,
  ExecResult,
  OrchestratorResult,
  StopError,
  StopReason,
  ToolCall
} from './types';
import { ApiClient, AgentSession } from './api';
import { Executor } from './executor';
import { Logger } from './log';
import { writeToolResults } from './format';
import * as fs from 'fs';
import * as path from 'path';

export interface PanelLike {
  setStatus(who: AgentName, status: AgentStatus): void;
  bumpTurn(who: AgentName): void;
  setElapsed(elapsedMs: number, totalMs: number): void;
  done(reason: StopReason, summary?: string): void;
}

export class NullPanel implements PanelLike {
  setStatus(): void {}
  bumpTurn(): void {}
  setElapsed(): void {}
  done(): void {}
}

interface QueuedItem {
  msg: ChatMessage;
  files?: string[];
}

export interface OrchestratorOptions {
  cwd: string;
  name: string;
  task: string;
  /**
   * Absolute wall-clock deadline for the whole task, in milliseconds
   * since the epoch. Not a per-attempt duration: retries share the
   * same deadline, so a retry cannot extend the total budget.
   *
   * The orchestrator treats this as the soft deadline (graceful
   * shutdown) and adds GRACE_MS on top for the hard stop.
   */
  deadlineAt: number;
  executorPrompt: string;
  criticPrompt: string;
  /**
   * Extra time granted after the soft deadline before the hard stop.
   * Defaults to GRACE_MS. Exposed so probes can shrink the window
   * without waiting two real minutes.
   */
  graceMs?: number;
  initialFiles?: string[];
  /**
   * Absolute paths to the per-agent state dirs under
   * ~/.pingis/deepseek-agents/agents/agent-N/. When provided, the
   * orchestrator writes and checks a `.last-project` marker so that a
   * chat belonging to one project is not silently reused by another.
   *
   * Optional: probe scripts leave it unset and keep the previous
   * behaviour (plan.md alone decides).
   */
  agentDirs?: { executor: string; critic: string };

  /**
   * Snapshot of the API feature flags (ENABLE_RAG / ENABLE_SNAPSHOT /
   * ENABLE_RESTORE) read from each agent's agent.env. Recorded in the
   * task_start log event so a task's configuration is visible when
   * reading the log later. Purely observational — no orchestrator
   * decision reads these.
   *
   * Optional: probe scripts leave it unset.
   */
  apiConfig?: {
    executor: { enableRag: boolean; enableSnapshot: boolean;
                enableRestore: boolean };
    critic:   { enableRag: boolean; enableSnapshot: boolean;
                enableRestore: boolean };
  };
}

/**
 * Maximum number of "please call finalize" reminders the orchestrator
 * sends to the Critic after the Executor has died (409
 * context_exhausted).
 *
 * This is the only bounded counter in the orchestrator, and it is not
 * a contradiction of the HELP protocol's "no iteration counters"
 * principle. The difference is what the counter guards:
 *
 *   - HELP loop: agents search for a solution. That is a creative
 *     process, unbounded by design — the only budget is time. A
 *     numeric cap there would abort work that is still moving forward.
 *
 *   - This counter: the Executor is already dead and the task cannot
 *     continue. The Critic is being asked to execute one mechanical
 *     step — call the finalize tool. Three reminders are enough to
 *     distinguish "still thinking" from "ignoring the instruction";
 *     after that, stopping with an honest error is better than
 *     looping until the timeout.
 */
const MAX_FINALIZE_REMINDERS = 3;

/**
 * Maximum number of full format-HELP rounds (L1a → L1b → L3) per agent
 * before the task stops with 'protocol_violation'.
 *
 * Rationale: without a bound, the format-HELP loop can run until the
 * task deadline without ever producing a valid tool_calls. Five rounds
 * give the agent up to 15 nudges (3 per round), which is enough to
 * distinguish "stuck on a specific format problem" from "cannot
 * produce valid output". After that, the honest outcome is a terminal
 * failure — no more auto-help.
 *
 * Malformed-tool-call HELP uses a separate counter (malformedRetryE)
 * and is not merged into this limit.
 */
const MAX_FORMAT_ROUNDS = 5;

/**
 * Minimum drop in percent_used between two consecutive responses from
 * the same agent for the change to be reported as a chat transition.
 *
 * The API switches to a new chat around 90%; percent_used drops from
 * high-80s to a low single digit. A 50-point threshold distinguishes
 * that jump from ordinary fluctuations.
 */
const TRANSITION_DROP_POINTS = 50;

/**
 * Extra time granted after the soft deadline so a graceful shutdown
 * (Critic finalizing, plan.md / summary.md written) can complete.
 * Added once, to the absolute deadline, not once per attempt.
 */
const GRACE_MS = 120_000;

export class Orchestrator {
  private queueE: QueuedItem[] = [];
  private queueC: QueuedItem[] = [];

  private stopped = false;
  private stopReason: StopReason | null = null;
  private stopSummary?: string;

  private turnE = 0;
  private turnC = 0;

  // How many times in a row the agent returned a response without tool_calls.
  // Reset on the first successful step.
  private protocolRetryE = 0;
  private protocolRetryC = 0;

  // Full format-HELP rounds per agent. One round = L1a → L1b → L3.
  // Incremented when L3 fires; checked before starting a new L1a.
  // Reset on the first successful step.
  private formatRoundsE = 0;
  private formatRoundsC = 0;

  // Last context_status from each agent (percent_used, etc.).
  private lastStatusE: ContextStatus | null = null;
  private lastStatusC: ContextStatus | null = null;

  // Previous percent_used seen from each agent. Used only to detect
  // a chat transition (sharp drop) for logging. Never read for
  // control flow.
  private prevPercentE = -1;
  private prevPercentC = -1;

  // Dead sessions: the agent hit 409 context_exhausted.
  private deadE = false;
  private deadC = false;

  // How many times the orchestrator has asked the Critic to finalize
  // while the Executor was dead (409 context_exhausted). Bounded by
  // MAX_FINALIZE_REMINDERS — see its comment for why this is the one
  // place where a numeric counter is correct in this file.
  private criticFinalizeReminders = 0;

  // When true, a stop('done') is treated as a graceful shutdown:
  // plan.md is preserved so the task can be resumed later. Set when
  // the orchestrator hands off to the Critic via CONTEXT_LIMIT: or
  // TIME_LIMIT:.
  private pendingGracefulShutdown = false;

  // Last broken (unparsed) response per agent. Cleared after a
  // successful tool_calls. Used for:
  //   - L1b: preview of the agent's own broken output during retry
  //   - L2:  enriching an agent-sent HELP with technical context
  private brokenBuffer: Map<AgentName, string> = new Map();

  // HELP / HELP_RESPONSE exchanges between Executor and Critic.
  // Observability only; no hard limit. The task timeout is the
  // ultimate bound.
  private helpCycles = 0;

  // How many times in a row the agent sent a malformed tool call
  // (missing required argument, invalid addressee, self-message).
  // Reset on the first well-formed step.
  private malformedRetryE = 0;
  private malformedRetryC = 0;

  // Coarse per-agent state. Observability only at this step — no
  // decision in the orchestrator reads these fields yet. See AgentPhase
  // in types.ts for the phase semantics.
  private phaseE: AgentPhase = 'idle';
  private phaseC: AgentPhase = 'idle';

  // The request content the agent was working from at the start of
  // its current step. Preserved across a HELP round so that, when
  // HELP_RESPONSE arrives, the orchestrator can restore the original
  // framing of the task instead of layering more meta-discussion on
  // top (step 51b).
  private originalE = '';
  private originalC = '';

  // Sessions are class fields so step() can handle 409 itself.
  private sessionE: AgentSession | null = null;
  private sessionC: AgentSession | null = null;

  // Cleanup functions for temporary tool-result files.
  // Called in the finally block of run().
  private toolResultCleanups: Array<() => void> = [];

  private tick?: NodeJS.Timeout;

  constructor(
    private apiE: ApiClient,
    private apiC: ApiClient,
    private exec: Executor,
    private panel: PanelLike,
    private log: Logger,
    private opts: OrchestratorOptions
  ) {}

  async run(): Promise<OrchestratorResult> {
    this.sessionE = new AgentSession('executor', this.opts.executorPrompt);
    this.sessionC = new AgentSession('critic', this.opts.criticPrompt);
    const sessionE = this.sessionE;
    const sessionC = this.sessionC;

    const start = Date.now();

    this.log.event('orchestrator', 'task_start', {
      name: this.opts.name,
      task: this.opts.task,
      cwd: this.opts.cwd,
      deadline_at: this.opts.deadlineAt,
      attachments: this.opts.initialFiles?.length ?? 0,
      api_config_executor: this.opts.apiConfig?.executor,
      api_config_critic: this.opts.apiConfig?.critic
    });
    this.log.event('executor', 'system_prompt', { text: this.opts.executorPrompt });
    this.log.event('critic', 'system_prompt', { text: this.opts.criticPrompt });

    // Artifact-based continuation decision.
    //   plan.md present AND marker matches -> resume: leave chats as-is.
    //   Otherwise -> new task: reset both chats.
    //
    // The `.last-project` marker in each agent's state dir records
    // which project the current chat belongs to. Without it, a plan.md
    // left over from one project could cause another project's task to
    // reuse the same chat.
    const planPath = path.join(this.opts.cwd, '.pingis', 'plan.md');
    const hasPlan = fs.existsSync(planPath);

    // Default to true when agentDirs are not provided (probe tests,
    // legacy callers) — keeps the previous behaviour.
    let projectMatches = true;
    if (this.opts.agentDirs) {
      projectMatches = false;
      try {
        const markerE = path.join(this.opts.agentDirs.executor, '.last-project');
        const markerC = path.join(this.opts.agentDirs.critic, '.last-project');
        const eVal = fs.readFileSync(markerE, 'utf-8').trim();
        const cVal = fs.readFileSync(markerC, 'utf-8').trim();
        projectMatches = (eVal === this.opts.cwd && cVal === this.opts.cwd);
      } catch { /* markers missing or unreadable */ }
    }

    if (!hasPlan || !projectMatches) {
      try {
        await this.apiE.newChat(sessionE, false);
        await this.apiC.newChat(sessionC, false);
        this.log.event('orchestrator', 'artifact', {
          action: 'reset',
          kind: 'chats',
          reason: !hasPlan ? 'no plan.md' : 'project marker mismatch'
        });

        if (this.opts.agentDirs) {
          try {
            const markerE = path.join(this.opts.agentDirs.executor, '.last-project');
            const markerC = path.join(this.opts.agentDirs.critic, '.last-project');
            fs.mkdirSync(this.opts.agentDirs.executor, { recursive: true });
            fs.mkdirSync(this.opts.agentDirs.critic, { recursive: true });
            fs.writeFileSync(markerE, this.opts.cwd, 'utf-8');
            fs.writeFileSync(markerC, this.opts.cwd, 'utf-8');
          } catch (e) {
            this.log.event('orchestrator', 'error', {
              stage: 'project_marker',
              code: 'write_failed',
              detail: String(e)
            });
          }
        }
      } catch (e) {
        this.log.event('orchestrator', 'error', {
          stage: 'chat_reset',
          code: 'new_chat_failed',
          detail: String(e)
        });
      }
    } else {
      this.log.event('orchestrator', 'artifact', {
        action: 'resume',
        kind: 'chats',
        reason: 'plan.md present and project matches',
        path: planPath
      });
    }

    this.queueE.push({
      msg: { role: 'user', content: 'Start the task.' },
      files: this.opts.initialFiles
    });

    const totalMs = this.opts.deadlineAt - start;
    this.tick = setInterval(() => {
      this.panel.setElapsed(Date.now() - start, totalMs);
    }, 1000);

    try {
      const softDeadline = this.opts.deadlineAt;
      const graceMs = this.opts.graceMs ?? GRACE_MS;
      const hardDeadline = softDeadline + graceMs;
      let softFired = false;

      while (!this.stopped) {
        const now = Date.now();

        if (!softFired && now > softDeadline) {
          softFired = true;
          if (!this.deadC) {
            this.log.event('orchestrator', 'error', {
              stage: 'timeout',
              code: 'soft_deadline',
              detail: 'Asking Critic to finalize.'
            });
            // Drop any pending Executor work. On timeout the Critic
            // finalizes; if the Executor queue stayed non-empty, the
            // hasE branch below would keep taking priority and the
            // TIME_LIMIT message would never reach the Critic.
            this.queueE.length = 0;
            this.pendingGracefulShutdown = true;
            this.queueC.push({
              msg: {
                role: 'user',
                content:
                  'TIME_LIMIT: The overall task time has expired. Read ' +
                  '.pingis/plan.md (if present) and key files. Assess what ' +
                  'is done and what is not. Call finalize with an honest ' +
                  'summary: what is done, what is not, and what the user ' +
                  'should do when restarting the task. Do not keep working.'
              }
            });
          }
        }

        if (now > hardDeadline) {
          this.log.event('orchestrator', 'error', {
            stage: 'timeout',
            code: 'hard_deadline',
            detail: 'Grace period exhausted.'
          });
          this.stop('timeout', 'Task timeout exceeded.');
          break;
        }

        const hasE = this.queueE.length > 0 && !this.deadE;
        const hasC = this.queueC.length > 0 && !this.deadC;

        if (hasE) {
          await this.step('executor', sessionE);
        } else if (hasC) {
          await this.step('critic', sessionC);
        } else if (this.deadE && !this.deadC) {
          // Executor exhausted context, the Critic queue is empty,
          // and Critic did not finish the task.
          this.stop(
            'context_exhausted',
            'Executor exhausted context. Critic failed to finalize.'
          );
          break;
        } else if (this.deadC) {
          this.stop('context_exhausted', 'Critic exhausted context.');
          break;
        } else {
          this.stop('deadlock', 'Both queues are empty.');
          break;
        }
      }
    } catch (e) {
      // 409 context_exhausted is now handled inside step();
      // this branch is never reached.
      if (e instanceof StopError) {
        this.log.event('orchestrator', 'error', {
          stage: 'loop',
          code: e.reason,
          detail: e.detail
        });
        this.stop(e.reason, e.detail);
      } else {
        this.log.event('orchestrator', 'error', {
          stage: 'loop',
          code: 'crash',
          detail: String(e)
        });
        this.stop('crash', String(e));
      }
    } finally {
      // Clean up temporary tool-result files.
      for (const fn of this.toolResultCleanups) {
        try { fn(); } catch { /* ignore */ }
      }
      this.toolResultCleanups = [];

      if (this.tick) clearInterval(this.tick);

      const summaryPath = path.join(this.opts.cwd, '.pingis', 'summary.md');
      const planPath = path.join(this.opts.cwd, '.pingis', 'plan.md');

      // Fallback summary when the Critic did not write one.
      // Covers clean done, deadlock (empty queues), and gave_up
      // (IMPOSSIBLE from an agent). All three end the task without
      // the Critic having written a summary; the user still needs a
      // persistent record of what happened.
      if ((this.stopReason === 'done' ||
           this.stopReason === 'deadlock' ||
           this.stopReason === 'gave_up' ||
           this.stopReason === 'timeout')
          && !fs.existsSync(summaryPath)) {
        this.writeFallbackSummary(summaryPath, planPath);
      }

      // Artifact lifecycle: delete plan.md on clean done.
      // On graceful shutdown (CONTEXT_LIMIT / TIME_LIMIT / deadlock) the
      // plan must survive so the task can be resumed later.
      if (this.stopReason === 'done' && !this.pendingGracefulShutdown) {
        if (fs.existsSync(planPath)) {
          try {
            fs.unlinkSync(planPath);
            this.log.event('orchestrator', 'artifact', {
              action: 'delete',
              kind: 'plan',
              path: planPath
            });
          } catch (e) {
            this.log.event('orchestrator', 'error', {
              stage: 'plan_delete',
              code: 'unlink_failed',
              detail: String(e)
            });
          }
        }
      } else if (fs.existsSync(planPath)) {
        this.log.event('orchestrator', 'artifact', {
          action: 'keep',
          kind: 'plan',
          reason: this.pendingGracefulShutdown
            ? 'graceful shutdown'
            : (this.stopReason ?? 'unknown'),
          path: planPath
        });
      }

      // Panel is the caller now; it decides whether to retry or to
      // show the final state. See OrchestratorResult.
      this.log.event('orchestrator', 'stop', {
        reason: this.stopReason ?? 'crash',
        summary: this.stopSummary,
        turns: { executor: this.turnE, critic: this.turnC },
        help_cycles: this.helpCycles,
        duration_ms: Date.now() - start
      });
    }

    return {
      reason: this.stopReason ?? 'crash',
      summary: this.stopSummary
    };
  }

  stop(reason: StopReason, summary?: string): void {
    if (this.stopped) return;
    this.stopped = true;
    this.stopReason = reason;
    this.stopSummary = summary;
  }

  /**
   * Set an agent's phase and log the transition. No-op when the
   * phase does not change, so idle → idle does not spam the log.
   */
  private setPhase(
    who: AgentName,
    phase: AgentPhase,
    reason?: string
  ): void {
    const current = who === 'executor' ? this.phaseE : this.phaseC;
    if (current === phase) return;
    if (who === 'executor') this.phaseE = phase;
    else this.phaseC = phase;
    this.log.event(who, 'agent_phase', {
      from: current,
      to: phase,
      reason
    });
  }

  private writeFallbackSummary(summaryPath: string, planPath: string): void {
    try {
      let planContent = '';
      if (fs.existsSync(planPath)) {
        planContent = fs.readFileSync(planPath, 'utf-8');
      }
      const lines = [
        '# Task summary (fallback, generated by orchestrator)',
        '',
        '## Task',
        this.opts.task,
        '',
        '## Stop reason',
        this.stopReason ?? 'unknown',
        '',
        '## Stop summary',
        this.stopSummary ?? '',
        '',
        '## Timestamp',
        new Date().toISOString()
      ];
      if (planContent) {
        lines.push('', '## Plan (verbatim)', '', planContent);
      }
      fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(summaryPath), { recursive: true });
      fs.writeFileSync(summaryPath, lines.join('\n'), 'utf-8');
      this.log.event('orchestrator', 'artifact', {
        action: 'fallback',
        kind: 'summary',
        path: summaryPath
      });
    } catch (e) {
      this.log.event('orchestrator', 'error', {
        stage: 'summary_fallback',
        code: 'write_failed',
        detail: String(e)
      });
    }
  }

  private async step(who: AgentName, session: AgentSession): Promise<void> {
    const queue = who === 'executor' ? this.queueE : this.queueC;
    const item = queue.shift()!;

    // Snapshot the framing the agent is about to work from. Used
    // after a HELP round to restore the original request (step 51b).
    if (who === 'executor') this.originalE = item.msg.content;
    else this.originalC = item.msg.content;

    this.setPhase(who, 'working', 'request');
    this.panel.setStatus(who, 'thinking');

    this.log.event(who, 'request', {
      is_first: session.isFirstCall,
      files: item.files?.length ?? 0
    });

    const api = who === 'executor' ? this.apiE : this.apiC;

    let resp;
    try {
      resp = await api.chat(session, item.msg, { files: item.files });
    } catch (e) {
      if (e instanceof StopError && e.reason === 'context_exhausted') {
        await this.handleAgentContextExhausted(who);
        return;
      }
      throw e;
    }

    this.panel.bumpTurn(who);
    if (who === 'executor') this.turnE++; else this.turnC++;

    this.log.event(who, 'response', {
      text_len: resp.text.length,
      tool_calls: resp.tool_calls.map(tc => ({
        id: tc.id,
        name: tc.name,
        args_keys: Object.keys((tc as any).args ?? {})
      }))
    });

    // Context tracking: use context_status from the API.
    if (resp.context_status) {
      const cs = resp.context_status;
      if (who === 'executor') this.lastStatusE = cs;
      else this.lastStatusC = cs;

      // Chat-transition detector: a sharp drop in percent_used means
      // the API switched to a new chat (snapshot + RAG). Log it as a
      // distinct event so the reader does not have to spot the jump.
      // Observability only.
      const prevPercent = who === 'executor'
        ? this.prevPercentE
        : this.prevPercentC;
      if (prevPercent >= 0
          && prevPercent - cs.percent_used >= TRANSITION_DROP_POINTS) {
        this.log.event(who, 'context_transition', {
          from_percent: prevPercent,
          to_percent: cs.percent_used,
          from_chars: (who === 'executor'
            ? this.lastStatusE
            : this.lastStatusC)?.chars_used ?? 0,
          to_chars: cs.chars_used
        });
      }
      if (who === 'executor') this.prevPercentE = cs.percent_used;
      else this.prevPercentC = cs.percent_used;

      this.log.event(who, 'context', {
        agent: who,
        percent_used: cs.percent_used,
        chars_used: cs.chars_used,
        chars_limit: cs.chars_limit,
        language_coefficient: cs.language_coefficient,
        warning_present: cs.warning !== null || cs.recommendation !== null,
        warning: cs.warning,
        recommendation: cs.recommendation,
        deepseek_length_detected: cs.deepseek_length_limit?.detected ?? false
      });
    }

    if (resp.usage) {
      this.log.event(who, 'response', {
        usage: resp.usage
      });
    }

    if (resp.tool_calls.length === 0) {
      // Salvage A: DeepSeek Web sometimes returns tool_calls as text.
      const salvaged = trySalvageTextualToolCalls(resp.text);
      if (salvaged && salvaged.length > 0) {
        this.log.event(who, 'response', {
          salvaged: true,
          kind: 'full_tool_calls',
          count: salvaged.length,
          names: salvaged.map(tc => tc.name)
        });
        resp.tool_calls = salvaged;
        this.brokenBuffer.delete(who);
        if (who === 'executor') this.protocolRetryE = 0;
        else this.protocolRetryC = 0;
      } else {
        // Salvage B: extract just the "message" field via regex.
        const extracted = tryExtractMessageFromBrokenJson(resp.text);
        if (extracted) {
          const other: AgentName = who === 'executor' ? 'critic' : 'executor';
          this.log.event(who, 'response', {
            salvaged: true,
            kind: 'message_extracted',
            length: extracted.length
          });
          resp.tool_calls = [{
            id: `salvaged_${Date.now()}`,
            name: 'send_message',
            args: { to: other, message: extracted }
          } as ToolCall];
          this.brokenBuffer.delete(who);
          if (who === 'executor') this.protocolRetryE = 0;
          else this.protocolRetryC = 0;
        } else {
          // Full salvage failed. Store the broken text, then escalate:
          // retries 0 → L1a, 1 → L1b, 2 → L3 (orchestrator HELP), 3 → stop.
          this.brokenBuffer.set(who, resp.text.slice(0, 2000));

          const retries = who === 'executor'
            ? this.protocolRetryE
            : this.protocolRetryC;

          if (retries === 0) {
            // Guard: stop before opening a new round if the budget
            // is exhausted. This is checked at the top of a round, so
            // up to MAX_FORMAT_ROUNDS rounds complete in full.
            const rounds = who === 'executor'
              ? this.formatRoundsE
              : this.formatRoundsC;
            if (rounds >= MAX_FORMAT_ROUNDS) {
              this.log.event(who, 'error', {
                stage: 'protocol',
                code: 'format_budget_exhausted',
                rounds
              });
              this.stop(
                'protocol_violation',
                `format budget exhausted (${rounds} full rounds)`
              );
              return;
            }

            // L1a: general hint.
            if (who === 'executor') this.protocolRetryE++;
            else this.protocolRetryC++;

            this.log.event(who, 'error', {
              stage: 'protocol',
              code: 'no_tool_calls',
              retry: 1,
              hint: 'general'
            });
            this.setPhase(who, 'format_retry', 'L1a');

            item.msg.content = item.msg.content +
              '\n\nYour previous response was not recognized as tool_calls. ' +
              'The raw text is in your conversation history — read it.\n\n' +
              'Most likely cause: a missing closing bracket at the end ' +
              'of the JSON, or a message too long to be generated ' +
              'completely.\n\n' +
              'Retry with a SHORTER reply. Ensure every opening bracket ' +
              'has a matching closing bracket.';
            queue.unshift(item);
            this.panel.setStatus(who, 'idle');
            return;
          }

          if (retries === 1) {
            // L1b: preview of the broken output.
            if (who === 'executor') this.protocolRetryE++;
            else this.protocolRetryC++;

            const broken = this.brokenBuffer.get(who) || '';
            const head = broken.slice(0, 800);
            const tail = broken.length > 1200 ? broken.slice(-400) : '';

            this.log.event(who, 'error', {
              stage: 'protocol',
              code: 'no_tool_calls',
              retry: 2,
              hint: 'preview'
            });
            this.setPhase(who, 'format_retry', 'L1b');

            const preview =
              'Your previous response is still not recognized as tool_calls.\n\n' +
              'What we received (first 800 characters):\n\n' +
              head +
              (tail ? '\n\n...\n\nLast 400 characters:\n\n' + tail : '') +
              '\n\nThe truncation or syntax error is likely at the boundary. ' +
              'Retry with a SHORTER reply.';

            item.msg.content = item.msg.content + '\n\n' + preview;
            queue.unshift(item);
            this.panel.setStatus(who, 'idle');
            return;
          }

          // L3 and beyond: orchestrator initiates HELP on the broken
          // agent's behalf. There is no L4 stop — the loop closes only
          // on IMPOSSIBLE from either agent, or on task timeout. The
          // protocol counter resets so the next failure starts at L1a.
          const broken = this.brokenBuffer.get(who) || '';
          const other: AgentName = who === 'executor' ? 'critic' : 'executor';

          this.log.event(who, 'error', {
            stage: 'protocol',
            code: 'no_tool_calls',
            retry: 3,
            hint: 'orchestrator_help'
          });

          const helpMsg =
            'HELP:\n' +
            'Problem: tool_calls unparseable\n' +
            'Error: my last reply was not valid JSON; likely truncated\n' +
            'Tried: two automatic retries with a hint and a preview\n' +
            'Files: n/a\n' +
            'Question: help me reformat — is my message too long?\n\n' +
            '--- last broken attempt ---\n' +
            broken;

          const target = other === 'critic' ? this.queueC : this.queueE;
          target.length = 0;
          target.push({ msg: { role: 'user', content: helpMsg } });

          this.log.event('orchestrator', 'help', {
            phase: 'HELP',
            from: who,
            to: other,
            initiator: 'orchestrator',
            enriched: true
          });
          this.helpCycles++;

          // One full round completed (L1a + L1b + L3).
          if (who === 'executor') this.formatRoundsE++;
          else this.formatRoundsC++;

          this.setPhase(who, 'awaiting_help', 'L3 synthesized');
          this.setPhase(other, 'helping', 'received synthesized HELP');

          if (who === 'executor') this.protocolRetryE = 0;
          else this.protocolRetryC = 0;

          this.panel.setStatus(who, 'idle');
          return;
        }
      }
    }

    // Pre-check: any malformed tool call aborts the whole batch and
    // re-queues the original item with a hint. Mirrors the L1a path
    // for `no_tool_calls`. Only after two retries does the task stop.
    const malformed = firstMalformedToolCall(who, resp.tool_calls);
    if (malformed) {
      const attempt = who === 'executor'
        ? this.malformedRetryE
        : this.malformedRetryC;

      if (attempt === 0) {
        // First failure: one hint attached to the current request.
        if (who === 'executor') this.malformedRetryE++;
        else this.malformedRetryC++;

        this.log.event(who, 'error', {
          stage: 'protocol',
          code: 'malformed_tool_call',
          retry: 1,
          reason: malformed
        });
        this.setPhase(who, 'format_retry', 'malformed');

        item.msg.content = item.msg.content +
          '\n\nYour previous tool call was malformed: ' + malformed + '. ' +
          'Re-send with the correct arguments — the tool schema is in ' +
          'your system prompt.';
        queue.unshift(item);
        this.panel.setStatus(who, 'idle');
        return;
      }

      // Second failure: hand off to the other agent via HELP. No stop.
      const broken = resp.text.slice(0, 2000);
      const other: AgentName = who === 'executor' ? 'critic' : 'executor';

      this.log.event(who, 'error', {
        stage: 'protocol',
        code: 'malformed_tool_call',
        action: 'orchestrator_help',
        reason: malformed
      });

      const helpMsg =
        'HELP:\n' +
        'Problem: my tool call was malformed\n' +
        'Error: ' + malformed + '\n' +
        'Tried: one correction attempt with a hint\n' +
        'Files: n/a\n' +
        'Question: help me produce a valid call\n\n' +
        '--- last broken attempt ---\n' + broken;

      const target = other === 'critic' ? this.queueC : this.queueE;
      target.length = 0;
      target.push({ msg: { role: 'user', content: helpMsg } });

      this.log.event('orchestrator', 'help', {
        phase: 'HELP',
        from: who,
        to: other,
        initiator: 'orchestrator',
        enriched: true
      });
      this.helpCycles++;

      this.setPhase(who, 'awaiting_help', 'malformed help synthesized');
      this.setPhase(other, 'helping', 'received malformed HELP');

      if (who === 'executor') this.malformedRetryE = 0;
      else this.malformedRetryC = 0;

      this.panel.setStatus(who, 'idle');
      return;
    }

    // Well-formed batch — reset the malformed counter for this agent.
    if (who === 'executor') this.malformedRetryE = 0;
    else this.malformedRetryC = 0;

    const execResults: ExecResult[] = [];

    for (const tc of resp.tool_calls) {
      const cont = await this.handleToolCall(who, tc, execResults);
      if (!cont) {
        this.panel.setStatus(who, 'idle');
        return;
      }
    }

    if (execResults.length > 0) {
      const rf = writeToolResults(execResults);
      this.toolResultCleanups.push(rf.cleanup);
      this.log.event('orchestrator', 'route', {
        from: 'orchestrator',
        to: who,
        kind: 'tool_results',
        count: execResults.length,
        file: rf.path
      });
      const contextPrefix = this.buildContextHint(who);

      queue.push({
        msg: {
          role: 'user',
          content: contextPrefix +
            'Result of the previous tool call is attached.'
        },
        files: [rf.path]
      });
    }

    // Successful step — reset this agent's retry counters.
    if (who === 'executor') {
      this.protocolRetryE = 0;
      this.malformedRetryE = 0;
      this.formatRoundsE = 0;
    } else {
      this.protocolRetryC = 0;
      this.malformedRetryC = 0;
      this.formatRoundsC = 0;
    }

    // If handleToolCall did not move the agent into awaiting_help
    // or helping, it has finished its step and is idle again.
    const currentPhase = who === 'executor' ? this.phaseE : this.phaseC;
    if (currentPhase === 'working') {
      this.setPhase(who, 'idle', 'step done');
    }

    this.panel.setStatus(who, 'idle');
  }

  private async handleAgentContextExhausted(who: AgentName): Promise<void> {
    if (who === 'executor') {
      this.deadE = true;
      this.log.event('orchestrator', 'error', {
        stage: 'context',
        code: 'executor_exhausted',
        detail: 'Executor exhausted context. Asking Critic to finalize.'
      });

      if (this.deadC) {
        this.stop('context_exhausted', 'Both agents exhausted context.');
        return;
      }

      this.pendingGracefulShutdown = true;
      this.queueC.push({
        msg: {
          role: 'user',
          content:
            'CONTEXT_LIMIT: The Executor has exhausted context and can no longer ' +
            'respond. Read .pingis/plan.md (if present) and key ' +
            'files, assess progress. Call finalize with an honest summary: what ' +
            'is done, what is not, and what the user should do on restart.'
        }
      });
    } else {
      this.deadC = true;
      this.stop('context_exhausted', 'Critic exhausted context. Task stopped.');
    }
  }

  private buildContextHint(who: AgentName): string {
    const cs = who === 'executor' ? this.lastStatusE : this.lastStatusC;
    if (!cs) return '';

    const parts: string[] = [];

    // First — the API's built-in signals (most accurate).
    if (cs.warning) {
      parts.push(`[CONTEXT WARNING] ${cs.warning}`);
    }
    if (cs.recommendation) {
      parts.push(`[CONTEXT RECOMMENDATION] ${cs.recommendation}`);
    }

    // Fallback thresholds in case the API is silent.
    if (cs.percent_used >= 92) {
      parts.push(
        `[CONTEXT CRITICAL] Context at ${cs.percent_used}%. ` +
        'Save progress to .pingis/plan.md and send ' +
        'CONTEXT_LIMIT to Critic, then stop.'
      );
    } else if (cs.percent_used >= 85 && !cs.warning) {
      parts.push(
        `[CONTEXT WARNING] Context at ${cs.percent_used}%. ` +
        'Keep responses concise, avoid re-reading files.'
      );
    }

    if (cs.deepseek_length_limit?.detected) {
      parts.push(
        '[CONTEXT WARNING] DeepSeek has truncated a long message. ' +
        'Split future large responses.'
      );
    }

    if (parts.length === 0) return '';
    return parts.join('\n') + '\n\n';
  }

  private async handleToolCall(
    who: AgentName,
    tc: ToolCall,
    execResults: ExecResult[]
  ): Promise<boolean> {
    if (tc.name === 'execute') {
      // Args are pre-validated by firstMalformedToolCall() in step();
      // that check aborts the whole batch before handleToolCall() runs.
      const script = (tc.args as any)?.script;
      const command = (tc.args as any)?.command;
      this.panel.setStatus(who, 'execute');
      const result = await this.exec.run(tc.id, script, command);
      execResults.push(result);
      return true;
    }

    if (tc.name === 'send_message') {
      // Args are pre-validated by firstMalformedToolCall() in step();
      // that check aborts the whole batch before handleToolCall() runs.
      const to = (tc.args as any)?.to;
      let message = (tc.args as any)?.message;

      // Classify the HELP-loop marker. IMPOSSIBLE is terminal; every
      // other marker is log-only and routed normally.
      const phase =
        message.startsWith('HELP_RESPONSE:') ? 'HELP_RESPONSE' :
        message.startsWith('HELP:')          ? 'HELP' :
        message.startsWith('SOLVED:')        ? 'SOLVED' :
        message.startsWith('IMPOSSIBLE:')    ? 'IMPOSSIBLE' :
        message.startsWith('QUESTION:')      ? 'QUESTION' :
        message.startsWith('ANSWER:')        ? 'ANSWER' :
        null;

      if (phase === 'IMPOSSIBLE') {
        this.log.event('orchestrator', 'help', {
          phase: 'IMPOSSIBLE',
          from: who,
          to
        });
        this.pendingGracefulShutdown = true;
        this.stop('gave_up',
          `IMPOSSIBLE from ${who}: ${message.slice(0, 200)}`);
        return false;
      }

      // Enrich HELP with the sender's last broken output, if any.
      if (phase === 'HELP') {
        const broken = this.brokenBuffer.get(who);
        if (broken) {
          message += '\n\n--- last broken attempt ---\n' + broken;
          this.log.event('orchestrator', 'help', {
            phase: 'HELP',
            from: who,
            to,
            enriched: true
          });
        } else {
          this.log.event('orchestrator', 'help', {
            phase: 'HELP',
            from: who,
            to,
            enriched: false
          });
        }
        this.helpCycles++;
        this.setPhase(who, 'awaiting_help', 'HELP sent');
        this.setPhase(to, 'helping', 'HELP received');
      } else if (phase) {
        this.log.event('orchestrator', 'help', {
          phase,
          from: who,
          to
        });
        this.helpCycles++;
        if (phase === 'HELP_RESPONSE' || phase === 'SOLVED') {
          // The sender has finished helping; return to idle. The
          // recipient stays in whatever phase it was — for
          // HELP_RESPONSE it is awaiting_help, for SOLVED it was
          // helping and will be reset when its next step runs.
          this.setPhase(who, 'idle', phase === 'SOLVED'
            ? 'problem solved'
            : 'HELP answered');
        }
      }

      // Special case: Executor is dead (409) and Critic is trying to reply.
      // Do not forward — ask Critic to finalize the task.
      if (to === 'executor' && this.deadE) {
        this.criticFinalizeReminders++;
        if (this.criticFinalizeReminders > MAX_FINALIZE_REMINDERS) {
          this.stop(
            'deadlock',
            `Critic did not finalize after ${MAX_FINALIZE_REMINDERS} reminders.`
          );
          return false;
        }
        this.queueC.push({
          msg: {
            role: 'user',
            content:
              'Executor is unavailable (context exhausted). ' +
              'Call finalize right now with the current summary.'
          }
        });
        this.log.event('orchestrator', 'route', {
          from: 'orchestrator',
          to: 'critic',
          message: '[executor dead — asking critic to finalize]'
        });
        return true;
      }
      this.panel.setStatus(who, 'send_message');
      const target = to === 'critic' ? this.queueC : this.queueE;

      // For HELP_RESPONSE, restore the recipient's original framing of
      // the task instead of forwarding the suggestion as the next
      // request. Without this, the recipient's "current request" becomes
      // another layer of HELP chatter, and the original task drifts out
      // of focus over several HELP rounds. See step 51 design notes.
      let outMessage = message;
      if (phase === 'HELP_RESPONSE') {
        const otherOriginal = to === 'executor'
          ? this.originalE
          : this.originalC;
        if (otherOriginal) {
          outMessage =
            'Return to your original task.\n\n' +
            'Original request:\n' +
            otherOriginal +
            '\n\nSuggestion from ' + who + ':\n' +
            message +
            '\n\nResume with the original request. If the suggestion ' +
            'does not help, say so in one line and continue on your own.';
        }
      }

      target.push({ msg: { role: 'user', content: outMessage } });
      this.log.event('orchestrator', 'route', {
        from: who,
        to,
        message: outMessage
      });
      return true;
    }

    if (tc.name === 'finalize') {
      if (who !== 'critic') {
        this.stop('unknown_tool', 'finalize from executor');
        return false;
      }
      const comment = (tc.args as any)?.comment ?? '';

      // Verify that the Critic wrote summary.md. The fallback is written
      // by the orchestrator in the `finally` block when no summary exists.
      const summaryPath = path.join(this.opts.cwd, '.pingis', 'summary.md');
      if (fs.existsSync(summaryPath)) {
        this.log.event('orchestrator', 'artifact', {
          action: 'verify',
          kind: 'summary',
          path: summaryPath
        });
      } else {
        this.log.event('orchestrator', 'error', {
          stage: 'summary_missing',
          code: 'critic_did_not_write',
          detail: 'orchestrator will write a fallback in finally'
        });
      }

      this.panel.setStatus(who, 'finalize');
      this.stop('done', String(comment));
      return false;
    }

    this.stop('unknown_tool', `unknown tool: ${(tc as any).name}`);
    return false;
  }
}


/**
 * Return a human-readable reason if any tool call in the batch is
 * malformed, or null if all calls are well-formed. Checked before any
 * call is executed, so a batch with a broken entry does not
 * half-execute.
 *
 * Malformed cases:
 *   - execute       — missing or empty `script`
 *   - send_message  — invalid `to`, empty `message`, or to = self
 *
 * Note: `finalize` is intentionally NOT checked here. That tool is
 * bound to the Critic role, and using it from the Executor is a role
 * violation (`unknown_tool`), not a formatting problem.
 */
function firstMalformedToolCall(
  who: AgentName,
  calls: ToolCall[]
): string | null {
  for (const tc of calls) {
    if (tc.name === 'execute') {
      const script = (tc.args as any)?.script;
      if (typeof script !== 'string' || script.length === 0) {
        return 'execute called without a script';
      }
    }
    if (tc.name === 'send_message') {
      const to = (tc.args as any)?.to;
      const message = (tc.args as any)?.message;
      if (to !== 'executor' && to !== 'critic') {
        return `send_message called with invalid 'to': ${JSON.stringify(to)}`;
      }
      if (typeof message !== 'string' || message.length === 0) {
        return 'send_message called without a message';
      }
      if (to === who) {
        return 'send_message called with to = self';
      }
    }
  }
  return null;
}

/**
 * Last-resort extraction of the "message" field from a broken tool_calls
 * response. Matches with a regex and unescapes. Returns null if the
 * field is absent or the text does not contain "message".
 *
 * Used when both strict JSON.parse and brace balancing fail — e.g. when
 * the model drops the closing bracket of the arguments object and the
 * entire JSON becomes unparseable.
 */
function tryExtractMessageFromBrokenJson(text: string): string | null {
  if (!text || !text.includes('"message"')) return null;
  const m = text.match(/"message"\s*:\s*"((?:[^"\\]|\\.)*)"/s);
  if (!m) return null;
  try {
    return JSON.parse('"' + m[1] + '"');
  } catch {
    return m[1]
      .replace(/\\n/g, '\n')
      .replace(/\\t/g, '\t')
      .replace(/\\"/g, '"')
      .replace(/\\\\/g, '\\');
  }
}

/**
 * DeepSeek Web sometimes returns tool_calls outside the structured field,
 * as text inside content: {"tool_calls": [{"name": "...", "arguments": {...}}]}
 * We recognize this format and reconstruct normal ToolCall objects.
 */
function trySalvageTextualToolCalls(text: string): ToolCall[] | null {
  const trimmed = (text ?? '').trim();
  if (!trimmed.startsWith('{')) return null;

  let parsed: any;
  try {
    parsed = JSON.parse(trimmed);
  } catch {
    return null;
  }

  const list = parsed?.tool_calls;
  if (!Array.isArray(list) || list.length === 0) return null;

  const out: ToolCall[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < list.length; i++) {
    const item = list[i];
    const name = item?.name;
    const args = item?.arguments;
    if (typeof name !== 'string') continue;
    if (!args || typeof args !== 'object') continue;
    if (name !== 'execute' && name !== 'send_message' && name !== 'finalize') continue;
    out.push({
      id: `salvaged_${Date.now()}_${i}`,
      name,
      args
    } as ToolCall);
  }

  return out.length > 0 ? out : null;
}

  | 'helping';       // received HELP:, working on the response

import * as fs from 'fs';
import * as path from 'path';
import { AgentName, LogEvent, LogRecord } from './types';

export interface LogSink {
  appendLine(text: string): void;
}

export class Logger {
  private seq = 0;
  private stream: fs.WriteStream;
  private sink: LogSink | null;

  constructor(cwd: string, sink: LogSink | null = null) {
    const dir = path.join(cwd, '.pingis');
    fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
    this.stream = fs.createWriteStream(path.join(dir, 'session.log'), { flags: 'a' });
    this.sink = sink;
  }

  event(who: AgentName | 'orchestrator', event: LogEvent, payload: object = {}): void {
    const record: LogRecord = {
      seq: ++this.seq,
      ts: new Date().toISOString(),
      who,
      event,
      ...payload
    };
    this.stream.write(JSON.stringify(record) + '\n');
    this.sink?.appendLine(`[${who}] ${event} ${shortSummary(record)}`);
  }

  raw(text: string): void {
    this.sink?.appendLine(text);
  }

  close(): void {
    this.stream.end();
  }
}

function shortSummary(r: LogRecord): string {
  switch (r.event) {
    case 'task_start':
      return `name="${r.name}"`;
    case 'system_prompt':
      return `${String(r.text ?? '').length} chars`;
    case 'request':
      return `${r.is_first ? 'first' : 'follow'} files=${r.files ?? 0}`;
    case 'response': {
      const calls = (r.tool_calls as any[] | undefined) ?? [];
      return calls.map(c => c?.name).join(',');
    }
    case 'exec':
      return `exit=${r.exit_code} ${r.duration_ms}ms`;
    case 'route': {
      if (r.kind === 'tool_results') {
        return `${r.from} → ${r.to}: tool_results(${r.count})`;
      }
      return `${r.from} → ${r.to}: ${String(r.message ?? '').slice(0, 60)}`;
    }
    case 'retry':
      return `${r.agent} HTTP ${r.http_status} left=${r.retries_left}`;
    case 'error':
      return `${r.stage}/${r.code}: ${String(r.detail ?? '').slice(0, 80)}`;
    case 'stop':
      return `reason=${r.reason}`;
    // Emitted by ApiClient.newChat when the orchestrator resets the
    // server-side chat at the start of a fresh task.
    case 'chat_new':
      return r.restore ? 'restore' : 'new chat';
    case 'api_spawn':
      if (r.reason === 'build_deployment') {
        return `build deployment at ${r.target ?? r.script ?? '?'}`;
      }
      return `start agents at ${r.agents_dir ?? '?'}`;
    case 'api_ready':
      return `agents ready at ${r.agents_dir ?? '?'}${r.reused ? ' (reused)' : ''}`;
    case 'api_exit':
      return `agents stopped (${r.reason ?? '?'})`;
    case 'help': {
      const phase = String(r.phase ?? r.kind ?? '?');
      const extra = r.enriched ? ' (enriched)' : '';
      const initiator = r.initiator ? ` [${r.initiator}]` : '';
      return `${phase} ${r.from} → ${r.to}${extra}${initiator}`;
    }
    case 'artifact': {
      const action = String(r.action ?? '?');
      const kind = String(r.kind ?? '?');
      const filePath = r.path ? path.basename(String(r.path)) : '';
      if (action === 'fallback' || action === 'write' || action === 'delete') {
        return `${action} ${kind}: ${filePath}`;
      }
      return `${action} ${kind}${r.reason ? ': ' + r.reason : ''}`;
    }
    case 'agent_phase':
      return `${r.from} → ${r.to}${r.reason ? ` (${r.reason})` : ''}`;
    case 'checkpoint_nudge':
      return `${r.streak} executes without check-in`;
    case 'context_transition':
      return `${r.who}: ${r.from_percent}% → ${r.to_percent}% ` +
             `(chat switched)`;
    case 'agent_phase':
      return `${r.from} → ${r.to}${r.reason ? ` (${r.reason})` : ''}`;
    case 'checkpoint_nudge':
      return `${r.streak} executes without check-in`;
    case 'context_transition':
      return `${r.who}: ${r.from_percent}% → ${r.to_percent}% ` +
             `(chat switched)`;
    case 'context': {
      const p = r.percent_used;
      const used = r.chars_used;
      const lim = r.chars_limit;
      const warn = r.warning_present ? ' [WARN]' : '';
      return `${r.agent}: ${p}% (${used}/${lim})${warn}`;
    }
    case 'api_spawn':
      return `spawn ${r.agent} on port ${r.port}`;
    case 'api_ready':
      return `${r.agent} ready on ${r.port}${r.reused ? ' (reused)' : ''}`;
    default:
      return '';
  }
}

===== FILE: .backup/dev-snapshot-v27/CHANGELOG.md =====
# Changelog

All notable changes to this project are documented here.

## [Unreleased]

### Added

- **Soft checkpoint nudge.** When an agent makes 15 consecutive
  `execute` calls without an intervening `send_message`, the
  orchestrator prepends a short `[CHECKPOINT]` reminder to the next
  request. It is not a stop: the agent decides whether to check in
  with `STAGE N/M DONE` or keep going. The counter resets at the
  nudge. Purpose: keep the PLAN → STAGE protocol from silently
  disappearing during long implementation phases. Observable as
  `event: 'checkpoint_nudge'` in `.pingis/session.log`.

### Fixed

- **Graceful shutdown on timeout.** When the soft deadline fires, the
  orchestrator now drops the Executor's pending queue before queuing
  the `TIME_LIMIT:` message for the Critic. Previously the Executor's
  non-empty queue kept taking priority in the main loop, and the
  Critic never received the message — the task ran all the way to the
  hard deadline instead of finalizing. The user saw a bare `timeout`
  stop with no summary.
- **Fallback summary on `timeout`.** `timeout` is now included in the
  condition that writes `summary.md` when the Critic did not. After a
  graceful shutdown the user finds both `plan.md` (preserved) and
  `summary.md` (fallback) on disk.

### Added

- **API configuration recorded in the task log.** `ENABLE_RAG`,
  `ENABLE_SNAPSHOT` and `ENABLE_RESTORE` are now read from each
  agent's `agent.env` and written into the `task_start` event of
  `.pingis/session.log`. Purely observational — no orchestrator
  decision depends on them.

- **Chat-transition detection in the log.** When `percent_used` drops
  by 50+ points between two consecutive responses from the same agent,
  the orchestrator logs a `context_transition` event with the before
  and after values. This is what a snapshot-and-RAG handoff to a new
  chat looks like from the client's side. Observability only — no
  control flow reads this event.

- **Context markers documented in both prompts.** The `[CONTEXT WARNING]`
  and `[CONTEXT CRITICAL]` prefixes that the orchestrator injects into
  tool results are now explained in both system prompts, together with
  a short proactive note to keep responses lean. Previously the agent
  had to infer the meaning of these markers from their names alone.

- **Format-restart in Panel.** When the format-HELP budget inside a
  single run is exhausted (`protocol_violation`), Panel now restarts
  the agents, resets both chats via `POST /v1/chat/new`, and re-runs
  the same task with `plan.md` still on disk. Up to two such restarts.
  The task time budget is unchanged — restarts share the same deadline.

- **Bounded format-HELP.** The loop that recovers from unparseable
  `tool_calls` (L1a hint → L1b preview → L3 orchestrator-synthesized
  HELP) now stops after 5 full rounds with `protocol_violation`.
  Each round is up to 3 nudges, so the agent has 15 attempts before
  the task is declared failed. This replaces the previous unbounded
  loop, which could consume the whole task budget without producing
  a valid tool_calls.

- `HELP_RESPONSE` messages now carry a "Return to your original task"
  preamble: the orchestrator restores the recipient's original framing
  of the task (captured when it sent `HELP:`) instead of forwarding the
  suggestion as the next request. Over several HELP rounds, this keeps
  the agent focused on the task rather than on the HELP exchange.

### Changed

- `StopReason` split: an agent's `IMPOSSIBLE` now stops the task with
  reason `gave_up`, distinct from `deadlock` (which still means "the
  orchestrator ran out of work — an internal error"). The user-facing
  reason text in the sidebar reflects the difference.

### Added

- **Per-agent phase tracking.** The orchestrator now records what each
  agent is doing (`idle` / `working` / `format_retry` / `awaiting_help` /
  `helping`) and logs every transition as `agent_phase` in
  `.pingis/session.log`. This is observability only — no decision in
  the orchestrator reads these fields yet. It is the foundation for the
  upcoming HELP-budget check (step 54) and for a clearer sidebar state.

The format is based on [Keep a Changelog](https://keepachangelog.com/en/1.1.0/),
and this project adheres to [Semantic Versioning](https://semver.org/spec/v2.0.0.html).

## [0.3.4] - 2026-10-15

### Fixed

- Malformed tool calls now retry up to two times with a hint instead
  of stopping the task immediately. Applies to `execute` without a
  script, `send_message` without a message, and `send_message` with
  an invalid addressee. This mirrors the L1a retry path already in
  place for responses with unparseable `tool_calls`.
- Before this release, the first malformed call stopped the task
  with `stop reason=malformed_tool_call`, even when the agent was
  one short hint away from producing a valid call.

## [0.3.4] - 2026-10-15

### Fixed

- Malformed tool calls (`execute` without a script, `send_message`
  without a message, invalid addressee, self-message) now retry once
  with a hint instead of stopping the task immediately. If the retry
  also fails, the orchestrator hands off to the other agent via HELP.
- The help-loop hints (L1a and L1b) are now attached to the current
  request instead of being queued as separate messages. Previously
  the agent never saw them — the loop kept re-asking the same
  question while a stack of unused hints accumulated in its queue.
  This was the root cause of runs where Executor made 80+ attempts
  and Critic never got a turn.
- The L4 stop (`protocol_violation` after repeated failed attempts)
  is removed. The HELP loop is now closed only by IMPOSSIBLE from
  either agent or by the task timeout — matching the design of the
  HELP protocol.
- When HELP is synthesized, the recipient's queue is replaced rather
  than appended to, so there is never more than one pending message
  per agent.

### Changed

- Executor and Critic prompts: IMPOSSIBLE is now documented as a
  valid outcome after several honest HELP / HELP_RESPONSE rounds
  without a new concrete direction, rather than only for external
  impossibility.

## [0.3.3] - 2026-10-15

### Added

- **Artifact lifecycle for long tasks.**
  - `.pingis/plan.md` is now a continuation marker, not a scratch
    file. While it exists, Pingis treats the task as resumable and
    leaves the API chats alone (no `POST /v1/chat/new`). When it is
    missing, Pingis resets both chats before the first request, so
    no history leaks from the previous task into a new one.
  - `.pingis/summary.md` is the persistent report of the last task.
    The Critic writes it before calling `finalize`; if the Critic
    does not, the orchestrator writes a fallback. The file is
    overwritten on every task.
  - On clean `done` the orchestrator deletes `plan.md`. On graceful
    shutdown (`CONTEXT_LIMIT:`, `TIME_LIMIT:`, `IMPOSSIBLE`, network
    failure) the plan is preserved so the task can be resumed later.

- **Unified HELP protocol** (logic + format).
  - `HELP:` / `HELP_RESPONSE:` / `SOLVED:` / `IMPOSSIBLE:` markers
    are recognised by the orchestrator.
  - `HELP:` from either agent is routed as-is and enriched with the
    sender's last broken `tool_calls` response, if any.
  - Format problems (unparseable `tool_calls`) escalate through
    three steps: L1a (hint), L1b (preview of the broken output),
    L3 (orchestrator-initiated HELP to the other agent). Time is
    the only budget — no numeric iteration counters anywhere.
  - `IMPOSSIBLE:` from either agent terminates the task with stop
    reason `deadlock`. The plan is preserved.

- `scripts/probe-help-protocol.ts` — unit coverage for HELP /
  HELP_RESPONSE / SOLVED / IMPOSSIBLE / broken-JSON salvage /
  L1a → L1b → L3 escalation.

- Fallback `summary.md` on `done` or `deadlock` when the Critic
  did not write one.

### Changed

- Executor prompt: mark stages `[x]` in `plan.md` **immediately**
  after `APPROVE_STAGE`, not at the end of the task. The checkboxes
  are the only reliable resume signal after a crash.
- Executor and Critic prompts: no numeric iteration limits. HELP is
  the signal for "stuck"; IMPOSSIBLE for "cannot be solved".
- `probe:help-protocol` added to `package.json` scripts.

### Fixed

- `src/log.ts`: `case 'help'` reads `r.phase` and shows enrichment /
  initiator flags.
- `scripts/probe-409.ts`: string literal containing an apostrophe
  switched to double quotes.

- **Automatic retry on transient errors.**
  - Retryable reasons: `network_error`, `bad_gateway`, `server_error`.
    Up to 3 retries, backoff 5s / 10s / 20s. The task timeout is
    measured once from the first attempt — a retry cannot extend the
    total budget.
  - On retry, the orchestrator stops and restarts the agents, then
    runs again with a fresh `ApiClient` / `Executor`. Because
    `plan.md` survives, the Executor resumes with `RESUME:` instead
    of starting over.
  - `crash`, `timeout`, `protocol_violation`, `deadlock`,
    `server_busy`, `context_exhausted`, and `user_stopped` do NOT
    retry.
  - `src/retry.ts` extracts the retry loop into a pure helper;
    `scripts/probe-retry.ts` covers attempt exhaustion, time-budget
    exhaustion, and non-retryable reasons.

### Notes

- Three end-to-end runs confirmed the pipeline: `taskdb-v2`
  (multi-stage), `fancy-lib-v2` (IMPOSSIBLE → deadlock, plan
  preserved), `is_valid_time` (single-shot). HELP itself is
  designed for rare stuck states; only IMPOSSIBLE and RESUME were
  exercised end-to-end. All HELP branches are covered by
  `probe-help-protocol.ts`.
- Crash recovery: on `network_error` after an interrupted run,
  a subsequent task with the same description in the same folder
  triggered `RESUME:` — the Executor read `plan.md`, recognized
  progress from disk, and continued from stage 4/6.

## [0.3.2] - 2026-10-11

### Added

- Soft timeout in the orchestrator. On task timeout, the Critic is
  asked to finalize first (`TIME_LIMIT:` message); a hard stop
  follows only after a 120-second grace period. The user gets a
  meaningful summary instead of a silent `timeout` stop.
- Log summaries distinguish between building the multi-agent
  deployment and starting it.

## [0.3.1] - 2026-10-11

### Added

- HELP protocol for joint debugging. When the Executor gets stuck
  (three or more identical failures, or no progress), it sends a
  structured `HELP:` message to the Critic with the problem, the exact
  error, what it has already tried, and the relevant file paths. The
  Critic reads the files, reproduces the error, and replies with a
  concrete fix, a different approach, or `IMPOSSIBLE`. This replaces
  the previous 5-attempt limit; the loop runs until the problem is
  solved or the task times out.
- `TIME_LIMIT:` handler in the Critic: on task timeout, finalizes with
  an honest summary instead of a hard stop.

### Fixed

- Multi-agent deployment is now driven by `make-multi-agent.sh` from
  DeepSeek Automation API. Pingis builds and manages the deployment
  under `~/.pingis/deepseek-agents/` itself; the user no longer touches
  cookies, ports, keys, or scripts.
- Ports moved from 3000/3001 to 3098/3099 to avoid collisions with the
  user's own project and with a manually started DeepSeek API.
- Log summaries for `api_spawn` / `api_ready` / `api_exit` no longer
  print `undefined` after the multi-agent refactor.

### Changed

- Settings surface reduced to `pingis.apiDir` (plus timeouts). All
  port/key/URL settings are gone; values come from the generated
  deployment.

## [0.3.0] - 2026-10-02

### Added

- Two-agent architecture: **Executor** and **Critic**, each with its own
  DeepSeek Automation API server, its own chat session, and its own API key.
- **PLAN → STAGE → DONE** protocol for multi-stage tasks: the Executor
  proposes a plan, the Critic approves it, and each stage is reviewed
  before the next begins.
- `.pingis/plan.md` for persisting task progress across restarts. On a
  restart, the Executor reads the plan and resumes from the first
  unfinished stage.
- Context tracking via `context_status` returned by the API:
  warnings at 85%, critical at 92%, and clean recovery on 409
  (Critic finalizes if the Executor runs out of context).
- Per-agent 409 handling with `CONTEXT_LIMIT:` handoff.
- Unit test for 409 handling (`scripts/probe-409.ts`) — no real API needed.
- Cross-platform process management: Linux, macOS, Windows
  (`taskkill /F /T` on Windows, `kill(-pid, SIGKILL)` on Unix).
- `pingis.saveRawResponses` setting for saving raw API responses
  (debug only).
- Structured JSONL log at `.pingis/session.log` with per-agent `context`
  events, `usage` token counts, and full tool-call traces.
- Attachment form support for task descriptions (up to 256 KB per file,
  multiple files allowed).

### Fixed

- Single-word interpreter commands (`python3`, `node`, `bash`) no longer
  hang waiting for stdin — the path to the patch script is appended
  automatically.
- Stale `.api-key` files are removed before each API spawn, preventing
  401 errors from keys left over from manual API runs.
- Temporary `tool-result-*.json` files are cleaned up when a task stops.
- `503` responses are retried up to three times, in case the API is still
  finishing Chromium initialization.
- Textual `tool_calls` returned by DeepSeek Web (broken JSON, DSML tags)
  are salvaged or retried automatically instead of crashing the task.
- Port occupants (leftover API processes, orphaned Chromium) are killed
  before starting the two API servers.
- API state is fully isolated under `~/.pingis/executor/` and
  `~/.pingis/critic/` — no interference between agents.

### Changed

- Project renamed from `deepseek-agent` to `pingis`.
- Settings prefix changed from `deepseekAgent.*` to `pingis.*`.
- Project-local state moved from `.deepseek-agent/` to `.pingis/`.
- All prompts, UI strings, and code comments are in English.
- Output channel filtered: only meaningful API milestones appear,
  not the internal Chromium chatter.

===== FILE: .backup/dev-snapshot-v29/CHANGELOG.md =====
# Changelog

All notable changes to this project are documented here.

## [Unreleased]

## [0.4.0] - 2026-10-16

### Added

- **Soft checkpoint nudge.** When an agent makes 15 consecutive
  `execute` calls without an intervening `send_message`, the
  orchestrator prepends a short `[CHECKPOINT]` reminder to the next
  request. It is not a stop: the agent decides whether to check in
  with `STAGE N/M DONE` or keep going. The counter resets at the
  nudge. Purpose: keep the PLAN → STAGE protocol from silently
  disappearing during long implementation phases. Observable as
  `event: 'checkpoint_nudge'` in `.pingis/session.log`.

### Fixed

- **Graceful shutdown on timeout.** When the soft deadline fires, the
  orchestrator now drops the Executor's pending queue before queuing
  the `TIME_LIMIT:` message for the Critic. Previously the Executor's
  non-empty queue kept taking priority in the main loop, and the
  Critic never received the message — the task ran all the way to the
  hard deadline instead of finalizing. The user saw a bare `timeout`
  stop with no summary.
- **Fallback summary on `timeout`.** `timeout` is now included in the
  condition that writes `summary.md` when the Critic did not. After a
  graceful shutdown the user finds both `plan.md` (preserved) and
  `summary.md` (fallback) on disk.

### Added

- **API configuration recorded in the task log.** `ENABLE_RAG`,
  `ENABLE_SNAPSHOT` and `ENABLE_RESTORE` are now read from each
  agent's `agent.env` and written into the `task_start` event of
  `.pingis/session.log`. Purely observational — no orchestrator
  decision depends on them.

- **Chat-transition detection in the log.** When `percent_used` drops
  by 50+ points between two consecutive responses from the same agent,
  the orchestrator logs a `context_transition` event with the before
  and after values. This is what a snapshot-and-RAG handoff to a new
  chat looks like from the client's side. Observability only — no
  control flow reads this event.

- **Context markers documented in both prompts.** The `[CONTEXT WARNING]`
  and `[CONTEXT CRITICAL]` prefixes that the orchestrator injects into
  tool results are now explained in both system prompts, together with
  a short proactive note to keep responses lean. Previously the agent
  had to infer the meaning of these markers from their names alone.

- **Format-restart in Panel.** When the format-HELP budget inside a
  single run is exhausted (`protocol_violation`), Panel now restarts
  the agents, resets both chats via `POST /v1/chat/new`, and re-runs
  the same task with `plan.md` still on disk. Up to two such restarts.
  The task time budget is unchanged — restarts share the same deadline.

- **Bounded format-HELP.** The loop that recovers from unparseable
  `tool_calls` (L1a hint → L1b preview → L3 orchestrator-synthesized
  HELP) now stops after 5 full rounds with `protocol_violation`.
  Each round is up to 3 nudges, so the agent has 15 attempts before
  the task is declared failed. This replaces the previous unbounded
  loop, which could consume the whole task budget without producing
  a valid tool_calls.

- `HELP_RESPONSE` messages now carry a "Return to your original task"
  preamble: the orchestrator restores the recipient's original framing
  of the task (captured when it sent `HELP:`) instead of forwarding the
  suggestion as the next request. Over several HELP rounds, this keeps
  the agent focused on the task rather than on the HELP exchange.

### Changed

- `StopReason` split: an agent's `IMPOSSIBLE` now stops the task with
  reason `gave_up`, distinct from `deadlock` (which still means "the
  orchestrator ran out of work — an internal error"). The user-facing
  reason text in the sidebar reflects the difference.

### Added

- **Per-agent phase tracking.** The orchestrator now records what each
  agent is doing (`idle` / `working` / `format_retry` / `awaiting_help` /
  `helping`) and logs every transition as `agent_phase` in
  `.pingis/session.log`. This is observability only — no decision in
  the orchestrator reads these fields yet. It is the foundation for the
  upcoming HELP-budget check (step 54) and for a clearer sidebar state.

The format is based on [Keep a Changelog](https://keepachangelog.com/en/1.1.0/),
and this project adheres to [Semantic Versioning](https://semver.org/spec/v2.0.0.html).

## [0.3.4] - 2026-10-15

### Fixed

- Malformed tool calls now retry up to two times with a hint instead
  of stopping the task immediately. Applies to `execute` without a
  script, `send_message` without a message, and `send_message` with
  an invalid addressee. This mirrors the L1a retry path already in
  place for responses with unparseable `tool_calls`.
- Before this release, the first malformed call stopped the task
  with `stop reason=malformed_tool_call`, even when the agent was
  one short hint away from producing a valid call.

## [0.3.4] - 2026-10-15

### Fixed

- Malformed tool calls (`execute` without a script, `send_message`
  without a message, invalid addressee, self-message) now retry once
  with a hint instead of stopping the task immediately. If the retry
  also fails, the orchestrator hands off to the other agent via HELP.
- The help-loop hints (L1a and L1b) are now attached to the current
  request instead of being queued as separate messages. Previously
  the agent never saw them — the loop kept re-asking the same
  question while a stack of unused hints accumulated in its queue.
  This was the root cause of runs where Executor made 80+ attempts
  and Critic never got a turn.
- The L4 stop (`protocol_violation` after repeated failed attempts)
  is removed. The HELP loop is now closed only by IMPOSSIBLE from
  either agent or by the task timeout — matching the design of the
  HELP protocol.
- When HELP is synthesized, the recipient's queue is replaced rather
  than appended to, so there is never more than one pending message
  per agent.

### Changed

- Executor and Critic prompts: IMPOSSIBLE is now documented as a
  valid outcome after several honest HELP / HELP_RESPONSE rounds
  without a new concrete direction, rather than only for external
  impossibility.

===== FILE: .backup/dev-snapshot-v29/src/log.ts =====
import * as fs from 'fs';
import * as path from 'path';
import { AgentName, LogEvent, LogRecord } from './types';

export interface LogSink {
  appendLine(text: string): void;
}

export class Logger {
  private seq = 0;
  private stream: fs.WriteStream;
  private sink: LogSink | null;

  constructor(cwd: string, sink: LogSink | null = null) {
    const dir = path.join(cwd, '.pingis');
    fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
    this.stream = fs.createWriteStream(path.join(dir, 'session.log'), { flags: 'a' });
    this.sink = sink;
  }

  event(who: AgentName | 'orchestrator', event: LogEvent, payload: object = {}): void {
    const record: LogRecord = {
      seq: ++this.seq,
      ts: new Date().toISOString(),
      who,
      event,
      ...payload
    };
    this.stream.write(JSON.stringify(record) + '\n');
    this.sink?.appendLine(`[${who}] ${event} ${shortSummary(record)}`);
  }

  raw(text: string): void {
    this.sink?.appendLine(text);
  }

  close(): void {
    this.stream.end();
  }
}

function shortSummary(r: LogRecord): string {
  switch (r.event) {
    case 'task_start':
      return `name="${r.name}"`;
    case 'system_prompt':
      return `${String(r.text ?? '').length} chars`;
    case 'request':
      return `${r.is_first ? 'first' : 'follow'} files=${r.files ?? 0}`;
    case 'response': {
      const calls = (r.tool_calls as any[] | undefined) ?? [];
      return calls.map(c => c?.name).join(',');
    }
    case 'exec':
      return `exit=${r.exit_code} ${r.duration_ms}ms`;
    case 'route': {
      if (r.kind === 'tool_results') {
        return `${r.from} → ${r.to}: tool_results(${r.count})`;
      }
      return `${r.from} → ${r.to}: ${String(r.message ?? '').slice(0, 60)}`;
    }
    case 'retry':
      return `${r.agent} HTTP ${r.http_status} left=${r.retries_left}`;
    case 'error':
      return `${r.stage}/${r.code}: ${String(r.detail ?? '').slice(0, 80)}`;
    case 'stop':
      return `reason=${r.reason}`;
    // Emitted by ApiClient.newChat when the orchestrator resets the
    // server-side chat at the start of a fresh task.
    case 'chat_new':
      return r.restore ? 'restore' : 'new chat';
    case 'api_spawn':
      if (r.reason === 'build_deployment') {
        return `build deployment at ${r.target ?? r.script ?? '?'}`;
      }
      return `start agents at ${r.agents_dir ?? '?'}`;
    case 'api_ready':
      return `agents ready at ${r.agents_dir ?? '?'}${r.reused ? ' (reused)' : ''}`;
    case 'api_exit':
      return `agents stopped (${r.reason ?? '?'})`;
    case 'help': {
      const phase = String(r.phase ?? r.kind ?? '?');
      const extra = r.enriched ? ' (enriched)' : '';
      const initiator = r.initiator ? ` [${r.initiator}]` : '';
      return `${phase} ${r.from} → ${r.to}${extra}${initiator}`;
    }
    case 'artifact': {
      const action = String(r.action ?? '?');
      const kind = String(r.kind ?? '?');
      const filePath = r.path ? path.basename(String(r.path)) : '';
      if (action === 'fallback' || action === 'write' || action === 'delete') {
        return `${action} ${kind}: ${filePath}`;
      }
      return `${action} ${kind}${r.reason ? ': ' + r.reason : ''}`;
    }
    case 'agent_phase':
      return `${r.from} → ${r.to}${r.reason ? ` (${r.reason})` : ''}`;
    case 'checkpoint_nudge':
      return `${r.streak} executes without check-in`;
    case 'continuation_nudge':
      return 'plan.md present; injected RESUME hint';
    case 'context_transition':
      return `${r.who}: ${r.from_percent}% → ${r.to_percent}% ` +
             `(chat switched)`;
    case 'context': {
      const p = r.percent_used;
      const used = r.chars_used;
      const lim = r.chars_limit;
      const warn = r.warning_present ? ' [WARN]' : '';
      return `${r.agent}: ${p}% (${used}/${lim})${warn}`;
    }
    default:
      return '';
  }
}
