PROBE_RETURN = r'''/**
 * Unit test for step 51b — HELP_RESPONSE wrap.
 *
 * Mocks ApiClient and Executor. No real API servers needed.
 *
 * Scenario:
 *   - Executor sends HELP: to Critic.
 *   - Critic replies HELP_RESPONSE:.
 *   - The message the orchestrator routes from Critic back to Executor
 *     must contain:
 *       * the "Return to your original task" preamble,
 *       * the Executor's original framing (the request it was working
 *         from when it sent HELP:),
 *       * the raw HELP_RESPONSE text from Critic.
 *
 * Run:
 *   npx ts-node --project scripts/tsconfig.json scripts/probe-return-to-original.ts
 */

import * as fs from 'fs';
import * as os from 'os';
import * as path from 'path';
import { ApiClient } from '../src/api';
import { Executor } from '../src/executor';
import { Logger } from '../src/log';
import { NullPanel, Orchestrator } from '../src/orchestrator';
import { AssistantResponse, ExecResult } from '../src/types';

let failures = 0;

function check(condition: boolean, label: string): void {
  if (condition) {
    console.log(`  ✓ ${label}`);
  } else {
    console.error(`  ✗ ${label}`);
    failures++;
  }
}

function freshTmp(name: string): string {
  const p = path.join(os.tmpdir(),
    `${name}-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8)}`);
  fs.mkdirSync(p, { recursive: true });
  return p;
}

type Step =
  | { kind: 'broken'; text: string }
  | { kind: 'tools'; calls: { name: string; args: any }[] };

class FakeApi {
  constructor(private who: string, private script: Step[]) {}
  private idx = 0;
  async newChat(): Promise<void> { /* no-op */ }
  async chat(): Promise<AssistantResponse> {
    if (this.idx >= this.script.length) {
      throw new Error(`FakeApi(${this.who}): script exhausted`);
    }
    const s = this.script[this.idx++];
    if (s.kind === 'broken') {
      return { text: s.text, tool_calls: [], raw: {} };
    }
    return {
      text: '',
      tool_calls: s.calls.map((c, i) => ({
        id: `call_${this.idx}_${i}`,
        name: c.name as any,
        args: c.args
      })) as any,
      raw: {}
    };
  }
}

class FakeExecutor {
  async run(call_id: string, script: string): Promise<ExecResult> {
    return {
      call_id, command: 'noop', exit_code: 0, duration_ms: 1,
      stdout: 'ok\n', stderr: '',
      stdout_truncated: false, stderr_truncated: false
    };
  }
}

function mkLog(cwd: string): Logger {
  return new Logger(cwd, { appendLine: () => { /* silent */ } });
}

async function runOrch(
  cwd: string,
  apiE: FakeApi,
  apiC: FakeApi
): Promise<void> {
  const log = mkLog(cwd);
  const orch = new Orchestrator(
    apiE as unknown as ApiClient,
    apiC as unknown as ApiClient,
    new FakeExecutor() as unknown as Executor,
    new NullPanel(),
    log,
    {
      cwd, name: 'probe-return-to-original', task: 'stub',
      deadlineAt: Date.now() + 30_000,
      executorPrompt: 'E', criticPrompt: 'C'
    }
  );
  await orch.run();
  log.close();
  await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 200));
}

function readLog(cwd: string): any[] {
  const logPath = path.join(cwd, '.pingis', 'session.log');
  if (!fs.existsSync(logPath)) return [];
  return fs.readFileSync(logPath, 'utf-8')
    .split('\n').filter(Boolean).map(l => JSON.parse(l));
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

async function t1_wrap_help_response(): Promise<void> {
  console.log('\nT1: HELP_RESPONSE wrapped with return-to-original');

  const cwd = freshTmp('probe-return-t1');
  fs.mkdirSync(path.join(cwd, '.pingis'), { recursive: true });
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(cwd, '.pingis', 'plan.md'), '# Plan\n');

  // Executor: execute, then HELP, then ALL DONE.
  // Critic: execute (reads files), HELP_RESPONSE, execute (verifies), finalize.
  const apiE = new FakeApi('executor', [
    { kind: 'tools', calls: [{ name: 'execute',
        args: { script: 'print(1)' } }] },
    { kind: 'tools', calls: [{ name: 'send_message',
        args: { to: 'critic', message: 'HELP:\nProblem: x\nTried: y' } }] },
    { kind: 'tools', calls: [{ name: 'send_message',
        args: { to: 'critic', message: 'ALL DONE: ok' } }] }
  ]);
  const apiC = new FakeApi('critic', [
    { kind: 'tools', calls: [{ name: 'execute',
        args: { script: 'print(1)' } }] },
    { kind: 'tools', calls: [{ name: 'send_message',
        args: { to: 'executor',
                message: 'HELP_RESPONSE: try X instead of Y' } }] },
    { kind: 'tools', calls: [{ name: 'finalize',
        args: { comment: 'done' } }] }
  ]);

  const lines = readLog(cwd);

    e => e.event === 'route'
      && e.from === 'critic'
      && e.to === 'executor'
      && typeof e.message === 'string'
  );

  check(!!routeCriticToExecutor,
    'route critic → executor exists');
  const msg: string = routeCriticToExecutor?.message ?? '';

  check(msg.includes('Return to your original task'),
    'wrapped message contains the preamble');
  check(msg.includes('HELP_RESPONSE: try X instead of Y'),
    'wrapped message still contains the raw HELP_RESPONSE text');
  check(msg.includes('Original request:'),
    'wrapped message labels the original request section');
  check(msg.includes('Suggestion from critic:'),
    'wrapped message labels the suggestion section');
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  await t1_wrap_help_response();

  if (failures === 0) {

}

===== FILE: scripts/dev/apply_step51c_format_rounds.py =====
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Step 51c: bound the format-HELP loop to 5 full rounds.

A "full format round" is one L1a → L1b → L3 cycle. The counter is
incremented when L3 fires (the orchestrator synthesizes HELP on the
broken agent's behalf). Before starting a new L1a, if the counter
has already reached MAX_FORMAT_ROUNDS, the task stops with
`protocol_violation` — no more auto-help.

Rationale: unbounded format-HELP can consume the entire task budget
without progress. Five rounds is 15 total nudges (5×3), which is
enough to distinguish "stuck on format" from "cannot format at all".
After that, the only honest outcome is to declare the failure.

Malformed-tool-call HELP is a separate branch with its own
malformedRetryE counter; it is not merged into this limit.

Run from the pingis/ extension root:
    python scripts/dev/apply_step51c_format_rounds.py
"""

import json
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent.parent
BACKUP = ROOT / ".backup" / "dev-snapshot-v19"


def backup(rel: str) -> None:
    src = ROOT / rel
    if not src.exists():
        return
    dst = BACKUP / rel
    dst.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    shutil.copy2(src, dst)


def patch(rel: str, pairs: list[tuple[str, str]]) -> int:
    p = ROOT / rel
    if not p.exists():
        print(f"  ✗ {rel}: not found")
        return -1
    text = p.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    original = text
    total = 0
    for old, new in pairs:
        if new in text:
            stripped = text.replace(new, "")
            if old not in stripped:
                print(f"  = {rel}: already patched")
                continue
        n = text.count(old)
        if n == 0:
            print(f"  ✗ {rel}: pattern not found; expected:")
            print(f"    {old[:160]!r}")
            return -1
        text = text.replace(old, new)
        total += n
        print(f"  + {rel}: {n} occurrence(s)")
    if text != original:
        backup(rel)
        p.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")
    return total


def write_new(rel: str, content: str) -> None:
    p = ROOT / rel
    p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    if p.exists():
        backup(rel)
    p.write_text(content, encoding="utf-8")
    print(f"  + {rel} (new, {len(content)} bytes)")


def run_cmd(cmd: list[str], label: str) -> bool:
    print()
    print(f"=== {label} ===")
    print("$ " + " ".join(cmd))
    r = subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=ROOT)
    if r.returncode != 0:
        print(f"  ✗ {label} failed (exit {r.returncode})")
        return False
    print(f"  + {label} ok")
    return True


def git_commit(message: str) -> None:
    if not (ROOT / ".git").exists():
        print("  git: no repo, skipping commit")
        return
    try:
        subprocess.run(["git", "add", "-A"], cwd=ROOT,
                       check=True, capture_output=True)
        subprocess.run(["git", "commit", "-m", message], cwd=ROOT,
                       check=True, capture_output=True)
        print(f"  git: committed \"{message}\"")
    except subprocess.CalledProcessError as e:
        print(f"  git: commit failed ({e})")


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# src/orchestrator.ts
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# 1) Constant next to MAX_FINALIZE_REMINDERS.
CONST_ANCHOR = """const MAX_FINALIZE_REMINDERS = 3;"""

CONST_NEW = """const MAX_FINALIZE_REMINDERS = 3;

/**
 * Maximum number of full format-HELP rounds (L1a → L1b → L3) per agent
 * before the task stops with 'protocol_violation'.
 *
 * Rationale: without a bound, the format-HELP loop can run until the
 * task deadline without ever producing a valid tool_calls. Five rounds
 * give the agent up to 15 nudges (3 per round), which is enough to
 * distinguish "stuck on a specific format problem" from "cannot
 * produce valid output". After that, the honest outcome is a terminal
 * failure — no more auto-help.
 *
 * Malformed-tool-call HELP uses a separate counter (malformedRetryE)
 * and is not merged into this limit.
 */
const MAX_FORMAT_ROUNDS = 5;"""


# 2) Fields — near the protocolRetryE fields.
FIELDS_ANCHOR = """  // How many times in a row the agent returned a response without tool_calls.
  // Reset on the first successful step.
  private protocolRetryE = 0;
  private protocolRetryC = 0;"""

FIELDS_NEW = """  // How many times in a row the agent returned a response without tool_calls.
  // Reset on the first successful step.
  private protocolRetryE = 0;
  private protocolRetryC = 0;

  // Full format-HELP rounds per agent. One round = L1a → L1b → L3.
  // Incremented when L3 fires; checked before starting a new L1a.
  // Reset on the first successful step.
  private formatRoundsE = 0;
  private formatRoundsC = 0;"""


# 3) Guard before L1a.
L1A_GUARD_OLD = """          if (retries === 0) {
            // L1a: general hint.
            if (who === 'executor') this.protocolRetryE++;
            else this.protocolRetryC++;"""

L1A_GUARD_NEW = """          if (retries === 0) {
            // Guard: stop before opening a new round if the budget
            // is exhausted. This is checked at the top of a round, so
            // up to MAX_FORMAT_ROUNDS rounds complete in full.
            const rounds = who === 'executor'
              ? this.formatRoundsE
              : this.formatRoundsC;
            if (rounds >= MAX_FORMAT_ROUNDS) {
              this.log.event(who, 'error', {
                stage: 'protocol',
                code: 'format_budget_exhausted',
                rounds
              });
              this.stop(
                'protocol_violation',
                `format budget exhausted (${rounds} full rounds)`
              );
              return;
            }

            // L1a: general hint.
            if (who === 'executor') this.protocolRetryE++;
            else this.protocolRetryC++;"""


# 4) Increment on L3.
L3_INC_OLD = """          this.log.event('orchestrator', 'help', {
            phase: 'HELP',
            from: who,
            to: other,
            initiator: 'orchestrator',
            enriched: true
          });
          this.helpCycles++;

          this.setPhase(who, 'awaiting_help', 'L3 synthesized');
          this.setPhase(other, 'helping', 'received synthesized HELP');

          if (who === 'executor') this.protocolRetryE = 0;
          else this.protocolRetryC = 0;"""

L3_INC_NEW = """          this.log.event('orchestrator', 'help', {
            phase: 'HELP',
            from: who,
            to: other,
            initiator: 'orchestrator',
            enriched: true
          });
          this.helpCycles++;

          // One full round completed (L1a + L1b + L3).
          if (who === 'executor') this.formatRoundsE++;
          else this.formatRoundsC++;

          this.setPhase(who, 'awaiting_help', 'L3 synthesized');
          this.setPhase(other, 'helping', 'received synthesized HELP');

          if (who === 'executor') this.protocolRetryE = 0;
          else this.protocolRetryC = 0;"""


# 5) Reset on successful step.
STEP_END_RESET_OLD = """    // Successful step — reset this agent's retry counters.
    if (who === 'executor') {
      this.protocolRetryE = 0;
      this.malformedRetryE = 0;
    } else {
      this.protocolRetryC = 0;
      this.malformedRetryC = 0;
    }"""

STEP_END_RESET_NEW = """    // Successful step — reset this agent's retry counters.
    if (who === 'executor') {
      this.protocolRetryE = 0;
      this.malformedRetryE = 0;
      this.formatRoundsE = 0;
    } else {
      this.protocolRetryC = 0;
      this.malformedRetryC = 0;
      this.formatRoundsC = 0;
    }"""


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# CHANGELOG
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

CHANGELOG_ANCHOR = """## [Unreleased]

### Added"""

CHANGELOG_NEW = """## [Unreleased]

### Added

- **Bounded format-HELP.** The loop that recovers from unparseable
  `tool_calls` (L1a hint → L1b preview → L3 orchestrator-synthesized
  HELP) now stops after 5 full rounds with `protocol_violation`.
  Each round is up to 3 nudges, so the agent has 15 attempts before
  the task is declared failed. This replaces the previous unbounded
  loop, which could consume the whole task budget without producing
  a valid tool_calls."""


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# New probe — T6 in probe-help-protocol.ts is not added; a separate
# probe is cleaner because it exercises exactly one scenario (budget
# exhaustion) and its assertion is a single stop reason.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

PROBE_FORMAT_BUDGET = r'''/**
 * Unit test for step 51c — format-HELP budget.
 *
 * Scenario: the Executor returns garbage on every request. After
 * MAX_FORMAT_ROUNDS full rounds (5 × L1a+L1b+L3 = 15 attempts), the
 * next unparseable response stops the task with 'protocol_violation'.
 *
 * Expected sequence per round:
 *   broken → L1a (retry 1)
 *   broken → L1b (retry 2)
 *   broken → L3 (orchestrator HELP, round++)
 *
 * After 5 rounds, the next broken response triggers the budget guard
 * on the way to L1a and stops the task.
 *
 * Run:
 *   npx ts-node --project scripts/tsconfig.json scripts/probe-format-budget.ts
 */

import * as fs from 'fs';
import * as os from 'os';
import * as path from 'path';
import { ApiClient } from '../src/api';
import { Executor } from '../src/executor';
import { Logger } from '../src/log';
import { NullPanel, Orchestrator } from '../src/orchestrator';
import { AssistantResponse, ExecResult } from '../src/types';

let failures = 0;

function check(condition: boolean, label: string): void {
  if (condition) {
    console.log(`  ✓ ${label}`);
  } else {
    console.error(`  ✗ ${label}`);
    failures++;
  }
}

function freshTmp(name: string): string {
  const p = path.join(os.tmpdir(),
    `${name}-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8)}`);
  fs.mkdirSync(p, { recursive: true });
  return p;
}

type Step =
  | { kind: 'broken'; text: string }
  | { kind: 'tools'; calls: { name: string; args: any }[] };

class FakeApi {
  constructor(private who: string, private script: Step[]) {}
  private idx = 0;
  async newChat(): Promise<void> { /* no-op */ }
  async chat(): Promise<AssistantResponse> {
    if (this.idx >= this.script.length) {
      // Return a plain broken response rather than throwing, so that
      // a runaway loop does not crash the probe with an "exhausted"
      // error — it just keeps failing.
      return { text: 'runaway loop', tool_calls: [], raw: {} };
    }
    const s = this.script[this.idx++];
    if (s.kind === 'broken') {
      return { text: s.text, tool_calls: [], raw: {} };
    }
    return {
      text: '',
      tool_calls: s.calls.map((c, i) => ({
        id: `call_${this.idx}_${i}`,
        name: c.name as any,
        args: c.args
      })) as any,
      raw: {}
    };
  }
}

class FakeExecutor {
  async run(call_id: string, script: string): Promise<ExecResult> {
    return {
      call_id, command: 'noop', exit_code: 0, duration_ms: 1,
      stdout: 'ok\n', stderr: '',
      stdout_truncated: false, stderr_truncated: false
    };
  }
}

function mkLog(cwd: string): Logger {
  return new Logger(cwd, { appendLine: () => { /* silent */ } });
}

async function runOrch(
  cwd: string,
  apiE: FakeApi,
  apiC: FakeApi
): Promise<void> {
  const log = mkLog(cwd);
  const orch = new Orchestrator(
    apiE as unknown as ApiClient,
    apiC as unknown as ApiClient,
    new FakeExecutor() as unknown as Executor,
    new NullPanel(),
    log,
    {
      cwd, name: 'probe-format-budget', task: 'stub',
      deadlineAt: Date.now() + 60_000,
      executorPrompt: 'E', criticPrompt: 'C'
    }
  );
  await orch.run();
  log.close();
  await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 200));
}

function readLog(cwd: string): any[] {
  const logPath = path.join(cwd, '.pingis', 'session.log');
  if (!fs.existsSync(logPath)) return [];
  return fs.readFileSync(logPath, 'utf-8')
    .split('\n').filter(Boolean).map(l => JSON.parse(l));
}

async function t1_budget_exhausted(): Promise<void> {
  console.log('\nT1: 5 rounds × 3 broken → protocol_violation');

  const cwd = freshTmp('probe-format-budget-t1');
  fs.mkdirSync(path.join(cwd, '.pingis'), { recursive: true });
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(cwd, '.pingis', 'plan.md'), '# Plan\n');

  // Executor: 5 rounds × 3 broken = 15 broken, then one more to trigger
  // the budget guard. Extra broken responses are harmless.
  const brokenRounds: Step[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < 16; i++) {
    brokenRounds.push({ kind: 'broken', text: `garbage #${i + 1}` });
  }
  const apiE = new FakeApi('executor', brokenRounds);

  // Critic: 5 HELP_RESPONSE replies (one per round). The sixth is never
  // requested, but keep a few extras to avoid a script-exhaustion crash
  // if the loop runs away.
  const criticSteps: Step[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
    criticSteps.push({
      kind: 'tools',
      calls: [{ name: 'send_message',
                args: { to: 'executor',
                        message: `HELP_RESPONSE: try again #${i + 1}` } }]
    });
  }
  const apiC = new FakeApi('critic', criticSteps);

  await runOrch(cwd, apiE, apiC);
  const lines = readLog(cwd);

  const orchHelp = lines.filter(
    e => e.event === 'help' && e.initiator === 'orchestrator'
  );
  const budget = lines.find(
    e => e.event === 'error' && e.code === 'format_budget_exhausted'
  );
  const stop = lines.find(e => e.event === 'stop');

  check(orchHelp.length === 5,
    `orchestrator HELP fired exactly 5 times (got ${orchHelp.length})`);
  check(!!budget, 'format_budget_exhausted event logged');
  check(budget?.rounds === 5,
    `budget event reports 5 rounds (got ${budget?.rounds})`);
  check(stop?.reason === 'protocol_violation',
    `stop reason = ${stop?.reason} (expected protocol_violation)`);
}

async function main(): Promise<void> {
  await t1_budget_exhausted();

  console.log();
  if (failures === 0) {
    console.log('=== SUCCESS: format-HELP budget works ===');
    process.exit(0);
  } else {
    console.log(`=== FAILURE: ${failures} check(s) failed ===`);
    process.exit(1);
  }
}

main().catch(e => {
  console.error('CRASH:', e);
  process.exit(2);
});
'''

===== FILE: scripts/dev/apply_step51d_format_restart.py =====
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Step 51d: restart + newChat when format-HELP budget is exhausted.

When Orchestrator returns 'protocol_violation' (5 format rounds done
without a valid tool_calls), Panel now:
  1. Stops and restarts the agents.
  2. Resets both chats via POST /v1/chat/new { restore: false }.
  3. Re-runs the whole runWithRetry with the same task and deadline.
  4. Repeats up to MAX_FORMAT_RESTARTS times.

Rationale: five rounds in one chat may fail because the accumulated
history has become hostile to valid generation. A fresh chat, with
plan.md still on disk, gives the Executor a clean slate.

Budget: time is unchanged. taskStartedAt and totalTimeoutMs are fixed
outside the loop; runWithRetry enforces the deadline on every attempt.

No probe is added at this step: PanelProvider depends on vscode,
AgentsProcess and ApiClient, and cannot be exercised without mocking
or a dependency-injection refactor. Existing probes stay green
because Orchestrator behavior is unchanged.

Run from the pingis/ extension root:
    python scripts/dev/apply_step51d_format_restart.py
"""

import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent.parent
BACKUP = ROOT / ".backup" / "dev-snapshot-v20"


def backup(rel: str) -> None:
    src = ROOT / rel
    if not src.exists():
        return
    dst = BACKUP / rel
    dst.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    shutil.copy2(src, dst)


def patch(rel: str, pairs: list[tuple[str, str]]) -> int:
    p = ROOT / rel
    if not p.exists():
        print(f"  ✗ {rel}: not found")
        return -1
    text = p.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    original = text
    total = 0
    for old, new in pairs:
        if new in text:
            stripped = text.replace(new, "")
            if old not in stripped:
                print(f"  = {rel}: already patched")
                continue
        n = text.count(old)
        if n == 0:
            print(f"  ✗ {rel}: pattern not found; expected:")
            print(f"    {old[:200]!r}")
            return -1
        text = text.replace(old, new)
        total += n
        print(f"  + {rel}: {n} occurrence(s)")
    if text != original:
        backup(rel)
        p.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")
    return total


def run_cmd(cmd: list[str], label: str) -> bool:
    print()
    print(f"=== {label} ===")
    print("$ " + " ".join(cmd))
    r = subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=ROOT)
    if r.returncode != 0:
        print(f"  ✗ {label} failed (exit {r.returncode})")

    // Outer loop: restart only on 'protocol_violation' (format-HELP
    // budget exhausted inside one run). Time budget is shared across
    // iterations — taskStartedAt and totalTimeoutMs are fixed.
    let result: OrchestratorResult = { reason: 'crash' };
    for (let formatRestarts = 0; ; formatRestarts++) {
    result = await runWithRetry({
      taskStartedAt,
      totalTimeoutMs,
      maxRetries: MAX_RETRIES,

TAIL_NEW = """    });

    // Success, non-format failure, or timeout — no restart needed.
    if (result.reason !== 'protocol_violation') {
      break;
    }

    if (formatRestarts >= MAX_FORMAT_RESTARTS) {
      this.log?.event('orchestrator', 'error', {
        stage: 'restart',
        code: 'format_restarts_exhausted',
        total: formatRestarts
      });
      break;
    }

    this.log?.event('orchestrator', 'retry', {
      __phase: 'format_restart',
      attempt: formatRestarts + 1,
      max: MAX_FORMAT_RESTARTS
    });
    this.post({
      type: 'retrying',
      attempt: formatRestarts + 1,
      max: MAX_FORMAT_RESTARTS
    });

    try {
      this.agents?.stop();
      this.agents = new AgentsProcess(apiDir, this.log!);
      await this.agents.ensureRunning();
      await resetChatInPlace(
        this.agents.executor.port, this.agents.executor.apiKey
      );
      await resetChatInPlace(
        this.agents.critic.port, this.agents.critic.apiKey
      );
    } catch (e: any) {
      this.log?.event('orchestrator', 'error', {
        stage: 'restart',
        code: 'format_restart_failed',
        detail: String(e)
      });
      this.done('server_error', String(e?.message ?? e));
      return;
    }
    }

    this.post({ type: 'retryDone' });
    this.done(result.reason, result.summary);
  }

  private async onPickFile(): Promise<void> {"""

# 5) src/panel.ts — resetChatInPlace helper
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

HELPER_OLD = """function sanitizeName(name: string): string {"""

HELPER_NEW = """async function resetChatInPlace(
  port: number,
  apiKey: string
): Promise<void> {
  // POST /v1/chat/new with restore:false resets the server-side chat.
  // AbortController guarantees we do not hang forever if the agent is
  // half-dead: a stuck fetch here would freeze the entire restart path.
  const controller = new AbortController();
  const timeout = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), 30_000);
  try {
    const r = await fetch(`http://127.0.0.1:${port}/v1/chat/new`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: {
        'Authorization': `Bearer ${apiKey}`,
        'Content-Type': 'application/json'
      },
      body: JSON.stringify({ restore: false }),
      signal: controller.signal
    });
    if (!r.ok) {
      throw new Error(`chat reset failed: HTTP ${r.status}`);
    }
  } finally {
    clearTimeout(timeout);
  }
}

function sanitizeName(name: string): string {"""

The orchestrator already injects "[CONTEXT WARNING]" and

them. Probes read the orchestrator, not prompts, so nothing should
break — but probe-help-protocol does exercise the prompts indirectly
through fake API, and stays green because prompt content does not
affect it.

===== FILE: scripts/dev/apply_step51f_context_transition.py =====
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Step 51f: log context transitions as a distinct event.

When the API switches to a new chat (snapshot + RAG, around 90%), the
next `context_status.percent_used` drops sharply — from ~89% to a low
single-digit value. The orchestrator currently logs this as a normal
`context` event and the reader has to notice the drop themselves.

This step adds a transition detector: when percent_used falls by 50+
points since the last response from the same agent, an additional
`context_transition` event is logged:

    {
      "who": "executor",
      "event": "context_transition",
      "from_percent": 89,
      "to_percent": 3,
      "from_chars": 2140000,
      "to_chars": 72000
    }

Detection is per-agent. The first response of a task never triggers
(no previous value). No control-flow reads this event yet — it is
observability only.

The threshold (50) is a constant TRANSITION_DROP_POINTS.

Run from the pingis/ extension root:
    python scripts/dev/apply_step51f_context_transition.py
"""

import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent.parent
BACKUP = ROOT / ".backup" / "dev-snapshot-v22"


def backup(rel: str) -> None:
    src = ROOT / rel
    if not src.exists():
        return
    dst = BACKUP / rel
    dst.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    shutil.copy2(src, dst)


def patch(rel: str, pairs: list[tuple[str, str]]) -> int:
    p = ROOT / rel
    if not p.exists():
        print(f"  ✗ {rel}: not found")
        return -1
    text = p.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    original = text
    total = 0
    for old, new in pairs:
        if new in text:
            stripped = text.replace(new, "")
            if old not in stripped:
                print(f"  = {rel}: already patched")
                continue
        n = text.count(old)
        if n == 0:
            print(f"  ✗ {rel}: pattern not found; expected:")
            print(f"    {old[:200]!r}")
            return -1
        text = text.replace(old, new)
        total += n
        print(f"  + {rel}: {n} occurrence(s)")
    if text != original:
        backup(rel)
        p.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")
    return total


def run_cmd(cmd: list[str], label: str) -> bool:

/**

 * the same agent for the change to be reported as a chat transition.
 *
 * The API switches to a new chat around 90%; percent_used drops from
 * high-80s to a low single digit. A 50-point threshold distinguishes
 * that jump from ordinary fluctuations.
 */
const TRANSITION_DROP_POINTS = 50;"""


FIELDS_ANCHOR = """  // Last context_status from each agent (percent_used, etc.).
  private lastStatusE: ContextStatus | null = null;
  private lastStatusC: ContextStatus | null = null;"""

FIELDS_NEW = """  // Last context_status from each agent (percent_used, etc.).
  private lastStatusE: ContextStatus | null = null;
  private lastStatusC: ContextStatus | null = null;

  // Previous percent_used seen from each agent. Used only to detect
  // a chat transition (sharp drop) for logging. Never read for
  // control flow.
  private prevPercentE = -1;
  private prevPercentC = -1;"""


DETECTOR_OLD = """    // Context tracking: use context_status from the API.
    if (resp.context_status) {
      const cs = resp.context_status;
      if (who === 'executor') this.lastStatusE = cs;
      else this.lastStatusC = cs;

DETECTOR_NEW = """    // Context tracking: use context_status from the API.
    if (resp.context_status) {
      const cs = resp.context_status;
      if (who === 'executor') this.lastStatusE = cs;
      else this.lastStatusC = cs;

      // Chat-transition detector: a sharp drop in percent_used means
      // the API switched to a new chat (snapshot + RAG). Log it as a
      // distinct event so the reader does not have to spot the jump.
      // Observability only.
      const prevPercent = who === 'executor'
        ? this.prevPercentE
        : this.prevPercentC;
      if (prevPercent >= 0
          && prevPercent - cs.percent_used >= TRANSITION_DROP_POINTS) {
        this.log.event(who, 'context_transition', {
          from_percent: prevPercent,
          to_percent: cs.percent_used,
          to_chars: cs.chars_used
        });
      }
      if (who === 'executor') this.prevPercentE = cs.percent_used;
      else this.prevPercentC = cs.percent_used;

      this.log.event(who, 'context', {"""

### Added

- **Chat-transition detection in the log.** When `percent_used` drops
  by 50+ points between two consecutive responses from the same agent,
  the orchestrator logs a `context_transition` event with the before
  and after values. This is what a snapshot-and-RAG handoff to a new
  chat looks like from the client's side. Observability only — no
  control flow reads this event."""

PROBE_TRANSITION = r'''/**
 * Unit test for step 51f — chat-transition detector.
 *
 * Mocks ApiClient and Executor. No real API servers needed.
 *
 * Scenario: the Executor returns three responses with context_status
 * percent_used at 88, 3, 5. The 88 → 3 drop crosses the 50-point
 * threshold and must produce one context_transition event. The 3 → 5
 * step is ordinary growth and must not.
 *
 * Run:
 *   npx ts-node --project scripts/tsconfig.json scripts/probe-context-transition.ts
 */

import * as fs from 'fs';
import * as os from 'os';
import * as path from 'path';
import { ApiClient } from '../src/api';
import { Executor } from '../src/executor';
import { Logger } from '../src/log';
import { NullPanel, Orchestrator } from '../src/orchestrator';
import { AssistantResponse, ContextStatus, ExecResult } from '../src/types';

let failures = 0;

function check(condition: boolean, label: string): void {
  if (condition) {
    console.log(`  ✓ ${label}`);
  } else {
    console.error(`  ✗ ${label}`);
    failures++;
  }
}

function freshTmp(name: string): string {
  const p = path.join(os.tmpdir(),
    `${name}-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8)}`);
  fs.mkdirSync(p, { recursive: true });
  return p;
}

type Step = {
  kind: 'tools';
  calls: { name: string; args: any }[];
  percent: number;
};

class FakeApi {
  constructor(private who: string, private script: Step[]) {}
  private idx = 0;
  async newChat(): Promise<void> { /* no-op */ }
  async chat(): Promise<AssistantResponse> {
    if (this.idx >= this.script.length) {
      throw new Error(`FakeApi(${this.who}): script exhausted`);
    }
    const s = this.script[this.idx++];
    const context_status: ContextStatus = {
      chars_used: s.percent * 24000,
      chars_limit: 2_400_000,
      percent_used: s.percent,
      language_coefficient: 2.4,
      warning: null,
      recommendation: null
    };
    return {
      text: '',
      tool_calls: s.calls.map((c, i) => ({
        id: `call_${this.idx}_${i}`,
        name: c.name as any,
        args: c.args
      })) as any,
      context_status,
      raw: {}
    };
  }
}

class FakeExecutor {
  async run(call_id: string, script: string): Promise<ExecResult> {
    return {
      call_id, command: 'noop', exit_code: 0, duration_ms: 1,
      stdout: 'ok\n', stderr: '',
      stdout_truncated: false, stderr_truncated: false
    };
  }
}

function mkLog(cwd: string): Logger {
  return new Logger(cwd, { appendLine: () => { /* silent */ } });
}

async function runOrch(
  cwd: string,
  apiE: FakeApi,
  apiC: FakeApi
): Promise<void> {
  const log = mkLog(cwd);
  const orch = new Orchestrator(
    apiE as unknown as ApiClient,
    apiC as unknown as ApiClient,
    new FakeExecutor() as unknown as Executor,
    new NullPanel(),
    log,
    {
      cwd, name: 'probe-context-transition', task: 'stub',
      deadlineAt: Date.now() + 30_000,
      executorPrompt: 'E', criticPrompt: 'C'
    }
  );
  await orch.run();
  log.close();
  await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 200));
}

function readLog(cwd: string): any[] {
  const logPath = path.join(cwd, '.pingis', 'session.log');
  if (!fs.existsSync(logPath)) return [];
  return fs.readFileSync(logPath, 'utf-8')
    .split('\n').filter(Boolean).map(l => JSON.parse(l));
}

async function t1_transition_detected(): Promise<void> {
  console.log('\nT1: 88% → 3% triggers one transition event');

  const cwd = freshTmp('probe-transition-t1');
  fs.mkdirSync(path.join(cwd, '.pingis'), { recursive: true });
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(cwd, '.pingis', 'plan.md'), '# Plan\n');

  // Executor:
  //   step 1: execute (percent 88)
  //   step 2: execute (percent 3)   ← transition (88 → 3)
  //   step 3: ALL DONE (percent 5)  ← no transition
  const apiE = new FakeApi('executor', [
    { kind: 'tools',
      calls: [{ name: 'execute', args: { script: 'print(1)' } }],
      percent: 88 },
    { kind: 'tools',
      calls: [{ name: 'execute', args: { script: 'print(2)' } }],
      percent: 3 },
    { kind: 'tools',
      calls: [{ name: 'send_message',
                args: { to: 'critic', message: 'ALL DONE: ok' } }],
      percent: 5 }
  ]);
  const apiC = new FakeApi('critic', [
    { kind: 'tools',
      calls: [{ name: 'finalize', args: { comment: 'done' } }],
      percent: 4 }
  ]);

  await runOrch(cwd, apiE, apiC);
  const lines = readLog(cwd);

  const transitions = lines.filter(
    e => e.event === 'context_transition' && e.who === 'executor'
  );

  check(transitions.length === 1,
    `exactly one transition detected (got ${transitions.length})`);
  if (transitions.length === 1) {
    const t = transitions[0];
    check(t.from_percent === 88,
      `from_percent = ${t.from_percent} (expected 88)`);
    check(t.to_percent === 3,
      `to_percent = ${t.to_percent} (expected 3)`);
  }

  // Critic has only one response, so no transition can be detected
  // for it — the first response has no previous value.
  const criticTransitions = lines.filter(
    e => e.event === 'context_transition' && e.who === 'critic'
  );
  check(criticTransitions.length === 0,
    `no transition for critic on its first response (got ${criticTransitions.length})`);
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

async function main(): Promise<void> {
  await t1_transition_detected();

  console.log();
  if (failures === 0) {
    console.log('=== SUCCESS: context-transition detector works ===');
    process.exit(0);
  } else {
    console.log(`=== FAILURE: ${failures} check(s) failed ===`);
    process.exit(1);
  }
}

main().catch(e => {
  console.error('CRASH:', e);
  process.exit(2);
});
'''


def patch_package_json() -> None:
    import json
    p = ROOT / "package.json"
    if not p.exists():
        print("  ✗ package.json not found")
        return
    backup("package.json")
    data = json.loads(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    scripts = data["scripts"]
    scripts["probe:context-transition"] = (
        "ts-node --project scripts/tsconfig.json "
        "scripts/probe-context-transition.ts"
    )
    order = ["compile", "watch", "typecheck:scripts", "vscode:prepublish",
             "probe:409", "probe:help", "probe:help-protocol",
             "probe:exec", "probe:artifacts", "probe:retry", "probe:phase",
             "probe:return-to-original", "probe:format-budget",
             "probe:context-transition"]
    ordered: dict[str, str] = {}
    for k in order:
        if k in scripts:
            ordered[k] = scripts.pop(k)
    ordered.update(scripts)
    data["scripts"] = ordered
    p.write_text(
        json.dumps(data, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n",
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    print("  + package.json: added probe:context-transition")


def main() -> int:
    if not (ROOT / "package.json").exists() or not (ROOT / "src").exists():
        print("ERROR: run from the pingis/ extension root.")
        return 1
    BACKUP.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    print("--- src/types.ts ---")
    rc = patch("src/types.ts", [(TYPES_OLD, TYPES_NEW)])
    if rc < 0:
        print(f"Aborting. Rollback: cp -r {BACKUP.relative_to(ROOT)}/* .")
        return 2

    print()
    print("--- src/log.ts ---")
    rc = patch("src/log.ts", [(LOG_OLD, LOG_NEW)])
    if rc < 0:
        print(f"Aborting. Rollback: cp -r {BACKUP.relative_to(ROOT)}/* .")
        return 2

    print()
    print("--- src/orchestrator.ts ---")
    rc = patch("src/orchestrator.ts", [
        (CONST_ANCHOR, CONST_NEW),
        (FIELDS_ANCHOR, FIELDS_NEW),
        (DETECTOR_OLD, DETECTOR_NEW),
    ])
    if rc < 0:
        print(f"Aborting. Rollback: cp -r {BACKUP.relative_to(ROOT)}/* .")
        return 2

    print()
    print("--- CHANGELOG.md ---")
    rc = patch("CHANGELOG.md", [(CHANGELOG_ANCHOR, CHANGELOG_NEW)])
    if rc < 0:
        print(f"Aborting. Rollback: cp -r {BACKUP.relative_to(ROOT)}/* .")
        return 2

    print()
    print("--- scripts/probe-context-transition.ts ---")
    write_new("scripts/probe-context-transition.ts", PROBE_TRANSITION)

    print()
    print("--- package.json ---")
    patch_package_json()

    if not run_cmd(["npm", "run", "compile"], "npm run compile"):
        print("Aborting: compile failed. Changes on disk, not committed.")
        return 3
    if not run_cmd(["npm", "run", "typecheck:scripts"],
                   "npm run typecheck:scripts"):
        print("Aborting: typecheck failed. Changes on disk, not committed.")
        return 4

    print()
    print("=== Unit tests ===")
    ok = True
    for name in ["probe:409", "probe:help", "probe:artifacts",
                 "probe:help-protocol", "probe:retry", "probe:phase",
                 "probe:return-to-original", "probe:format-budget",
                 "probe:context-transition"]:
        ok &= run_cmd(["npm", "run", name], name)
    if not ok:
        print("Aborting: tests failed. Changes on disk, not committed.")
        return 5

    print()
    print("=== Commit ===")
    git_commit("step51f: log context_transition on sharp context drop")

    print()
    print(f"Done. Rollback: cp -r {BACKUP.relative_to(ROOT)}/* .")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
===== END FILE: scripts/dev/apply_step51f_context_transition.py =====

===== FILE: scripts/dev/apply_step51f_fix_detector.py =====
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Step 51f (fix): insert the chat-transition detector reliably.

A previous 51f run applied TYPES, LOG, CONST and FIELDS, but DETECTOR
did not match — the multi-line pattern around `context_status` differed
from the file. This script installs the missing detector using a narrow
anchor: it inserts the transition block just before the existing
`this.log.event(who, 'context', {` call, and skips if `context_transition`
is already present.

Idempotent across all four orchestrator edits.

Run from the pingis/ extension root:
    python scripts/dev/apply_step51f_fix_detector.py
"""

import json
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent.parent
BACKUP = ROOT / ".backup" / "dev-snapshot-v22"


def backup(rel: str) -> None:
    src = ROOT / rel
    if not src.exists():
        return
    dst = BACKUP / rel
    dst.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    shutil.copy2(src, dst)


def patch(rel: str, pairs: list[tuple[str, str]]) -> int:
    p = ROOT / rel
    if not p.exists():
        print(f"  ✗ {rel}: not found")
        return -1
    text = p.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    original = text
    total = 0
    for old, new in pairs:
        if new in text:
            stripped = text.replace(new, "")
            if old not in stripped:
                print(f"  = {rel}: already patched")
                continue
        n = text.count(old)
        if n == 0:
            print(f"  ✗ {rel}: pattern not found; expected:")
            print(f"    {old[:200]!r}")
            return -1
        text = text.replace(old, new)
        total += n
        print(f"  + {rel}: {n} occurrence(s)")
    if text != original:
        backup(rel)
        p.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")
    return total


def write_new(rel: str, content: str) -> None:
    p = ROOT / rel
    p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    if p.exists():
        backup(rel)
    p.write_text(content, encoding="utf-8")
    print(f"  + {rel} (new, {len(content)} bytes)")


def run_cmd(cmd: list[str], label: str) -> bool:
    print()
    print(f"=== {label} ===")
    print("$ " + " ".join(cmd))
    r = subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=ROOT)
    if r.returncode != 0:
        print(f"  ✗ {label} failed (exit {r.returncode})")
        return False
    print(f"  + {label} ok")
    return True


def git_commit(message: str) -> None:
    if not (ROOT / ".git").exists():
        print("  git: no repo, skipping commit")
        return
    try:
        subprocess.run(["git", "add", "-A"], cwd=ROOT,
                       check=True, capture_output=True)
        subprocess.run(["git", "commit", "-m", message], cwd=ROOT,
                       check=True, capture_output=True)
        print(f"  git: committed \"{message}\"")
    except subprocess.CalledProcessError as e:
        print(f"  git: commit failed ({e})")


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# CONST + FIELDS — safe re-checks (they may already be applied)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

CONST_OLD = """const MAX_FORMAT_ROUNDS = 5;"""

CONST_NEW = """const MAX_FORMAT_ROUNDS = 5;

/**
 * Minimum drop in percent_used between two consecutive responses from
 * the same agent for the change to be reported as a chat transition.
 *
 * The API switches to a new chat around 90%; percent_used drops from
 * high-80s to a low single digit. A 50-point threshold distinguishes
 * that jump from ordinary fluctuations.
 */
const TRANSITION_DROP_POINTS = 50;"""


FIELDS_OLD = """  // Last context_status from each agent (percent_used, etc.).
  private lastStatusE: ContextStatus | null = null;
  private lastStatusC: ContextStatus | null = null;"""

FIELDS_NEW = """  // Last context_status from each agent (percent_used, etc.).
  private lastStatusE: ContextStatus | null = null;
  private lastStatusC: ContextStatus | null = null;

  // Previous percent_used seen from each agent. Used only to detect
  // a chat transition (sharp drop) for logging. Never read for
  // control flow.
  private prevPercentE = -1;
  private prevPercentC = -1;"""


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# DETECTOR — insert via a narrow anchor.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

DETECTOR_ANCHOR = """      this.log.event(who, 'context', {"""

DETECTOR_BLOCK = """      // Chat-transition detector: a sharp drop in percent_used means
      // the API switched to a new chat (snapshot + RAG). Log it as a
      // distinct event so the reader does not have to spot the jump.
      // Observability only.
      const prevPercent = who === 'executor'
        ? this.prevPercentE
        : this.prevPercentC;
      if (prevPercent >= 0
          && prevPercent - cs.percent_used >= TRANSITION_DROP_POINTS) {
        this.log.event(who, 'context_transition', {
          from_percent: prevPercent,
          to_percent: cs.percent_used,
          to_chars: cs.chars_used
        });
      }
      if (who === 'executor') this.prevPercentE = cs.percent_used;
      else this.prevPercentC = cs.percent_used;

"""


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Probe (same as before)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

PROBE_TRANSITION = r'''/**
 * Unit test for step 51f — chat-transition detector.
 *
 * Scenario: the Executor returns three responses with context_status
 * percent_used at 88, 3, 5. The 88 → 3 drop crosses the 50-point
 * threshold and must produce one context_transition event. The 3 → 5
 * step is ordinary growth and must not.
 *
 * Run:
 *   npx ts-node --project scripts/tsconfig.json scripts/probe-context-transition.ts
 */

import * as os from 'os';
import * as path from 'path';
import { ApiClient } from '../src/api';
import { Executor } from '../src/executor';
import { Logger } from '../src/log';
import { NullPanel, Orchestrator } from '../src/orchestrator';
import { AssistantResponse, ContextStatus, ExecResult } from '../src/types';

let failures = 0;

  if (condition) {
    console.log(`  ✓ ${label}`);
  } else {
    console.error(`  ✗ ${label}`);
    failures++;
  }
}

function freshTmp(name: string): string {

    `${name}-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8)}`);
  fs.mkdirSync(p, { recursive: true });

}

type Step = {
  kind: 'tools';
  calls: { name: string; args: any }[];
  percent: number;
};

class FakeApi {
  constructor(private who: string, private script: Step[]) {}

      throw new Error(`FakeApi(${this.who}): script exhausted`);
    }

      chars_used: s.percent * 24000,

      text: '',

        id: `call_${this.idx}_${i}`,
        name: c.name as any,
        args: c.args
      })) as any,
      context_status,
      raw: {}
    };
  }
}

class FakeExecutor {
  async run(call_id: string, script: string): Promise<ExecResult> {

async function t1_transition_detected(): Promise<void> {

def patch_package_json() -> None:
    p = ROOT / "package.json"
    if not p.exists():
        print("  ✗ package.json not found")
        return
    backup("package.json")
    data = json.loads(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    scripts = data["scripts"]
    scripts["probe:context-transition"] = (
        "ts-node --project scripts/tsconfig.json "
        "scripts/probe-context-transition.ts"
    )
    order = ["compile", "watch", "typecheck:scripts", "vscode:prepublish",
             "probe:409", "probe:help", "probe:help-protocol",
             "probe:exec", "probe:artifacts", "probe:retry", "probe:phase",
             "probe:return-to-original", "probe:format-budget",
             "probe:context-transition"]
    ordered: dict[str, str] = {}
    for k in order:
        if k in scripts:
            ordered[k] = scripts.pop(k)
    ordered.update(scripts)
    data["scripts"] = ordered
    p.write_text(
        json.dumps(data, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n",
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    print("  + package.json: added probe:context-transition")


def install_detector() -> int:
    """Insert the transition block before the context-event anchor."""
    rel = "src/orchestrator.ts"
    p = ROOT / rel
    if not p.exists():
        print(f"  ✗ {rel}: not found")
        return -1

    text = p.read_text(encoding="utf-8")

    if "context_transition" in text:
        print(f"  = {rel}: detector already present")
        return 0

    n = text.count(DETECTOR_ANCHOR)
    if n != 1:
        print(f"  ✗ {rel}: expected exactly one anchor, found {n}")
        return -1

    text = text.replace(DETECTOR_ANCHOR, DETECTOR_BLOCK + DETECTOR_ANCHOR, 1)
    backup(rel)
    p.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")
    print(f"  + {rel}: detector inserted before anchor")
    return 1


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# CHANGELOG
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

CHANGELOG_ANCHOR = """## [Unreleased]

### Added"""

CHANGELOG_NEW = """## [Unreleased]

### Added

- **Chat-transition detection in the log.** When `percent_used` drops
  by 50+ points between two consecutive responses from the same agent,
  the orchestrator logs a `context_transition` event with the before
  and after values. This is what a snapshot-and-RAG handoff to a new
  chat looks like from the client's side. Observability only — no
  control flow reads this event."""


def main() -> int:
    if not (ROOT / "package.json").exists() or not (ROOT / "src").exists():
        print("ERROR: run from the pingis/ extension root.")
        return 1
    BACKUP.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    print("--- src/orchestrator.ts (const + fields) ---")
    rc = patch("src/orchestrator.ts", [
        (CONST_OLD, CONST_NEW),
        (FIELDS_OLD, FIELDS_NEW),
    ])
    if rc < 0:
        print(f"Aborting. Rollback: cp -r {BACKUP.relative_to(ROOT)}/* .")
        return 2

    print()
    print("--- src/orchestrator.ts (detector) ---")
    rc = install_detector()
    if rc < 0:
        print(f"Aborting. Rollback: cp -r {BACKUP.relative_to(ROOT)}/* .")
        return 2

    print()
    print("--- CHANGELOG.md ---")
    rc = patch("CHANGELOG.md", [(CHANGELOG_ANCHOR, CHANGELOG_NEW)])
    if rc < 0:
        print(f"Aborting. Rollback: cp -r {BACKUP.relative_to(ROOT)}/* .")
        return 2

    print()
    print("--- scripts/probe-context-transition.ts ---")
    write_new("scripts/probe-context-transition.ts", PROBE_TRANSITION)

    print()
    print("--- package.json ---")
    patch_package_json()

    if not run_cmd(["npm", "run", "compile"], "npm run compile"):
        print("Aborting: compile failed. Changes on disk, not committed.")
        return 3
    if not run_cmd(["npm", "run", "typecheck:scripts"],
                   "npm run typecheck:scripts"):
        print("Aborting: typecheck failed. Changes on disk, not committed.")
        return 4

    print()
    print("=== Unit tests ===")
    ok = True

===== FILE: scripts/dev/apply_step51g_config_flags.py =====
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Step 51g: read API feature flags and record them in task_start.

config.ts currently exposes only port and api key for each agent.
The feature flags written by make-multi-agent.sh into agent.env
(ENABLE_RAG / ENABLE_SNAPSHOT / ENABLE_RESTORE) are not read anywhere,
so the log has no record of which configuration a task ran under.

This step:

  1. Extends AgentEndpoint with three booleans.
  2. Reads them in readAgent() from agent.env.
  3. Threads them through OrchestratorOptions and writes them into
     the `task_start` event under `api_config_executor` and
     `api_config_critic`.

Probes are unaffected: they do not pass `agentDirs`, so the flags
are not provided and the task_start event omits them.

Run from the pingis/ extension root:
    python scripts/dev/apply_step51g_config_flags.py
"""

import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent.parent
BACKUP = ROOT / ".backup" / "dev-snapshot-v23"


def backup(rel: str) -> None:
    src = ROOT / rel
    if not src.exists():
        return
    dst = BACKUP / rel
    dst.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    shutil.copy2(src, dst)


def patch(rel: str, pairs: list[tuple[str, str]]) -> int:
    p = ROOT / rel
    if not p.exists():
        print(f"  ✗ {rel}: not found")
        return -1
    text = p.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    original = text
    total = 0
    for old, new in pairs:
        if new in text:
            stripped = text.replace(new, "")
            if old not in stripped:
                print(f"  = {rel}: already patched")
                continue
        n = text.count(old)
        if n == 0:
            print(f"  ✗ {rel}: pattern not found; expected:")
            print(f"    {old[:200]!r}")
            return -1
        text = text.replace(old, new)
        total += n
        print(f"  + {rel}: {n} occurrence(s)")
    if text != original:
        backup(rel)
        p.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")
    return total


def run_cmd(cmd: list[str], label: str) -> bool:
    print()
    print(f"=== {label} ===")
    print("$ " + " ".join(cmd))
    r = subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=ROOT)
    if r.returncode != 0:
        print(f"  ✗ {label} failed (exit {r.returncode})")
        return False
    print(f"  + {label} ok")
    return True


def git_commit(message: str) -> None:
    if not (ROOT / ".git").exists():
        print("  git: no repo, skipping commit")
        return
    try:
        subprocess.run(["git", "add", "-A"], cwd=ROOT,
                       check=True, capture_output=True)
        subprocess.run(["git", "commit", "-m", message], cwd=ROOT,
                       check=True, capture_output=True)
        print(f"  git: committed \"{message}\"")
    except subprocess.CalledProcessError as e:
        print(f"  git: commit failed ({e})")


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# src/config.ts
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

ENDPOINT_OLD = """export interface AgentEndpoint {
  // Currently unused. Intended for logging agent identity
  // (agent-1 / agent-2) next to executor / critic in api_ready /
  // api_exit events. Remove if no such log line is planned.
  name: string;      // "agent-1" | "agent-2"
  dir: string;       // absolute path to agent-N/
  port: number;
  apiKey: string;
}"""

ENDPOINT_NEW = """export interface AgentEndpoint {
  // Currently unused. Intended for logging agent identity
  // (agent-1 / agent-2) next to executor / critic in api_ready /
  // api_exit events. Remove if no such log line is planned.
  name: string;      // "agent-1" | "agent-2"
  dir: string;       // absolute path to agent-N/
  port: number;
  apiKey: string;
  // Feature flags read from agent.env (written by
  // make-multi-agent.sh). Recorded in task_start so the log shows
  // which configuration a task ran under.
  enableRag: boolean;
  enableSnapshot: boolean;
  enableRestore: boolean;
}"""


READAGENT_STUB_OLD = """  if (!fs.existsSync(envPath) || !fs.existsSync(keyPath)) {
    return { name, dir, port: 0, apiKey: '' };
  }

  const env = readEnv(envPath);
  const port = parseInt(env.PORT ?? '', 10);
  if (!Number.isFinite(port) || port <= 0) {
    throw new Error(`Invalid PORT in ${envPath}`);
  }

  const apiKey = fs.readFileSync(keyPath, 'utf-8').trim();
  if (!apiKey) {
    throw new Error(`Empty .api-key: ${keyPath}`);
  }

  return { name, dir, port, apiKey };
}"""

READAGENT_STUB_NEW = """  if (!fs.existsSync(envPath) || !fs.existsSync(keyPath)) {
    return {
      name, dir, port: 0, apiKey: '',
      enableRag: false, enableSnapshot: false, enableRestore: false
    };
  }

  const env = readEnv(envPath);
  const port = parseInt(env.PORT ?? '', 10);
  if (!Number.isFinite(port) || port <= 0) {
    throw new Error(`Invalid PORT in ${envPath}`);
  }

  const apiKey = fs.readFileSync(keyPath, 'utf-8').trim();
  if (!apiKey) {
    throw new Error(`Empty .api-key: ${keyPath}`);
  }

  return {
    name, dir, port, apiKey,
    enableRag: parseBool(env.ENABLE_RAG),
    enableSnapshot: parseBool(env.ENABLE_SNAPSHOT),
    enableRestore: parseBool(env.ENABLE_RESTORE)
  };
}

/**
 * Parse a boolean env value strictly. Only the exact string "true"
 * (case-insensitive, trimmed) is true. Everything else — including
 * "false", "0", "no", and unset — is false.
 */
function parseBool(v: string | undefined): boolean {
  return (v ?? '').trim().toLowerCase() === 'true';
}"""

===== FILE: scripts/dev/apply_step55_gave_up.py =====
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Step 55: split 'deadlock' into 'deadlock' and 'gave_up'.

Currently an agent's IMPOSSIBLE ends the task with stop reason
'deadlock'. But 'deadlock' also fires when both queues are empty and
nobody is doing anything (in run()'s loop tail). These are different
events:

  - deadlock: the orchestrator ran out of work — a structural bug or
    an unexpected protocol state.
  - gave_up:  an agent consciously declared the task impossible.

The distinction matters for the user-facing reason text and for any
future retry decision (currently neither is retryable, but that may
change). The `deadlock` reason is not removed — it stays for the
loop-tail case.

Changes:
  - src/types.ts: add 'gave_up' to StopReason.
  - src/orchestrator.ts: IMPOSSIBLE handler now stops with 'gave_up'.
  - media/panel.js: reasonText entries for both reasons.
  - scripts/probe-help-protocol.ts: T2, T4, T5 assert 'gave_up' instead
    of 'deadlock' for IMPOSSIBLE scenarios.

Behavior for the deadlock case (loop tail) is unchanged.

Run from the pingis/ extension root:
    python scripts/dev/apply_step55_gave_up.py
"""

import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent.parent
BACKUP = ROOT / ".backup" / "dev-snapshot-v16"


def backup(rel: str) -> None:
    src = ROOT / rel
    if not src.exists():
        return
    dst = BACKUP / rel
    dst.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    shutil.copy2(src, dst)

        return -1

    original = text
    total = 0
    for old, new in pairs:

            if old not in stripped:

                continue
        n = text.count(old)

            return -1

        total += n
        print(f"  + {rel}: {n} occurrence(s)")
    if text != original:
        backup(rel)
        p.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")
    return total


def run_cmd(cmd: list[str], label: str) -> bool:

===== FILE: scripts/dev/apply_step55a_fix_summary.py =====
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Step 55a: fix fallback-summary condition after step55 rename.

Step 55 renamed the IMPOSSIBLE stop reason from 'deadlock' to
'gave_up' but did not update the fallback-summary condition in
Orchestrator.run()'s finally block. As a result, an IMPOSSIBLE no
longer writes summary.md — a real regression caught by
probe-help-protocol T4.

Fix: include 'gave_up' in the condition list.

This script also commits the step55 changes, which are on disk but
not yet committed (step55 failed at probe-help-protocol T4 before
reaching its own commit). The two steps are one logical unit:
step55 renamed the reason, step55a completes the rename.

Run from the pingis/ extension root:
    python scripts/dev/apply_step55a_fix_summary.py
"""

import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent.parent
BACKUP = ROOT / ".backup" / "dev-snapshot-v16"


def backup(rel: str) -> None:
    src = ROOT / rel
    if not src.exists():
        return
    dst = BACKUP / rel
    dst.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    shutil.copy2(src, dst)


def patch(rel: str, pairs: list[tuple[str, str]]) -> int:
    p = ROOT / rel
    if not p.exists():
        print(f"  ✗ {rel}: not found")
        return -1
    text = p.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    original = text
    total = 0
    for old, new in pairs:
        if new in text:
            stripped = text.replace(new, "")
            if old not in stripped:
                print(f"  = {rel}: already patched")
                continue
        n = text.count(old)
        if n == 0:
            print(f"  ✗ {rel}: pattern not found; expected:")
            print(f"    {old[:160]!r}")
            return -1
        text = text.replace(old, new)
        total += n
        print(f"  + {rel}: {n} occurrence(s)")
    if text != original:
        backup(rel)
        p.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")
    return total


def run_cmd(cmd: list[str], label: str) -> bool:
    print()
    print(f"=== {label} ===")
    print("$ " + " ".join(cmd))
    r = subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=ROOT)
    if r.returncode != 0:
        print(f"  ✗ {label} failed (exit {r.returncode})")
        return False
    print(f"  + {label} ok")
    return True


def git_commit(message: str) -> None:
    if not (ROOT / ".git").exists():
        print("  git: no repo, skipping commit")
        return
    try:
        subprocess.run(["git", "add", "-A"], cwd=ROOT,
                       check=True, capture_output=True)
        subprocess.run(["git", "commit", "-m", message], cwd=ROOT,
                       check=True, capture_output=True)
        print(f"  git: committed \"{message}\"")
    except subprocess.CalledProcessError as e:
        print(f"  git: commit failed ({e})")


COND_OLD = """      // Fallback summary when the Critic did not write one.
      // Covers clean done without summary, and deadlock (IMPOSSIBLE).
      if ((this.stopReason === 'done' || this.stopReason === 'deadlock')
          && !fs.existsSync(summaryPath)) {
        this.writeFallbackSummary(summaryPath, planPath);
      }"""

COND_NEW = """      // Fallback summary when the Critic did not write one.
      // Covers clean done, deadlock (empty queues), and gave_up
      // (IMPOSSIBLE from an agent). All three end the task without
      // the Critic having written a summary; the user still needs a
      // persistent record of what happened.
      if ((this.stopReason === 'done' ||
           this.stopReason === 'deadlock' ||
           this.stopReason === 'gave_up')
          && !fs.existsSync(summaryPath)) {
        this.writeFallbackSummary(summaryPath, planPath);
      }"""


def main() -> int:
    if not (ROOT / "package.json").exists() or not (ROOT / "src").exists():
        print("ERROR: run from the pingis/ extension root.")
        return 1
    BACKUP.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    print("--- src/orchestrator.ts ---")
    rc = patch("src/orchestrator.ts", [(COND_OLD, COND_NEW)])
    if rc < 0:
        print(f"Aborting. Rollback: cp -r {BACKUP.relative_to(ROOT)}/* .")
        return 2

    if not run_cmd(["npm", "run", "compile"], "npm run compile"):
        print("Aborting: compile failed.")
        return 3
    if not run_cmd(["npm", "run", "typecheck:scripts"],
                   "npm run typecheck:scripts"):
        print("Aborting: typecheck failed.")
        return 4

    print("=== Unit tests ===")
    ok = True
    for name in ["probe:409", "probe:help", "probe:artifacts",

        ok &= run_cmd(["npm", "run", name], name)
    if not ok:
        print("Aborting: tests failed. Changes on disk, not committed.")
        return 5

    print()
    print("=== Commit ===")
    print("  (includes step55 changes from the previous run)")
    git_commit("step55: split gave_up from deadlock, fix summary fallback")

    print()
    print(f"Done. Rollback: cp -r {BACKUP.relative_to(ROOT)}/* .")
    return 0

    sys.exit(main())

===== FILE: scripts/dev/apply_step56_graceful_shutdown.py =====
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Step 56: fix graceful shutdown on soft deadline.

Two related bugs surfaced in the ASDI e2e run.

Bug 1. When the soft deadline fires, the orchestrator queues a
TIME_LIMIT message for the Critic. But the main loop checks the
Executor queue first:

    if (hasE) { step('executor') }
    else if (hasC) { step('critic') }

If the Executor still has pending work (which it does after every
execute), the Critic never gets a turn — the task runs to the hard
deadline instead of finalizing. In ASDI: 53 Executor turns, 2 Critic
turns, stop reason 'timeout'.

Fix: on soft deadline, drop the Executor queue. The Critic gets the
TIME_LIMIT, reads plan.md, and finalizes. If it does not finish in
time, the hard deadline still fires.

Bug 2. The fallback-summary condition in finally did not include
'timeout'. On timeout the user found plan.md on disk but no
summary.md. Fix: include 'timeout' in the list.

Design note: the grace window (GRACE_MS) becomes overridable via
OrchestratorOptions.graceMs, so probes can shrink it without waiting
two real minutes. Default remains 120_000.

Run from the pingis/ extension root:
    python scripts/dev/apply_step56_graceful_shutdown.py
"""

import json
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent.parent
BACKUP = ROOT / ".backup" / "dev-snapshot-v24"


def backup(rel: str) -> None:
    src = ROOT / rel
    if not src.exists():
        return
    dst = BACKUP / rel
    dst.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    shutil.copy2(src, dst)


def patch(rel: str, pairs: list[tuple[str, str]]) -> int:
    p = ROOT / rel
    if not p.exists():
        print(f"  ✗ {rel}: not found")
        return -1
    text = p.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    original = text
    total = 0
    for old, new in pairs:
        if new in text:
            stripped = text.replace(new, "")
            if old not in stripped:
                print(f"  = {rel}: already patched")
                continue
        n = text.count(old)
        if n == 0:
            print(f"  ✗ {rel}: pattern not found; expected:")
            print(f"    {old[:200]!r}")
            return -1
        text = text.replace(old, new)
        total += n
        print(f"  + {rel}: {n} occurrence(s)")
    if text != original:
        backup(rel)
        p.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")
    return total


def write_new(rel: str, content: str) -> None:
    p = ROOT / rel
    p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    if p.exists():
        backup(rel)
    p.write_text(content, encoding="utf-8")
    print(f"  + {rel} (new, {len(content)} bytes)")


def run_cmd(cmd: list[str], label: str) -> bool:
    print()
    print(f"=== {label} ===")
    print("$ " + " ".join(cmd))
    r = subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=ROOT)
    if r.returncode != 0:
        print(f"  ✗ {label} failed (exit {r.returncode})")
        return False
    print(f"  + {label} ok")
    return True


def git_commit(message: str) -> None:
    if not (ROOT / ".git").exists():
        print("  git: no repo, skipping commit")
        return
    try:
        subprocess.run(["git", "add", "-A"], cwd=ROOT,
                       check=True, capture_output=True)
        subprocess.run(["git", "commit", "-m", message], cwd=ROOT,
                       check=True, capture_output=True)
        print(f"  git: committed \"{message}\"")
    except subprocess.CalledProcessError as e:
        print(f"  git: commit failed ({e})")


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# src/orchestrator.ts — options, deadline math, two fixes
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# 1) OrchestratorOptions: add graceMs.
OPTS_OLD = """  deadlineAt: number;
  executorPrompt: string;
  criticPrompt: string;
  initialFiles?: string[];"""

OPTS_NEW = """  deadlineAt: number;
  executorPrompt: string;
  criticPrompt: string;
  /**
   * Extra time granted after the soft deadline before the hard stop.
   * Defaults to GRACE_MS. Exposed so probes can shrink the window
   * without waiting two real minutes.
   */
  graceMs?: number;
  initialFiles?: string[];"""


# 2) Use graceMs in run().
DEADLINE_OLD = """    try {
      const softDeadline = this.opts.deadlineAt;
      const hardDeadline = softDeadline + GRACE_MS;
      let softFired = false;"""

DEADLINE_NEW = """    try {
      const softDeadline = this.opts.deadlineAt;
      const graceMs = this.opts.graceMs ?? GRACE_MS;
      const hardDeadline = softDeadline + graceMs;
      let softFired = false;"""


# 3) Fix 1: drop Executor queue on soft deadline.
SOFT_OLD = """            this.pendingGracefulShutdown = true;
            this.queueC.push({
              msg: {
                role: 'user',
                content:
                  'TIME_LIMIT: The overall task time has expired. Read ' +"""

SOFT_NEW = """            // Drop any pending Executor work. On timeout the Critic
            // finalizes; if the Executor queue stayed non-empty, the
            // hasE branch below would keep taking priority and the
            // TIME_LIMIT message would never reach the Critic.
            this.queueE.length = 0;
            this.pendingGracefulShutdown = true;
            this.queueC.push({
              msg: {
                role: 'user',
                content:
                  'TIME_LIMIT: The overall task time has expired. Read ' +"""


# 4) Fix 2: fallback summary covers 'timeout'.
FALLBACK_OLD = """      if ((this.stopReason === 'done' ||
           this.stopReason === 'deadlock' ||
           this.stopReason === 'gave_up')
          && !fs.existsSync(summaryPath)) {
        this.writeFallbackSummary(summaryPath, planPath);
      }"""

FALLBACK_NEW = """      if ((this.stopReason === 'done' ||
           this.stopReason === 'deadlock' ||
           this.stopReason === 'gave_up' ||
           this.stopReason === 'timeout')
          && !fs.existsSync(summaryPath)) {
        this.writeFallbackSummary(summaryPath, planPath);
      }"""


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# CHANGELOG
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

CHANGELOG_ANCHOR = """## [Unreleased]"""

CHANGELOG_NEW = """## [Unreleased]

### Fixed

- **Graceful shutdown on timeout.** When the soft deadline fires, the
  orchestrator now drops the Executor's pending queue before queuing
  the `TIME_LIMIT:` message for the Critic. Previously the Executor's
  non-empty queue kept taking priority in the main loop, and the
  Critic never received the message — the task ran all the way to the
  hard deadline instead of finalizing. The user saw a bare `timeout`
  stop with no summary.
- **Fallback summary on `timeout`.** `timeout` is now included in the
  condition that writes `summary.md` when the Critic did not. After a
  graceful shutdown the user finds both `plan.md` (preserved) and
  `summary.md` (fallback) on disk."""

# Probe

PROBE_SOFT = r'''/**
 * Unit test for step 56 — graceful shutdown on soft deadline.
 *
 * T1. Executor makes a few executes; soft deadline fires; the
 *     Executor queue is drained; Critic gets TIME_LIMIT and
 *     finalizes. stop reason = 'done'; plan.md and summary.md exist
 *     (graceful shutdown keeps the plan).
 *
 * T2. Same setup, but the grace window is short and the Critic never
 *     finalizes. Hard deadline fires. stop reason = 'timeout';
 *     summary.md and plan.md are both present.
 *
 * Run:
 *   npx ts-node --project scripts/tsconfig.json scripts/probe-soft-deadline.ts
 */

import * as fs from 'fs';
import * as os from 'os';
import * as path from 'path';
import { ApiClient } from '../src/api';
import { Executor } from '../src/executor';
import { Logger } from '../src/log';
import { NullPanel, Orchestrator } from '../src/orchestrator';
import { AssistantResponse, ExecResult } from '../src/types';

let failures = 0;

function check(condition: boolean, label: string): void {
  if (condition) {
    console.log(`  ✓ ${label}`);
  } else {
    console.error(`  ✗ ${label}`);
    failures++;
  }
}

function freshTmp(name: string): string {
  const p = path.join(os.tmpdir(),
    `${name}-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8)}`);
  fs.mkdirSync(p, { recursive: true });
  return p;
}

// Infinite execute: every chat() returns another execute call.
class InfiniteExecuteApi {
  public calls = 0;
  async newChat(): Promise<void> { /* no-op */ }
  async chat(): Promise<AssistantResponse> {
    this.calls++;
    return {
      text: '',
      tool_calls: [{
        id: `call_${this.calls}`,
        name: 'execute',
        args: { script: 'print(1)' }
      } as any],
      raw: {}
    };
  }
}

// Finalize on the first chat() call.
class FinalizeApi {
  public calls = 0;
  async newChat(): Promise<void> { /* no-op */ }
  async chat(): Promise<AssistantResponse> {
    this.calls++;
    return {
      text: '',
      tool_calls: [{
        id: `call_${this.calls}`,
        name: 'finalize',
        args: { comment: 'soft-deadline' }
      } as any],
      raw: {}
    };
  }
}

class SlowFakeExecutor {
  public calls = 0;
  async run(call_id: string, script: string): Promise<ExecResult> {
    this.calls++;
    await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 40));
    return {
      call_id, command: 'noop', exit_code: 0, duration_ms: 40,
      stdout: 'ok\n', stderr: '',
      stdout_truncated: false, stderr_truncated: false
    };
  }
}

function mkLog(cwd: string): Logger {
  return new Logger(cwd, { appendLine: () => { /* silent */ } });
}

async function runOrch(
  cwd: string,
  apiE: InfiniteExecuteApi,
  apiC: FinalizeApi | InfiniteExecuteApi,
  deadlineAt: number,
  graceMs: number,
  exec: SlowFakeExecutor
): Promise<void> {
  const log = mkLog(cwd);
  const orch = new Orchestrator(
    apiE as unknown as ApiClient,
    apiC as unknown as ApiClient,
    exec as unknown as Executor,
    new NullPanel(),
    log,
    {
      cwd, name: 'probe-soft-deadline', task: 'stub',
      deadlineAt,
      graceMs,
      executorPrompt: 'E', criticPrompt: 'C'
    }
  );
  await orch.run();
  log.close();
  await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 200));
}

function readLog(cwd: string): any[] {
  const logPath = path.join(cwd, '.pingis', 'session.log');
  if (!fs.existsSync(logPath)) return [];
  return fs.readFileSync(logPath, 'utf-8')
    .split('\n').filter(Boolean).map(l => JSON.parse(l));
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

async function t1_critic_finalizes_on_soft_deadline(): Promise<void> {
  console.log('\nT1: soft deadline → Critic finalizes → done');

  const cwd = freshTmp('probe-soft-t1');
  fs.mkdirSync(path.join(cwd, '.pingis'), { recursive: true });
  // No plan.md → fresh chats (irrelevant here, but sets a known state).

  const apiE = new InfiniteExecuteApi();
  const apiC = new FinalizeApi();
  const exec = new SlowFakeExecutor();

  // Soft deadline very close; grace long enough for the Critic to
  // finalize on its first step.
  await runOrch(cwd, apiE, apiC, Date.now() + 200, 800, exec);
  const lines = readLog(cwd);

  const soft = lines.find(
    e => e.event === 'error' && e.code === 'soft_deadline'
  );
  const timeLimitRoute = lines.find(
    e => e.event === 'route' && e.to === 'critic'
      && typeof e.message === 'string'
      && e.message.startsWith('TIME_LIMIT:')
  );
  const stop = lines.find(e => e.event === 'stop');

  check(!!soft, 'soft_deadline event logged');
  check(!!timeLimitRoute, 'TIME_LIMIT routed to critic');

  // Executor made fewer than 10 executes — its queue was drained on
  // soft deadline. The exact number is timing-dependent.
  check(exec.calls < 10,
    `executor executed fewer than 10 times (got ${exec.calls})`);

  check(stop?.reason === 'done',
    `stop reason = ${stop?.reason} (expected done)`);

  const planPath = path.join(cwd, '.pingis', 'plan.md');
  const summaryPath = path.join(cwd, '.pingis', 'summary.md');
  // No plan.md existed to begin with, so only summary is checked.
  check(fs.existsSync(summaryPath), 'summary.md written (fallback)');
}

async function t2_hard_deadline_after_short_grace(): Promise<void> {
  console.log('\nT2: short grace → hard deadline → timeout with summary');

  const cwd = freshTmp('probe-soft-t2');
  fs.mkdirSync(path.join(cwd, '.pingis'), { recursive: true });
  // A plan.md so we can verify it is preserved on timeout.
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(cwd, '.pingis', 'plan.md'),
    '# Plan\nreal content\n');

  const apiE = new InfiniteExecuteApi();
  // Critic never finalizes — keeps doing executes until hard deadline.
  const apiC = new InfiniteExecuteApi();
  const exec = new SlowFakeExecutor();

  // Soft at +100ms, hard at +400ms — Critic cannot finish in time.
  await runOrch(cwd, apiE, apiC, Date.now() + 100, 300, exec);
  const lines = readLog(cwd);

  const stop = lines.find(e => e.event === 'stop');
  check(stop?.reason === 'timeout',
    `stop reason = ${stop?.reason} (expected timeout)`);

  const summaryPath = path.join(cwd, '.pingis', 'summary.md');
  const planPath = path.join(cwd, '.pingis', 'plan.md');
  check(fs.existsSync(summaryPath),
    'summary.md written (fallback on timeout)');
  check(fs.existsSync(planPath),
    'plan.md preserved on graceful shutdown');

  const artifact = lines.find(
    e => e.event === 'artifact' && e.action === 'fallback'
  );
  check(!!artifact, 'fallback summary artifact event logged');
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

async function main(): Promise<void> {
  await t1_critic_finalizes_on_soft_deadline();
  await t2_hard_deadline_after_short_grace();

  console.log();
  if (failures === 0) {
    console.log('=== SUCCESS: graceful shutdown works ===');
    process.exit(0);
  } else {
    console.log(`=== FAILURE: ${failures} check(s) failed ===`);
    process.exit(1);
  }
}

main().catch(e => {
  console.error('CRASH:', e);
  process.exit(2);
});
'''


def patch_package_json() -> None:
    p = ROOT / "package.json"
    if not p.exists():
        print("  ✗ package.json not found")
        return
    backup("package.json")
    data = json.loads(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    scripts = data["scripts"]
    scripts["probe:soft-deadline"] = (
        "ts-node --project scripts/tsconfig.json scripts/probe-soft-deadline.ts"
    )
    order = ["compile", "watch", "typecheck:scripts", "vscode:prepublish",
             "probe:409", "probe:help", "probe:help-protocol",
             "probe:exec", "probe:artifacts", "probe:retry", "probe:phase",
             "probe:return-to-original", "probe:format-budget",
             "probe:context-transition", "probe:soft-deadline"]
    ordered: dict[str, str] = {}
    for k in order:
        if k in scripts:
            ordered[k] = scripts.pop(k)
    ordered.update(scripts)
    data["scripts"] = ordered
    p.write_text(
        json.dumps(data, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n",
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    print("  + package.json: added probe:soft-deadline")


def main() -> int:
    if not (ROOT / "package.json").exists() or not (ROOT / "src").exists():
        print("ERROR: run from the pingis/ extension root.")

    ])

        return 2

    print()
    print("--- scripts/probe-soft-deadline.ts ---")
    write_new("scripts/probe-soft-deadline.ts", PROBE_SOFT)

    print()
    print("--- package.json ---")
    patch_package_json()

    if not run_cmd(["npm", "run", "compile"], "npm run compile"):
        print("Aborting: compile failed. Changes on disk, not committed.")
        return 3
    if not run_cmd(["npm", "run", "typecheck:scripts"],
