===== FILE: scripts/probe-checkpoint-nudge.ts =====
/**
 * Unit test for step 57 — checkpoint nudge.
 *
 * Scenario: Executor makes 17 execute calls, then ALL DONE. Critic
 * finalizes. With CHECKPOINT_NUDGE_AFTER = 15, exactly one
 * checkpoint_nudge event must be logged (at the 16th request), and
 * the streak resets to 0 afterwards.
 *
 * Run:
 *   npx ts-node --project scripts/tsconfig.json scripts/probe-checkpoint-nudge.ts
 */

import * as fs from 'fs';
import * as os from 'os';
import * as path from 'path';
import { ApiClient } from '../src/api';
import { Executor } from '../src/executor';
import { Logger } from '../src/log';
import { NullPanel, Orchestrator } from '../src/orchestrator';
import { AssistantResponse, ExecResult } from '../src/types';

let failures = 0;

function check(condition: boolean, label: string): void {
  if (condition) {
    console.log(`  ✓ ${label}`);
  } else {
    console.error(`  ✗ ${label}`);
    failures++;
  }
}

function freshTmp(name: string): string {
  const p = path.join(os.tmpdir(),
    `${name}-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8)}`);
  fs.mkdirSync(p, { recursive: true });
  return p;
}

type Step =
  | { kind: 'execute' }
  | { kind: 'tools'; calls: { name: string; args: any }[] };

class FakeApi {
  public receivedContents: string[] = [];
  constructor(private who: string, private script: Step[]) {}
  private idx = 0;
  async newChat(): Promise<void> { /* no-op */ }
  async chat(session: unknown, msg: { content: string }): Promise<AssistantResponse> {
    this.receivedContents.push(msg.content);
    if (this.idx >= this.script.length) {
      throw new Error(`FakeApi(${this.who}): script exhausted`);
    }
    const s = this.script[this.idx++];
    if (s.kind === 'execute') {
      return {
        text: '',
        tool_calls: [{
          id: `call_${this.idx}`,
          name: 'execute',
          args: { script: 'print(1)' }
        } as any],
        raw: {}
      };
    }
    return {
      text: '',
      tool_calls: s.calls.map((c, i) => ({
        id: `call_${this.idx}_${i}`,
        name: c.name as any,
        args: c.args
      })) as any,
      raw: {}
    };
  }
}

class FakeExecutor {
  async run(call_id: string, script: string): Promise<ExecResult> {
    return {
      call_id, command: 'noop', exit_code: 0, duration_ms: 1,
      stdout: 'ok\n', stderr: '',
      stdout_truncated: false, stderr_truncated: false
    };
  }
}

function mkLog(cwd: string): Logger {
  return new Logger(cwd, { appendLine: () => { /* silent */ } });
}

async function runOrch(
  cwd: string,
  apiE: FakeApi,
  apiC: FakeApi
): Promise<void> {
  const log = mkLog(cwd);
  const orch = new Orchestrator(
    apiE as unknown as ApiClient,
    apiC as unknown as ApiClient,
    new FakeExecutor() as unknown as Executor,
    new NullPanel(),
    log,
    {
      cwd, name: 'probe-checkpoint-nudge', task: 'stub',
      deadlineAt: Date.now() + 60_000,
      executorPrompt: 'E', criticPrompt: 'C'
    }
  );
  await orch.run();
  log.close();
  await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 200));
}

function readLog(cwd: string): any[] {
  const logPath = path.join(cwd, '.pingis', 'session.log');
  if (!fs.existsSync(logPath)) return [];
  return fs.readFileSync(logPath, 'utf-8')
    .split('\n').filter(Boolean).map(l => JSON.parse(l));
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

async function t1_nudge_fires_once(): Promise<void> {
  console.log('\nT1: 15 executes → one checkpoint_nudge, then reset');

  const cwd = freshTmp('probe-nudge-t1');
  fs.mkdirSync(path.join(cwd, '.pingis'), { recursive: true });
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(cwd, '.pingis', 'plan.md'), '# Plan\n');

  // Executor: 17 executes then ALL DONE.
  const executorSteps: Step[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < 17; i++) executorSteps.push({ kind: 'execute' });
  executorSteps.push({
    kind: 'tools',
    calls: [{ name: 'send_message',
              args: { to: 'critic', message: 'ALL DONE: ok' } }]
  });
  const apiE = new FakeApi('executor', executorSteps);

  const apiC = new FakeApi('critic', [
    { kind: 'tools',
      calls: [{ name: 'finalize', args: { comment: 'done' } }] }
  ]);

  await runOrch(cwd, apiE, apiC);
  const lines = readLog(cwd);

  const nudges = lines.filter(e => e.event === 'checkpoint_nudge');

  check(nudges.length === 1,
    `exactly one checkpoint_nudge (got ${nudges.length})`);
  if (nudges.length === 1) {
    check(nudges[0].who === 'executor',
      `nudge agent = ${nudges[0].who} (expected executor)`);
    check(nudges[0].streak === 15,
      `nudge streak = ${nudges[0].streak} (expected 15)`);
  }

  // The 16th request to the executor must carry the [CHECKPOINT] prefix.
  // requests are recorded via receivedContents (one per chat call).
  // Executor requests are those made before the ALL DONE turn.
  // We expect the prefix on exactly one of them.
  const executorMsgsWithPrefix = apiE.receivedContents.filter(
    c => c.startsWith('[CHECKPOINT]')
  );
  check(executorMsgsWithPrefix.length === 1,
    `exactly one executor request has the [CHECKPOINT] prefix (got ${executorMsgsWithPrefix.length})`);
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

async function main(): Promise<void> {
  await t1_nudge_fires_once();

  console.log();
  if (failures === 0) {
    console.log('=== SUCCESS: checkpoint nudge works ===');
    process.exit(0);
  } else {
    console.log(`=== FAILURE: ${failures} check(s) failed ===`);
    process.exit(1);
  }
}

main().catch(e => {
  console.error('CRASH:', e);
  process.exit(2);
});
===== END FILE: scripts/probe-checkpoint-nudge.ts =====

===== FILE: scripts/probe-context-transition.ts =====
/**
 * Unit test for step 51f — chat-transition detector.
 *
 * Scenario: the Executor returns three responses with context_status
 * percent_used at 88, 3, 5. The 88 → 3 drop crosses the 50-point
 * threshold and must produce one context_transition event. The 3 → 5
 * step is ordinary growth and must not.
 *
 * Run:
 *   npx ts-node --project scripts/tsconfig.json scripts/probe-context-transition.ts
 */

import * as fs from 'fs';
import * as os from 'os';
import * as path from 'path';
import { ApiClient } from '../src/api';
import { Executor } from '../src/executor';
import { Logger } from '../src/log';
import { NullPanel, Orchestrator } from '../src/orchestrator';
import { AssistantResponse, ContextStatus, ExecResult } from '../src/types';

let failures = 0;

function check(condition: boolean, label: string): void {
  if (condition) {
    console.log(`  ✓ ${label}`);
  } else {
    console.error(`  ✗ ${label}`);
    failures++;
  }
}

function freshTmp(name: string): string {
  const p = path.join(os.tmpdir(),
    `${name}-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8)}`);
  fs.mkdirSync(p, { recursive: true });
  return p;
}

type Step = {
  kind: 'tools';
  calls: { name: string; args: any }[];
  percent: number;
};

class FakeApi {
  constructor(private who: string, private script: Step[]) {}
  private idx = 0;
  async newChat(): Promise<void> { /* no-op */ }
  async chat(): Promise<AssistantResponse> {
    if (this.idx >= this.script.length) {
      throw new Error(`FakeApi(${this.who}): script exhausted`);
    }
    const s = this.script[this.idx++];
    const context_status: ContextStatus = {
      chars_used: s.percent * 24000,
      chars_limit: 2_400_000,
      percent_used: s.percent,
      language_coefficient: 2.4,
      warning: null,
      recommendation: null
    };
    return {
      text: '',
      tool_calls: s.calls.map((c, i) => ({
        id: `call_${this.idx}_${i}`,
        name: c.name as any,
        args: c.args
      })) as any,
      context_status,
      raw: {}
    };
  }
}

class FakeExecutor {
  async run(call_id: string, script: string): Promise<ExecResult> {
    return {
      call_id, command: 'noop', exit_code: 0, duration_ms: 1,
      stdout: 'ok\n', stderr: '',
      stdout_truncated: false, stderr_truncated: false
    };
  }
}

function mkLog(cwd: string): Logger {
  return new Logger(cwd, { appendLine: () => { /* silent */ } });
}

async function runOrch(
  cwd: string,
  apiE: FakeApi,
  apiC: FakeApi
): Promise<void> {
  const log = mkLog(cwd);
  const orch = new Orchestrator(
    apiE as unknown as ApiClient,
    apiC as unknown as ApiClient,
    new FakeExecutor() as unknown as Executor,
    new NullPanel(),
    log,
    {
      cwd, name: 'probe-context-transition', task: 'stub',
      deadlineAt: Date.now() + 30_000,
      executorPrompt: 'E', criticPrompt: 'C'
    }
  );
  await orch.run();
  log.close();
  await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 200));
}

async function t1_transition_detected(): Promise<void> {
  console.log('\nT1: 88% → 3% triggers one transition event');

  const cwd = freshTmp('probe-transition-t1');
  fs.mkdirSync(path.join(cwd, '.pingis'), { recursive: true });
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(cwd, '.pingis', 'plan.md'), '# Plan\n');

  const apiE = new FakeApi('executor', [
    { kind: 'tools',
      calls: [{ name: 'execute', args: { script: 'print(1)' } }],
      percent: 88 },
    { kind: 'tools',
      calls: [{ name: 'execute', args: { script: 'print(2)' } }],
      percent: 3 },
    { kind: 'tools',
      calls: [{ name: 'send_message',
                args: { to: 'critic', message: 'ALL DONE: ok' } }],
      percent: 5 }
  ]);
  const apiC = new FakeApi('critic', [
    { kind: 'tools',
      calls: [{ name: 'finalize', args: { comment: 'done' } }],
      percent: 4 }
  ]);

  await runOrch(cwd, apiE, apiC);
  const lines = readLog(cwd);

  const transitions = lines.filter(
    e => e.event === 'context_transition' && e.who === 'executor'
  );

  check(transitions.length === 1,
    `exactly one transition detected (got ${transitions.length})`);
  if (transitions.length === 1) {
    const t = transitions[0];
    check(t.from_percent === 88,
      `from_percent = ${t.from_percent} (expected 88)`);
    check(t.to_percent === 3,
      `to_percent = ${t.to_percent} (expected 3)`);
  }

  const criticTransitions = lines.filter(
    e => e.event === 'context_transition' && e.who === 'critic'
  );
  check(criticTransitions.length === 0,
    `no transition for critic on its first response (got ${criticTransitions.length})`);
}

  }

===== FILE: scripts/probe-continuation-nudge.ts =====
/**
 * Unit test for step 62 — continuation nudge repeats until check-in.
 *
 * T1. plan.md present, Executor sends RESUME on its first response.
 *     Nudge fires exactly once. Second Executor step has no prefix.
 * T2. plan.md present, Executor ignores the hint and does five
 *     executes in a row before finally sending a message. Nudge
 *     fires on the first three steps (cap = 3), then no more.
 * T3. plan.md absent — no nudge ever.
 *
 * Run:
 *   npx ts-node --project scripts/tsconfig.json scripts/probe-continuation-nudge.ts
 */

import * as fs from 'fs';
import * as os from 'os';
import * as path from 'path';
import { ApiClient } from '../src/api';
import { Executor } from '../src/executor';
import { Logger } from '../src/log';
import { NullPanel, Orchestrator } from '../src/orchestrator';
import { AssistantResponse, ExecResult } from '../src/types';

let failures = 0;

function check(condition: boolean, label: string): void {
  if (condition) {
    console.log(`  ✓ ${label}`);
  } else {
    console.error(`  ✗ ${label}`);
    failures++;
  }
}

function freshTmp(name: string): string {
  const p = path.join(os.tmpdir(),
    `${name}-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8)}`);
  fs.mkdirSync(p, { recursive: true });
  return p;
}

type Step =
  | { kind: 'execute' }
  | { kind: 'tools'; calls: { name: string; args: any }[] };

class FakeApi {
  public receivedContents: string[] = [];
  constructor(private who: string, private script: Step[]) {}
  private idx = 0;
  async newChat(): Promise<void> { /* no-op */ }
  async chat(_session: unknown, msg: { content: string }): Promise<AssistantResponse> {
    this.receivedContents.push(msg.content);
    if (this.idx >= this.script.length) {
      throw new Error(`FakeApi(${this.who}): script exhausted`);
    }
    const s = this.script[this.idx++];
    if (s.kind === 'execute') {
      return {
        text: '',
        tool_calls: [{
          id: `call_${this.idx}`,
          name: 'execute',
          args: { script: 'print(1)' }
        } as any],
        raw: {}
      };
    }
    return {
      text: '',
      tool_calls: s.calls.map((c, i) => ({
        id: `call_${this.idx}_${i}`,
        name: c.name as any,
        args: c.args
      })) as any,
      raw: {}
    };
  }
}

class FakeExecutor {
  async run(call_id: string, script: string): Promise<ExecResult> {
    return {
      call_id, command: 'noop', exit_code: 0, duration_ms: 1,
      stdout: 'ok\n', stderr: '',
      stdout_truncated: false, stderr_truncated: false
    };
  }
}

function mkLog(cwd: string): Logger {
  return new Logger(cwd, { appendLine: () => { /* silent */ } });
}

async function runOrch(
  cwd: string,
  apiE: FakeApi,
  apiC: FakeApi
): Promise<void> {
  const log = mkLog(cwd);
  const orch = new Orchestrator(
    apiE as unknown as ApiClient,
    apiC as unknown as ApiClient,
    new FakeExecutor() as unknown as Executor,
    new NullPanel(),
    log,
    {
      cwd, name: 'probe-continuation-nudge', task: 'stub',
      deadlineAt: Date.now() + 60_000,
      executorPrompt: 'E', criticPrompt: 'C'
    }
  );
  await orch.run();
  log.close();
  await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 200));
}

function readLog(cwd: string): any[] {
  const logPath = path.join(cwd, '.pingis', 'session.log');
  if (!fs.existsSync(logPath)) return [];
  return fs.readFileSync(logPath, 'utf-8')
    .split('\n').filter(Boolean).map(l => JSON.parse(l));
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

async function t1_stops_after_first_check_in(): Promise<void> {
  console.log('\nT1: Executor sends RESUME first → 1 nudge');

  const cwd = freshTmp('probe-cont-t1');
  fs.mkdirSync(path.join(cwd, '.pingis'), { recursive: true });
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(cwd, '.pingis', 'plan.md'),
    '# Plan\n- [ ] 5. do a thing\n');

  const apiE = new FakeApi('executor', [
    { kind: 'tools',
      calls: [{ name: 'send_message',
                args: { to: 'critic',
                        message: 'RESUME: continuing from stage 5.' } }] },
    { kind: 'tools',
      calls: [{ name: 'send_message',
                args: { to: 'critic', message: 'ALL DONE: ok' } }] }
  ]);
  const apiC = new FakeApi('critic', [
    { kind: 'tools',
      calls: [{ name: 'send_message',
                args: { to: 'executor', message: 'APPROVE_PLAN' } }] },
    { kind: 'tools',
      calls: [{ name: 'finalize', args: { comment: 'done' } }] }
  ]);

  await runOrch(cwd, apiE, apiC);
  const lines = readLog(cwd);

  const nudges = lines.filter(e => e.event === 'continuation_nudge');
  check(nudges.length === 1,
    `exactly one continuation_nudge (got ${nudges.length})`);
  if (nudges.length === 1) {
    check(nudges[0].attempt === 1,
      `attempt = ${nudges[0].attempt} (expected 1)`);
  }

  const prefixed = apiE.receivedContents.filter(
    c => c.startsWith('[CONTINUATION]')
  );
  check(prefixed.length === 1,
    `exactly one executor request has [CONTINUATION] (got ${prefixed.length})`);
  if (apiE.receivedContents.length >= 2) {
    check(!apiE.receivedContents[1].startsWith('[CONTINUATION]'),
      'second executor request has no prefix');
  }
}

async function t2_repeats_until_cap(): Promise<void> {
  console.log('\nT2: Executor ignores hint → 3 nudges, then stops');

  const cwd = freshTmp('probe-cont-t2');
  fs.mkdirSync(path.join(cwd, '.pingis'), { recursive: true });
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(cwd, '.pingis', 'plan.md'),
    '# Plan\n- [ ] 5. do a thing\n');

  const apiE = new FakeApi('executor', [
    { kind: 'execute' },
    { kind: 'execute' },
    { kind: 'execute' },
    { kind: 'execute' },
    { kind: 'execute' },
    { kind: 'tools',
      calls: [{ name: 'send_message',
                args: { to: 'critic', message: 'ALL DONE: ok' } }] }
  ]);
  const apiC = new FakeApi('critic', [
    { kind: 'tools',
      calls: [{ name: 'finalize', args: { comment: 'done' } }] }
  ]);

  await runOrch(cwd, apiE, apiC);
  const lines = readLog(cwd);

  const nudges = lines.filter(e => e.event === 'continuation_nudge');
  check(nudges.length === 3,
    `exactly three continuation_nudge (got ${nudges.length})`);
  if (nudges.length === 3) {
    const attempts = nudges.map((n: any) => n.attempt);
    check(attempts[0] === 1 && attempts[1] === 2 && attempts[2] === 3,
      `attempts = ${attempts.join(',')} (expected 1,2,3)`);
  }

  const prefixed = apiE.receivedContents.filter(
    c => c.startsWith('[CONTINUATION]')
  );
  check(prefixed.length === 3,
    `exactly three executor requests have [CONTINUATION] (got ${prefixed.length})`);

  // Executor received 6 requests in total.
  if (apiE.receivedContents.length >= 5) {
    check(!apiE.receivedContents[3].startsWith('[CONTINUATION]'),
      'fourth executor request has no prefix (cap reached)');
    check(!apiE.receivedContents[4].startsWith('[CONTINUATION]'),
      'fifth executor request has no prefix (cap reached)');
  }
}

async function t3_no_plan_no_nudge(): Promise<void> {
  console.log('\nT3: plan.md absent → no nudge');

  const cwd = freshTmp('probe-cont-t3');
  fs.mkdirSync(path.join(cwd, '.pingis'), { recursive: true });

  const apiE = new FakeApi('executor', [
    { kind: 'execute' },
    { kind: 'tools',
      calls: [{ name: 'send_message',
                args: { to: 'critic', message: 'ALL DONE: ok' } }] }
  ]);
  const apiC = new FakeApi('critic', [
    { kind: 'tools',
      calls: [{ name: 'finalize', args: { comment: 'done' } }] }
  ]);

  await runOrch(cwd, apiE, apiC);
  const lines = readLog(cwd);

  const nudges = lines.filter(e => e.event === 'continuation_nudge');
  check(nudges.length === 0,
    `no continuation_nudge (got ${nudges.length})`);

  const prefixed = apiE.receivedContents.filter(
    c => c.startsWith('[CONTINUATION]')
  );
  check(prefixed.length === 0,
    `no executor request has [CONTINUATION] (got ${prefixed.length})`);
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

async function main(): Promise<void> {
  await t1_stops_after_first_check_in();
  await t2_repeats_until_cap();
  await t3_no_plan_no_nudge();

  console.log();
  if (failures === 0) {
    console.log('=== SUCCESS: continuation nudge repeat works ===');
    process.exit(0);
  } else {
    console.log(`=== FAILURE: ${failures} check(s) failed ===`);
    process.exit(1);
  }
}

  console.error('CRASH:', e);
  process.exit(2);

/**
 * Unit test for step 65 — fallback summary on any stop reason.
 *
 * T1. network_error (StopError raised from api.chat) → summary.md
 *     written even though network_error is not in the "usual" list.
 * T2. unknown_tool (executor tries to call finalize) → summary.md
 *     written.
 * T3. The Critic's own summary is never overwritten: a fake Critic
 *     writes summary.md before finalize; orchestrator must not touch
 *     it.
 *
 * Run:
 *   npx ts-node --project scripts/tsconfig.json scripts/probe-fallback-summary.ts
 */

import * as fs from 'fs';
import * as os from 'os';
import * as path from 'path';
import { ApiClient } from '../src/api';
import { Executor } from '../src/executor';
import { Logger } from '../src/log';
import { NullPanel, Orchestrator } from '../src/orchestrator';
import { AssistantResponse, ExecResult, StopError } from '../src/types';

let failures = 0;

function check(condition: boolean, label: string): void {
  if (condition) {
    console.log(`  ✓ ${label}`);
  } else {
    console.error(`  ✗ ${label}`);
    failures++;
  }
}

function freshTmp(name: string): string {
  const p = path.join(os.tmpdir(),
    `${name}-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8)}`);
  fs.mkdirSync(p, { recursive: true });
  return p;
}

type Step =
  | { kind: 'throw_stop'; reason: string }
  | { kind: 'tools'; calls: { name: string; args: any }[] };

class FakeApi {
  constructor(private who: string, private script: Step[]) {}
  private idx = 0;
  async newChat(): Promise<void> { /* no-op */ }
  async chat(): Promise<AssistantResponse> {
    if (this.idx >= this.script.length) {
      throw new Error(`FakeApi(${this.who}): script exhausted`);
    }
    const s = this.script[this.idx++];
    if (s.kind === 'throw_stop') {
      throw new StopError(s.reason as any, 'simulated');
    }
    return {
      text: '',
      tool_calls: s.calls.map((c, i) => ({
        id: `call_${this.idx}_${i}`,
        name: c.name as any,
        args: c.args
      })) as any,
      raw: {}
    };
  }
}

class FakeExecutor {
  constructor(private cwd: string) {}

  async run(call_id: string, script: string): Promise<ExecResult> {
    // In real use, the Critic writes .pingis/summary.md via execute.
    // When the fake script mentions summary.md, simulate that write
    // so probes can verify the orchestrator leaves the file alone.
    if (script.includes('summary.md')) {
      const dir = path.join(this.cwd, '.pingis');
      fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
      fs.writeFileSync(
        path.join(dir, 'summary.md'),
        '# Task summary\n\nCritic-authored content. Do not touch.\n'
      );
    }
    return {
      call_id, command: 'noop', exit_code: 0, duration_ms: 1,
      stdout: 'ok\n', stderr: '',
      stdout_truncated: false, stderr_truncated: false
    };
  }
}

function mkLog(cwd: string): Logger {
  return new Logger(cwd, { appendLine: () => { /* silent */ } });
}

async function runOrch(
  cwd: string,
  apiE: FakeApi,
  apiC: FakeApi
): Promise<void> {
  const log = mkLog(cwd);
  const orch = new Orchestrator(
    apiE as unknown as ApiClient,
    apiC as unknown as ApiClient,
    new FakeExecutor(cwd) as unknown as Executor,
    new NullPanel(),
    log,
    {
      cwd, name: 'probe-fallback-summary', task: 'stub',
      deadlineAt: Date.now() + 30_000,
      executorPrompt: 'E', criticPrompt: 'C'
    }
  );
  await orch.run();
  log.close();
  await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 200));
}

function readLog(cwd: string): any[] {
  const logPath = path.join(cwd, '.pingis', 'session.log');
  if (!fs.existsSync(logPath)) return [];
  return fs.readFileSync(logPath, 'utf-8')
    .split('\n').filter(Boolean).map(l => JSON.parse(l));
}

async function t1_network_error(): Promise<void> {
  console.log('\nT1: network_error → summary written');

  const cwd = freshTmp('probe-fallback-t1');
  fs.mkdirSync(path.join(cwd, '.pingis'), { recursive: true });
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(cwd, '.pingis', 'plan.md'),
    '# Plan\nreal content\n');

  const apiE = new FakeApi('executor', [
    { kind: 'throw_stop', reason: 'network_error' }
  ]);
  const apiC = new FakeApi('critic', []);

  await runOrch(cwd, apiE, apiC);
  const lines = readLog(cwd);

  const stop = lines.find(e => e.event === 'stop');
  const summary = path.join(cwd, '.pingis', 'summary.md');
  const plan = path.join(cwd, '.pingis', 'plan.md');

  check(stop?.reason === 'network_error',
    `stop reason = ${stop?.reason} (expected network_error)`);
  check(fs.existsSync(summary),
    'summary.md written even for network_error');
  check(fs.existsSync(plan),
    'plan.md preserved (graceful shutdown keeps it)');
}

async function t2_unknown_tool(): Promise<void> {
  console.log('\nT2: unknown_tool (executor calls finalize) → summary written');

  const cwd = freshTmp('probe-fallback-t2');

  const apiE = new FakeApi('executor', [
    { kind: 'tools',
      calls: [{ name: 'finalize', args: { comment: 'not mine' } }] }
  ]);
  const apiC = new FakeApi('critic', []);

  await runOrch(cwd, apiE, apiC);
  const lines = readLog(cwd);

  const stop = lines.find(e => e.event === 'stop');
  const summary = path.join(cwd, '.pingis', 'summary.md');

  check(stop?.reason === 'unknown_tool',
    `stop reason = ${stop?.reason} (expected unknown_tool)`);
  check(fs.existsSync(summary),
    'summary.md written even for unknown_tool');
}

async function t3_critic_summary_untouched(): Promise<void> {
  console.log('\nT3: Critic writes its own summary → orchestrator leaves it');

  const cwd = freshTmp('probe-fallback-t3');
  fs.mkdirSync(path.join(cwd, '.pingis'), { recursive: true });

  // Executor: ALL DONE. Critic: execute that writes summary.md
  // (FakeExecutor simulates the write when the script mentions
  // summary.md), then finalize. The orchestrator must leave the
  // file untouched.
  const apiE = new FakeApi('executor', [
    { kind: 'tools',
      calls: [{ name: 'send_message',
                args: { to: 'critic', message: 'ALL DONE: ok' } }] }
  ]);
  const apiC = new FakeApi('critic', [
    { kind: 'tools',
      calls: [{ name: 'execute',
                args: { script: 'print("write .pingis/summary.md")' } }] },
    { kind: 'tools',
      calls: [{ name: 'finalize', args: { comment: 'done' } }] }
  ]);

  await runOrch(cwd, apiE, apiC);

  const summary = path.join(cwd, '.pingis', 'summary.md');
  const text = fs.readFileSync(summary, 'utf-8');
  check(text.includes('Critic-authored content'),
    'critic summary not overwritten');
  check(!text.includes('fallback'),
    'fallback marker absent');
}

async function t4_stale_summary_cleared(): Promise<void> {
  console.log('\nT4: stale summary.md is cleared at task start');

  const cwd = freshTmp('probe-fallback-t4');
  fs.mkdirSync(path.join(cwd, '.pingis'), { recursive: true });
  // A stale summary from a previous task. It must not survive.
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(cwd, '.pingis', 'summary.md'),
    '# Stale summary from a previous task. Must not survive.\n');

  const apiE = new FakeApi('executor', [
    { kind: 'throw_stop', reason: 'network_error' }
  ]);
  const apiC = new FakeApi('critic', []);

  await runOrch(cwd, apiE, apiC);
  const lines = readLog(cwd);

  const reset = lines.find(
    e => e.event === 'artifact'
      && e.action === 'reset'
      && e.kind === 'summary'
  );
  const summary = path.join(cwd, '.pingis', 'summary.md');

  check(!!reset, 'artifact reset summary event logged');
  check(fs.existsSync(summary),
    'summary.md exists after run (fallback wrote it)');
  if (fs.existsSync(summary)) {
    const content = fs.readFileSync(summary, 'utf-8');
    check(!content.includes('Stale summary'),
      'old content gone');
    check(content.includes('fallback'),
      'fallback content present');
  }
}

    console.log(`=== FAILURE: ${failures} check(s) failed ===`);

===== FILE: scripts/probe-format-budget.ts =====
/**
 * Unit test for step 51c — format-HELP budget.
 *
 * Scenario: the Executor returns garbage on every request. After
 * MAX_FORMAT_ROUNDS full rounds (5 × L1a+L1b+L3 = 15 attempts), the
 * next unparseable response stops the task with 'protocol_violation'.
 *
 * Expected sequence per round:
 *   broken → L1a (retry 1)
 *   broken → L1b (retry 2)
 *   broken → L3 (orchestrator HELP, round++)
 *
 * After 5 rounds, the next broken response triggers the budget guard
 * on the way to L1a and stops the task.
 *
 * Run:
 *   npx ts-node --project scripts/tsconfig.json scripts/probe-format-budget.ts
 */

import * as fs from 'fs';
import * as os from 'os';
import * as path from 'path';
import { ApiClient } from '../src/api';
import { Executor } from '../src/executor';
import { Logger } from '../src/log';
import { NullPanel, Orchestrator } from '../src/orchestrator';
import { AssistantResponse, ExecResult } from '../src/types';

let failures = 0;

function check(condition: boolean, label: string): void {
  if (condition) {
    console.log(`  ✓ ${label}`);
  } else {
    console.error(`  ✗ ${label}`);
    failures++;
  }
}

function freshTmp(name: string): string {
  const p = path.join(os.tmpdir(),
    `${name}-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8)}`);
  fs.mkdirSync(p, { recursive: true });
  return p;
}

type Step =
  | { kind: 'broken'; text: string }
  | { kind: 'tools'; calls: { name: string; args: any }[] };

class FakeApi {
  constructor(private who: string, private script: Step[]) {}
  private idx = 0;
  async newChat(): Promise<void> { /* no-op */ }
  async chat(): Promise<AssistantResponse> {
    if (this.idx >= this.script.length) {
      // Return a plain broken response rather than throwing, so that
      // a runaway loop does not crash the probe with an "exhausted"
      // error — it just keeps failing.
      return { text: 'runaway loop', tool_calls: [], raw: {} };
    }
    const s = this.script[this.idx++];
    if (s.kind === 'broken') {
      return { text: s.text, tool_calls: [], raw: {} };
    }
    return {
      text: '',
      tool_calls: s.calls.map((c, i) => ({
        id: `call_${this.idx}_${i}`,
        name: c.name as any,
        args: c.args
      })) as any,
      raw: {}
    };
  }
}

class FakeExecutor {
  async run(call_id: string, script: string): Promise<ExecResult> {
    return {
      call_id, command: 'noop', exit_code: 0, duration_ms: 1,
      stdout: 'ok\n', stderr: '',
      stdout_truncated: false, stderr_truncated: false
    };
  }
}

function mkLog(cwd: string): Logger {
  return new Logger(cwd, { appendLine: () => { /* silent */ } });
}

async function runOrch(
  cwd: string,
  apiE: FakeApi,
  apiC: FakeApi
): Promise<void> {
  const log = mkLog(cwd);
  const orch = new Orchestrator(
    apiE as unknown as ApiClient,
    apiC as unknown as ApiClient,
    new FakeExecutor() as unknown as Executor,
    new NullPanel(),
    log,
    {
      cwd, name: 'probe-format-budget', task: 'stub',
      deadlineAt: Date.now() + 60_000,
      executorPrompt: 'E', criticPrompt: 'C'
    }
  );
  await orch.run();
  log.close();
  await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 200));
}

function readLog(cwd: string): any[] {
  const logPath = path.join(cwd, '.pingis', 'session.log');
  if (!fs.existsSync(logPath)) return [];
  return fs.readFileSync(logPath, 'utf-8')
    .split('\n').filter(Boolean).map(l => JSON.parse(l));
}

async function t1_budget_exhausted(): Promise<void> {
  console.log('\nT1: 5 rounds × 3 broken → protocol_violation');

  const cwd = freshTmp('probe-format-budget-t1');
  fs.mkdirSync(path.join(cwd, '.pingis'), { recursive: true });
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(cwd, '.pingis', 'plan.md'), '# Plan\n');

  // Executor: 5 rounds × 3 broken = 15 broken, then one more to trigger
  // the budget guard. Extra broken responses are harmless.
  const brokenRounds: Step[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < 16; i++) {
    brokenRounds.push({ kind: 'broken', text: `garbage #${i + 1}` });
  }
  const apiE = new FakeApi('executor', brokenRounds);

  // Critic: 5 HELP_RESPONSE replies (one per round). The sixth is never
  // requested, but keep a few extras to avoid a script-exhaustion crash
  // if the loop runs away.
  const criticSteps: Step[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
    criticSteps.push({
      kind: 'tools',
      calls: [{ name: 'send_message',
                args: { to: 'executor',
                        message: `HELP_RESPONSE: try again #${i + 1}` } }]
    });
  }
  const apiC = new FakeApi('critic', criticSteps);

  await runOrch(cwd, apiE, apiC);
  const lines = readLog(cwd);

  const orchHelp = lines.filter(
    e => e.event === 'help' && e.initiator === 'orchestrator'
  );
  const budget = lines.find(
    e => e.event === 'error' && e.code === 'format_budget_exhausted'
  );
  const stop = lines.find(e => e.event === 'stop');

  check(orchHelp.length === 5,
    `orchestrator HELP fired exactly 5 times (got ${orchHelp.length})`);
  check(!!budget, 'format_budget_exhausted event logged');
  check(budget?.rounds === 5,
    `budget event reports 5 rounds (got ${budget?.rounds})`);
  check(stop?.reason === 'protocol_violation',
    `stop reason = ${stop?.reason} (expected protocol_violation)`);
}

async function main(): Promise<void> {
  await t1_budget_exhausted();

  console.log();
  if (failures === 0) {
    console.log('=== SUCCESS: format-HELP budget works ===');
    process.exit(0);
  } else {
    console.log(`=== FAILURE: ${failures} check(s) failed ===`);
    process.exit(1);
  }
}

main().catch(e => {
  console.error('CRASH:', e);
  process.exit(2);
});

===== FILE: scripts/probe-help-protocol.ts =====
/**
 * Unit test for the unified HELP protocol.
 *
 * T1. Broken JSON with a valid "message" is salvaged. Dialog continues.
 * T2. Three garbage attempts in a row → orchestrator HELP, no
 *     protocol_violation stop. IMPOSSIBLE from the other agent ends
 *     the task with reason deadlock.
 * T3. HELP → HELP_RESPONSE → SOLVED → done.
 * T4. IMPOSSIBLE from Executor → stop('deadlock'); plan preserved.
 * T5. Help loop across two full rounds — orchestrator HELP fires
 *     more than once; the task ends with IMPOSSIBLE, not with a
 *     hard stop.
 *
 * Run:
 *   npx ts-node --project scripts/tsconfig.json scripts/probe-help-protocol.ts
 */

import * as fs from 'fs';
import * as os from 'os';
import * as path from 'path';
import { ApiClient } from '../src/api';
import { Executor } from '../src/executor';
import { Logger } from '../src/log';
import { NullPanel, Orchestrator } from '../src/orchestrator';
import { AssistantResponse, ExecResult } from '../src/types';

let failures = 0;

function check(condition: boolean, label: string): void {
  if (condition) {
    console.log(`  \u2713 ${label}`);
  } else {
    console.error(`  \u2717 ${label}`);
    failures++;
  }
}

function freshTmp(name: string): string {
  const p = path.join(os.tmpdir(),
    `${name}-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8)}`);
  fs.mkdirSync(p, { recursive: true });
  return p;
}

type Step =
  | { kind: 'broken'; text: string }
  | { kind: 'tools'; calls: { name: string; args: any }[] };

class FakeApi {
  public newChatCalls = 0;
  constructor(private who: string, private script: Step[]) {}
  private idx = 0;
  async newChat(): Promise<void> { this.newChatCalls++; }
  async chat(): Promise<AssistantResponse> {
    if (this.idx >= this.script.length) {
      throw new Error(`FakeApi(${this.who}): script exhausted`);
    }
    const s = this.script[this.idx++];
    if (s.kind === 'broken') {
      return { text: s.text, tool_calls: [], raw: {} };
    }
    return {
      text: '',
      tool_calls: s.calls.map((c, i) => ({
        id: `call_${this.idx}_${i}`,
        name: c.name as any,
        args: c.args
      })) as any,
      raw: {}
    };
  }
}

class FakeExecutor {
  async run(call_id: string, script: string): Promise<ExecResult> {
    return {
      call_id, command: 'noop', exit_code: 0, duration_ms: 1,
      stdout: 'ok\n', stderr: '',
      stdout_truncated: false, stderr_truncated: false
    };
  }
}

function mkLog(cwd: string): Logger {
  return new Logger(cwd, { appendLine: () => { /* silent */ } });
}

async function runOrch(
  cwd: string,
  apiE: FakeApi,
  apiC: FakeApi,
  task = 'stub'
): Promise<void> {
  const log = mkLog(cwd);
  const orch = new Orchestrator(
    apiE as unknown as ApiClient,
    apiC as unknown as ApiClient,
    new FakeExecutor() as unknown as Executor,
    new NullPanel(),
    log,
    {
      cwd, name: 'probe-help-protocol', task,
      deadlineAt: Date.now() + 30_000,
      executorPrompt: 'E', criticPrompt: 'C'
    }
  );
  await orch.run();
  log.close();
  await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 200));
}

function readLog(cwd: string): any[] {
  const logPath = path.join(cwd, '.pingis', 'session.log');
  if (!fs.existsSync(logPath)) return [];
  return fs.readFileSync(logPath, 'utf-8')
    .split('\n').filter(Boolean).map(l => JSON.parse(l));
}

async function t1_salvage_from_broken_message(): Promise<void> {
  console.log('\nT1: broken JSON with valid "message" is salvaged');

  const cwd = freshTmp('probe-hp-t1');
  fs.mkdirSync(path.join(cwd, '.pingis'), { recursive: true });
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(cwd, '.pingis', 'plan.md'), '# Plan\n');

  const brokenJson =
    '{"tool_calls":[{"name":"send_message","arguments":' +
    '{"to":"critic","message":"APPROVE_PLAN"';

  const apiE = new FakeApi('executor', [
    { kind: 'broken', text: brokenJson }
  ]);
  const apiC = new FakeApi('critic', [
    { kind: 'tools', calls: [{ name: 'execute', args: { script: 'print(1)' } }] },
    { kind: 'tools', calls: [{ name: 'finalize', args: { comment: 'ok' } }] }
  ]);

  await runOrch(cwd, apiE, apiC);
  const lines = readLog(cwd);

  const salvaged = lines.find(
    e => e.event === 'response' && e.salvaged === true
      && e.kind === 'message_extracted'
  );
  const routed = lines.find(
    e => e.event === 'route' && e.from === 'executor' && e.to === 'critic'
      && typeof e.message === 'string' && e.message.includes('APPROVE_PLAN')
  );
  const stop = lines.find(e => e.event === 'stop');

  check(!!salvaged, 'message_extracted salvage event present');
  check(!!routed, 'APPROVE_PLAN routed to critic');
  check(stop?.reason === 'done', `stop reason = ${stop?.reason} (expected done)`);
}

async function t2_garbage_escalates_to_help(): Promise<void> {
  console.log('\nT2: three garbage attempts → HELP, then IMPOSSIBLE');

  const cwd = freshTmp('probe-hp-t2');
  fs.mkdirSync(path.join(cwd, '.pingis'), { recursive: true });
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(cwd, '.pingis', 'plan.md'), '# Plan\n');

  const apiE = new FakeApi('executor', [
    { kind: 'broken', text: 'not json at all' },
    { kind: 'broken', text: 'still garbage' },
    { kind: 'broken', text: 'garbage again' },
    { kind: 'tools', calls: [{ name: 'send_message',
        args: { to: 'critic', message: 'IMPOSSIBLE: cannot reformat' } }] }
  ]);
  const apiC = new FakeApi('critic', [
    { kind: 'tools', calls: [{ name: 'send_message',
        args: { to: 'executor', message: 'HELP_RESPONSE: try shorter' } }] }
  ]);

  await runOrch(cwd, apiE, apiC);
  const lines = readLog(cwd);

  const retry1 = lines.find(
    e => e.event === 'error' && e.code === 'no_tool_calls' && e.retry === 1
  );
  const retry2 = lines.find(
    e => e.event === 'error' && e.code === 'no_tool_calls' && e.retry === 2
  );
  const orchHelp = lines.find(
    e => e.event === 'help' && e.initiator === 'orchestrator'
  );
  const stop = lines.find(e => e.event === 'stop');

  check(!!retry1, 'retry 1 (L1a) logged');
  check(!!retry2, 'retry 2 (L1b) logged');
  check(!!orchHelp, 'orchestrator-initiated HELP logged');
  check(stop?.reason !== 'protocol_violation',
    `stop reason = ${stop?.reason} (must not be protocol_violation)`);
  check(stop?.reason === 'gave_up',
    `stop reason = ${stop?.reason} (expected gave_up from IMPOSSIBLE)`);
}

async function t3_help_loop_and_solved(): Promise<void> {
  console.log('\nT3: HELP → HELP_RESPONSE → SOLVED → done');

  const cwd = freshTmp('probe-hp-t3');
  fs.mkdirSync(path.join(cwd, '.pingis'), { recursive: true });
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(cwd, '.pingis', 'plan.md'), '# Plan\n');

  const apiE = new FakeApi('executor', [
    { kind: 'tools', calls: [{ name: 'send_message',
        args: { to: 'critic', message: 'HELP:\nProblem: x\nTried: y' } }] },
    { kind: 'tools', calls: [{ name: 'send_message',
        args: { to: 'critic', message: 'SOLVED: it worked' } }] },
    { kind: 'tools', calls: [{ name: 'send_message',
        args: { to: 'critic', message: 'ALL DONE: ok' } }] }
  ]);
  const apiC = new FakeApi('critic', [
    { kind: 'tools', calls: [{ name: 'execute', args: { script: 'print(1)' } }] },
    { kind: 'tools', calls: [{ name: 'send_message',
        args: { to: 'executor', message: 'HELP_RESPONSE: try X' } }] },
    { kind: 'tools', calls: [{ name: 'finalize', args: { comment: 'ok' } }] }
  ]);

  await runOrch(cwd, apiE, apiC);
  const lines = readLog(cwd);

  const helpSent = lines.find(
    e => e.event === 'help' && e.phase === 'HELP'
  );
  const helpResp = lines.find(
    e => e.event === 'help' && e.phase === 'HELP_RESPONSE'
  );
  const solved = lines.find(
    e => e.event === 'help' && e.phase === 'SOLVED'
  );
  const stop = lines.find(e => e.event === 'stop');

  check(!!helpSent, 'HELP event logged');
  check(!!helpResp, 'HELP_RESPONSE event logged');
  check(!!solved, 'SOLVED event logged');
  check(stop?.reason === 'done', `stop reason = ${stop?.reason} (expected done)`);
}

async function t4_impossible_stops_task(): Promise<void> {
  console.log('\nT4: IMPOSSIBLE → deadlock, plan preserved');

  const cwd = freshTmp('probe-hp-t4');
  fs.mkdirSync(path.join(cwd, '.pingis'), { recursive: true });
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(cwd, '.pingis', 'plan.md'), '# Plan\nreal content\n');

  const apiE = new FakeApi('executor', [
    { kind: 'tools', calls: [{ name: 'send_message',
        args: { to: 'critic', message: 'IMPOSSIBLE: cannot solve' } }] }
  ]);
  const apiC = new FakeApi('critic', []);

  await runOrch(cwd, apiE, apiC);
  const lines = readLog(cwd);

  const stop = lines.find(e => e.event === 'stop');
  const summary = path.join(cwd, '.pingis', 'summary.md');
  const plan = path.join(cwd, '.pingis', 'plan.md');

  check(stop?.reason === 'gave_up',
    `stop reason = ${stop?.reason} (expected gave_up)`);
  check(fs.existsSync(summary), 'fallback summary written');
  check(fs.existsSync(plan), 'plan.md preserved (graceful shutdown)');
}

async function t5_help_loop_no_stop(): Promise<void> {
  console.log('\nT5: two full HELP rounds, then IMPOSSIBLE — no hard stop');

  const cwd = freshTmp('probe-hp-t5');
  fs.mkdirSync(path.join(cwd, '.pingis'), { recursive: true });
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(cwd, '.pingis', 'plan.md'), '# Plan\n');

  const apiE = new FakeApi('executor', [
    { kind: 'broken', text: 'r1 garbage a' },
    { kind: 'broken', text: 'r1 garbage b' },
    { kind: 'broken', text: 'r1 garbage c' },
    { kind: 'broken', text: 'r2 garbage a' },
    { kind: 'broken', text: 'r2 garbage b' },
    { kind: 'broken', text: 'r2 garbage c' },
    { kind: 'tools', calls: [{ name: 'send_message',
        args: { to: 'critic', message: 'IMPOSSIBLE: endless format failure' } }] }
  ]);
  const apiC = new FakeApi('critic', [
    { kind: 'tools', calls: [{ name: 'send_message',
        args: { to: 'executor', message: 'HELP_RESPONSE: try a smaller reply' } }] },
    { kind: 'tools', calls: [{ name: 'send_message',
        args: { to: 'executor', message: 'HELP_RESPONSE: split into two calls' } }] }
  ]);

  await runOrch(cwd, apiE, apiC);
  const lines = readLog(cwd);

  const helpEvents = lines.filter(
    e => e.event === 'help' && e.initiator === 'orchestrator'
  );
  const stop = lines.find(e => e.event === 'stop');

  check(helpEvents.length >= 2,
    `orchestrator HELP fired ${helpEvents.length} time(s) (>= 2)`);
  check(stop?.reason === 'gave_up',
    `stop reason = ${stop?.reason} (expected gave_up)`);
  check(stop?.reason !== 'protocol_violation',
    'stop reason is not protocol_violation');
}

async function main(): Promise<void> {
  await t1_salvage_from_broken_message();

  await t3_help_loop_and_solved();

  console.log();

    console.log('=== SUCCESS: HELP protocol works ===');
    process.exit(0);
  } else {
    console.log(`=== FAILURE: ${failures} check(s) failed ===`);
    process.exit(1);
  }
}

===== FILE: scripts/probe-help.ts =====
/**
 * Unit test for the HELP protocol.
 *
 * Mocks ApiClient and Executor. No real API servers needed.
 * Checks:
 *   1. Executor sends HELP: -> Critic receives it.
 *   2. Critic replies HELP_RESPONSE: -> Executor receives it.
 *   3. Executor eventually sends ALL DONE -> Critic finalizes.
 *   4. stop reason=done.
 *
 * Run:
 *   npx ts-node --project scripts/tsconfig.json scripts/probe-help.ts
 */

import * as fs from 'fs';
import * as os from 'os';
import * as path from 'path';
import { ApiClient } from '../src/api';
import { Executor } from '../src/executor';
import { Logger } from '../src/log';
import { NullPanel, Orchestrator } from '../src/orchestrator';
import { AssistantResponse, ExecResult } from '../src/types';

const TMP = path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'probe-help-' + Date.now());
fs.mkdirSync(TMP, { recursive: true });
console.log('TMP:', TMP);

const log = new Logger(TMP, {
  appendLine: (s: string) => console.log(s)
});

type Step =
  | 'execute'
  | 'send_help'
  | 'send_all_done'
  | 'send_help_response'
  | 'send_approve_stage'
  | 'finalize';

class FakeApi {
  private count = 0;
  constructor(
    private who: string,
    private script: Step[]
  ) {}

  async newChat(): Promise<void> { /* no-op */ }

  async chat(): Promise<AssistantResponse> {
    const step = this.script[this.count++];
    console.log(`[fake-${this.who}] step #${this.count}: ${step}`);
    if (!step) throw new Error('script exhausted for ' + this.who);

    const mk = (args: any): AssistantResponse => ({
      text: '',
      tool_calls: [{
        id: `call_${this.count}`,
        name: args.name,
        args: args.args
      } as any],
      raw: {}
    });

    if (step === 'execute') {
      return mk({ name: 'execute', args: { script: 'print("noop")' } });
    }
    if (step === 'send_help') {
      return mk({
        name: 'send_message',
        args: {
          to: 'critic',
          message:
            'HELP:\n' +
            'Problem: regex fails on IPv6 addresses.\n' +
            'Error: ValueError: no match at position 0\n' +
            'Tried: \\S+ for ip; \\S+ for url; \\[.+\\] for ts\n' +
            'Files: /tmp/help-test/loganalyzer/parser.py\n' +
            'Question: how to match IPv6 in the ip field?'
        }
      });
    }
    if (step === 'send_all_done') {
      return mk({
        name: 'send_message',
        args: { to: 'critic', message: 'ALL DONE: parser works on all cases.' }
      });
    }
    if (step === 'send_help_response') {
      return mk({
        name: 'send_message',
        args: {
          to: 'executor',
          message:
            'HELP_RESPONSE: use a bracketed class for ip: ' +
            String.raw`(?P<ip>\[[0-9a-fA-F:]+\]|[0-9.]+)`
        }
      });
    }
    if (step === 'send_approve_stage') {
      return mk({
        name: 'send_message',
        args: { to: 'executor', message: 'APPROVE_STAGE' }
      });
    }
    if (step === 'finalize') {
      return mk({
        name: 'finalize',
        args: { comment: 'Parser verified on all edge cases.' }
      });
    }
    throw new Error('unknown step: ' + step);
  }
}

class FakeExecutor {
  async run(call_id: string, script: string, command?: string): Promise<ExecResult> {
    console.log(`[fake-exec] script len=${script.length}`);
    return {
      call_id,
      command: command ?? 'noop',
      exit_code: 0,
      duration_ms: 1,
      stdout: 'noop\n',
      stderr: '',
      stdout_truncated: false,
      stderr_truncated: false
    };
  }
}

// --- Scenario ---
//
// E: execute              (stuck)
// E: send_help            -> C
// C: execute              (reads files)
// C: send_help_response   -> E
// E: execute              (applies fix)
// E: send_all_done        -> C
// C: execute              (verifies)
// C: finalize
//
// We simulate the natural flow. The exact number of execute calls on
// each side does not matter — what matters is that HELP and
// HELP_RESPONSE travel through the orchestrator's routing table.

const fakeApiE = new FakeApi('executor', [
  'execute',
  'send_help',
  'execute',
  'send_all_done'
]);

const fakeApiC = new FakeApi('critic', [
  'execute',              // reads files after HELP
  'send_help_response',   // replies HELP_RESPONSE
  'execute',              // verifies after ALL DONE
  'finalize'
]);

async function main() {
  const orch = new Orchestrator(
    fakeApiE as unknown as ApiClient,
    fakeApiC as unknown as ApiClient,
    new FakeExecutor() as unknown as Executor,
    new NullPanel(),
    log,
    {
      cwd: TMP,
      name: 'probe-help',
      task: 'Stub task for HELP protocol test.',
      deadlineAt: Date.now() + 60_000,
      executorPrompt: 'EXECUTOR_PROMPT',
      criticPrompt: 'CRITIC_PROMPT'
    }
  );

  await orch.run();
  log.close();

  const logPath = path.join(TMP, '.pingis', 'session.log');
  const text = await readLogWhenReady(logPath);
  const lines = text.split('\n').filter(Boolean).map(l => JSON.parse(l));

  const helpRoute = lines.find(
    e => e.event === 'route'
      && e.from === 'executor'
      && e.to === 'critic'
      && String(e.message ?? '').startsWith('HELP:')
  );
  // After step 51b, HELP_RESPONSE is wrapped with a
  // "Return to your original task" preamble before delivery, so the
  // route message no longer starts with the HELP_RESPONSE: marker.
  // Use `includes` — the marker is still inside the wrapped message.
  const helpResponseRoute = lines.find(
    e => e.event === 'route'
      && e.from === 'critic'
      && e.to === 'executor'
      && String(e.message ?? '').includes('HELP_RESPONSE:')
  );
  const stopEvent = lines.find(e => e.event === 'stop');
  const helpEvent = lines.find(
    e => e.event === 'help' && e.phase === 'HELP'
  );
  const helpResponseEvent = lines.find(
    e => e.event === 'help' && e.phase === 'HELP_RESPONSE'
  );

  console.log();
  console.log('--- CHECKS ---');
  console.log('HELP route found:', !!helpRoute);
  console.log('HELP_RESPONSE route found:', !!helpResponseRoute);
  console.log('help event (request):', !!helpEvent);
  console.log('help event (response):', !!helpResponseEvent);
  console.log('stop reason:', stopEvent?.reason);

  let failures = 0;
  if (!helpRoute)         { console.error('FAIL: no HELP route'); failures++; }
  if (!helpResponseRoute) { console.error('FAIL: no HELP_RESPONSE route'); failures++; }
  if (!helpEvent)         { console.error('FAIL: no help (request) event'); failures++; }
  if (!helpResponseEvent) { console.error('FAIL: no help (response) event'); failures++; }
  if (!stopEvent || stopEvent.reason !== 'done') {
    console.error(`FAIL: stop reason = ${stopEvent?.reason}, expected done`);
    failures++;
  }

  if (failures === 0) {
    console.log();
    console.log('=== SUCCESS: HELP protocol works ===');
    process.exit(0);
  } else {
    console.log();
    console.log(`=== FAILURE: ${failures} checks failed ===`);
    process.exit(1);
  }
}

async function readLogWhenReady(logPath: string, timeoutMs = 3000): Promise<string> {
  const deadline = Date.now() + timeoutMs;
  while (Date.now() < deadline) {
    if (fs.existsSync(logPath)) {
      const text = fs.readFileSync(logPath, 'utf-8');
      if (text.includes('"event":"stop"')) return text;
    }
    await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 50));
  }
  return fs.existsSync(logPath) ? fs.readFileSync(logPath, 'utf-8') : '';
}

main().catch(e => {
  console.error('CRASH:', e);
  process.exit(2);
});

===== FILE: scripts/probe-phase.ts =====
/**
 * Unit test for step 50 — AgentPhase transitions.
 *
 * Mocks ApiClient and Executor. No real API servers needed.
 *
 * Scenarios:
 *   T1. Normal step: idle → working → idle.
 *   T2. Format retry (one garbage response then a valid one):
 *       working → format_retry → working.
 *   T3. HELP loop: Executor sends HELP:, Critic replies HELP_RESPONSE:,
 *       Executor sends SOLVED:. Expect transitions:
 *         E: working → awaiting_help, then back to working / idle
 *         C: working → helping, then back to idle
 *
 * The probe reads `agent_phase` events from session.log and asserts
 * that the expected transitions are present. Exact ordering is not
 * asserted — the phase machine has many legitimate orderings, and
 * asserting them rigidly would make this probe brittle.
 *
 * Run:
 *   npx ts-node --project scripts/tsconfig.json scripts/probe-phase.ts
 */

import * as fs from 'fs';
import * as os from 'os';
import * as path from 'path';
import { ApiClient } from '../src/api';
import { Executor } from '../src/executor';
import { Logger } from '../src/log';
import { NullPanel, Orchestrator } from '../src/orchestrator';
import { AssistantResponse, ExecResult } from '../src/types';

let failures = 0;

function check(condition: boolean, label: string): void {
  if (condition) {
    console.log(`  ✓ ${label}`);
  } else {
    console.error(`  ✗ ${label}`);
    failures++;
  }
}

function freshTmp(name: string): string {
  const p = path.join(os.tmpdir(),
    `${name}-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8)}`);
  fs.mkdirSync(p, { recursive: true });
  return p;
}

type Step =
  | { kind: 'broken'; text: string }
  | { kind: 'tools'; calls: { name: string; args: any }[] };

class FakeApi {
  constructor(private who: string, private script: Step[]) {}
  private idx = 0;
  async newChat(): Promise<void> { /* no-op */ }
  async chat(): Promise<AssistantResponse> {
    if (this.idx >= this.script.length) {
      throw new Error(`FakeApi(${this.who}): script exhausted`);
    }
    const s = this.script[this.idx++];
    if (s.kind === 'broken') {
      return { text: s.text, tool_calls: [], raw: {} };
    }
    return {
      text: '',
      tool_calls: s.calls.map((c, i) => ({
        id: `call_${this.idx}_${i}`,
        name: c.name as any,
        args: c.args
      })) as any,
      raw: {}
    };
  }
}

class FakeExecutor {
  async run(call_id: string, script: string): Promise<ExecResult> {
    return {
      call_id, command: 'noop', exit_code: 0, duration_ms: 1,
      stdout: 'ok\n', stderr: '',
      stdout_truncated: false, stderr_truncated: false
    };
  }
}

function mkLog(cwd: string): Logger {
  return new Logger(cwd, { appendLine: () => { /* silent */ } });
}

async function runOrch(
  cwd: string,
  apiE: FakeApi,
  apiC: FakeApi
): Promise<void> {
  const log = mkLog(cwd);
  const orch = new Orchestrator(
    apiE as unknown as ApiClient,
    apiC as unknown as ApiClient,
    new FakeExecutor() as unknown as Executor,
    new NullPanel(),
    log,
    {
      cwd, name: 'probe-phase', task: 'stub',
      deadlineAt: Date.now() + 30_000,
      executorPrompt: 'E', criticPrompt: 'C'
    }
  );
  await orch.run();
  log.close();
  await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 200));
}

function readPhaseEvents(cwd: string): Array<{
  who: string; from: string; to: string; reason?: string;
}> {
  const logPath = path.join(cwd, '.pingis', 'session.log');
  if (!fs.existsSync(logPath)) return [];
  const lines = fs.readFileSync(logPath, 'utf-8')
    .split('\n').filter(Boolean);
  const out: Array<{ who: string; from: string; to: string;
                     reason?: string }> = [];
  for (const line of lines) {
    const e = JSON.parse(line);
    if (e.event === 'agent_phase') {
      out.push({ who: e.who, from: e.from, to: e.to, reason: e.reason });
    }
  }
  return out;
}

function hasTransition(
  events: Array<{ who: string; from: string; to: string; reason?: string }>,
  who: string,
  from: string,
  to: string
): boolean {
  return events.some(e => e.who === who && e.from === from && e.to === to);
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

async function t1_normal_step(): Promise<void> {
  console.log('\nT1: normal step — idle → working → idle');

  const cwd = freshTmp('probe-phase-t1');
  fs.mkdirSync(path.join(cwd, '.pingis'), { recursive: true });
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(cwd, '.pingis', 'plan.md'), '# Plan\n');

  const apiE = new FakeApi('executor', [
    { kind: 'tools', calls: [{ name: 'execute',
        args: { script: 'print(1)' } }] },
    { kind: 'tools', calls: [{ name: 'send_message',
        args: { to: 'critic', message: 'ALL DONE: ok' } }] }
  ]);
  const apiC = new FakeApi('critic', [
    { kind: 'tools', calls: [{ name: 'finalize',
        args: { comment: 'done' } }] }
  ]);

  await runOrch(cwd, apiE, apiC);
  const events = readPhaseEvents(cwd);

  check(hasTransition(events, 'executor', 'idle', 'working'),
    'executor: idle → working');
  check(hasTransition(events, 'executor', 'working', 'idle'),
    'executor: working → idle');
  check(hasTransition(events, 'critic', 'idle', 'working'),
    'critic: idle → working');
}

async function t2_format_retry(): Promise<void> {
  console.log('\nT2: format retry — working → format_retry → working');

  const cwd = freshTmp('probe-phase-t2');
  fs.mkdirSync(path.join(cwd, '.pingis'), { recursive: true });
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(cwd, '.pingis', 'plan.md'), '# Plan\n');

  const apiE = new FakeApi('executor', [
    { kind: 'broken', text: 'not json' },
    { kind: 'tools', calls: [{ name: 'execute',
        args: { script: 'print(1)' } }] },
    { kind: 'tools', calls: [{ name: 'send_message',
        args: { to: 'critic', message: 'ALL DONE: ok' } }] }
  ]);
  const apiC = new FakeApi('critic', [
    { kind: 'tools', calls: [{ name: 'finalize',
        args: { comment: 'done' } }] }
  ]);

  await runOrch(cwd, apiE, apiC);
  const events = readPhaseEvents(cwd);

  check(hasTransition(events, 'executor', 'working', 'format_retry'),
    'executor: working → format_retry');
  check(hasTransition(events, 'executor', 'format_retry', 'working'),
    'executor: format_retry → working');
}

async function t3_help_loop(): Promise<void> {
  console.log('\nT3: HELP loop — awaiting_help / helping');

  const cwd = freshTmp('probe-phase-t3');
  fs.mkdirSync(path.join(cwd, '.pingis'), { recursive: true });
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(cwd, '.pingis', 'plan.md'), '# Plan\n');

  const apiE = new FakeApi('executor', [
    { kind: 'tools', calls: [{ name: 'send_message',
        args: { to: 'critic', message: 'HELP:\nProblem: x\nTried: y' } }] },
    { kind: 'tools', calls: [{ name: 'send_message',
        args: { to: 'critic', message: 'SOLVED: it worked' } }] },
    { kind: 'tools', calls: [{ name: 'send_message',
        args: { to: 'critic', message: 'ALL DONE: ok' } }] }
  ]);
  const apiC = new FakeApi('critic', [
    { kind: 'tools', calls: [{ name: 'send_message',
        args: { to: 'executor', message: 'HELP_RESPONSE: try X' } }] },
    { kind: 'tools', calls: [{ name: 'finalize',
        args: { comment: 'done' } }] }
  ]);

  await runOrch(cwd, apiE, apiC);
  const events = readPhaseEvents(cwd);

  check(hasTransition(events, 'executor', 'working', 'awaiting_help'),
    'executor: working → awaiting_help');
  check(hasTransition(events, 'critic', 'idle', 'helping'),
    'critic: idle → helping (HELP arrived while idle)');
  check(hasTransition(events, 'critic', 'helping', 'working'),
    'critic: helping → working (step started)');
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

async function main(): Promise<void> {
  await t1_normal_step();
  await t2_format_retry();
  await t3_help_loop();

  console.log();
  if (failures === 0) {
    console.log('=== SUCCESS: agent phases work ===');
    process.exit(0);
  } else {
    console.log(`=== FAILURE: ${failures} check(s) failed ===`);
    process.exit(1);
  }
}

main().catch(e => {
  console.error('CRASH:', e);
  process.exit(2);
});

===== FILE: scripts/probe-retry-restart.ts =====
/**
 * Unit test for step 63 — restart decision.
 *
 * T1. shouldRestartAgentsOnRetry returns the expected values.
 * T2. runWithRetry passes the reason to onRetry as the third arg.
 *
 * Run:
 *   npx ts-node --project scripts/tsconfig.json scripts/probe-retry-restart.ts
 */

import { runWithRetry, shouldRestartAgentsOnRetry } from '../src/retry';
import { OrchestratorResult, StopReason } from '../src/types';

let failures = 0;

function check(condition: boolean, label: string): void {
  if (condition) {
    console.log(`  ✓ ${label}`);
  } else {
    console.error(`  ✗ ${label}`);
    failures++;
  }
}

function t1_decision_table(): void {
  console.log('\nT1: shouldRestartAgentsOnRetry decision table');

  check(shouldRestartAgentsOnRetry('network_error') === false,
    'network_error → no restart');
  check(shouldRestartAgentsOnRetry('server_error') === true,
    'server_error → restart');
  check(shouldRestartAgentsOnRetry('bad_gateway') === true,
    'bad_gateway → restart');
  check(shouldRestartAgentsOnRetry('timeout') === false,
    'timeout → no restart (and not retryable anyway)');
  check(shouldRestartAgentsOnRetry('crash') === false,
    'crash → no restart');
}

async function t2_onRetry_receives_reason(): Promise<void> {
  console.log('\nT2: onRetry receives the reason as third argument');

  const reasons: StopReason[] = [];
  const script: StopReason[] = ['network_error', 'server_error', 'done'];

  const result = await runWithRetry({
    taskStartedAt: Date.now(),
    totalTimeoutMs: 60_000,
    maxRetries: 3,
    backoffMs: [1, 1, 1],
    minRemainingMs: 100,
    isRetryable: (r) =>
      r === 'network_error' || r === 'server_error' || r === 'bad_gateway',
    runOnce: async (): Promise<OrchestratorResult> => {
      const r = script.shift() ?? 'done';
      return { reason: r };
    },
    onRetry: async (_attempt, _max, reason) => {
      reasons.push(reason);
    },
    log: () => { /* silent */ }
  });

  check(result.reason === 'done',
    `result = ${result.reason} (expected done)`);
  check(reasons.length === 2,
    `onRetry called twice (got ${reasons.length})`);
  check(reasons[0] === 'network_error',
    `reasons[0] = ${reasons[0]} (expected network_error)`);
  check(reasons[1] === 'server_error',
    `reasons[1] = ${reasons[1]} (expected server_error)`);
}

async function t3_abort_before_first_attempt(): Promise<void> {
  console.log('\nT3: abort before first attempt → runOnce never called');

  const controller = new AbortController();
  controller.abort();

  let calls = 0;
  const result = await runWithRetry({
    taskStartedAt: Date.now(),
    totalTimeoutMs: 60_000,
    maxRetries: 3,
    backoffMs: [1, 1, 1],
    minRemainingMs: 100,
    signal: controller.signal,
    isRetryable: (r) => r === 'network_error',
    runOnce: async () => {
      calls++;
      return { reason: 'done' };
    },
    onRetry: async () => { /* no-op */ },
    log: () => { /* silent */ }
  });

  check(calls === 0, `runOnce never called (got ${calls})`);
  check(result.reason === 'crash',
    `result.reason = ${result.reason} (default crash)`);
}

async function t4_abort_during_backoff(): Promise<void> {
  console.log('\nT4: abort during backoff → loop exits promptly');

  const controller = new AbortController();
  let calls = 0;

  // Long backoff (10s) but we abort after 20ms. If abort works,
  // the loop finishes well before the backoff would have.
  const started = Date.now();
  const resultPromise = runWithRetry({
    taskStartedAt: Date.now(),
    totalTimeoutMs: 60_000,
    maxRetries: 3,
    backoffMs: [10_000, 10_000, 10_000],
    minRemainingMs: 100,
    signal: controller.signal,
    isRetryable: (r) => r === 'network_error',
    runOnce: async () => {
      calls++;
      return { reason: 'network_error' };
    },
    onRetry: async () => { /* no-op */ },
    log: () => { /* silent */ }
  });

  setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), 20);
  const result = await resultPromise;
  const elapsed = Date.now() - started;

  check(calls === 1, `runOnce called once (got ${calls})`);
  check(elapsed < 1000,
    `finished in ${elapsed}ms (well under the 10s backoff)`);
  check(result.reason === 'network_error',
    `result.reason = ${result.reason} (last attempt)`);
}

async function main(): Promise<void> {
  t1_decision_table();
  await t2_onRetry_receives_reason();
  await t3_abort_before_first_attempt();
  await t4_abort_during_backoff();

  console.log();
  if (failures === 0) {
    console.log('=== SUCCESS: retry restart decision works ===');
    process.exit(0);
  } else {
    console.log(`=== FAILURE: ${failures} check(s) failed ===`);
    process.exit(1);
  }
}

main().catch(e => {
  console.error('CRASH:', e);
  process.exit(2);
});

===== FILE: scripts/probe-retry.ts =====
/**
 * Unit test for step 34 — runWithRetry().
 *
 * Run:
 *   npx ts-node --project scripts/tsconfig.json scripts/probe-retry.ts
 */

import { runWithRetry } from '../src/retry';
import { OrchestratorResult, StopReason } from '../src/types';

let failures = 0;

function check(condition: boolean, label: string): void {
  if (condition) {
    console.log(`  ✓ ${label}`);
  } else {
    console.error(`  ✗ ${label}`);
    failures++;
  }
}

function freshRunWithRetry(
  script: StopReason[],
  opts: {
    maxRetries?: number;
    backoffMs?: number[];
    totalTimeoutMs?: number;
    taskStartedAtOffset?: number;
  } = {}
): Promise<{ result: OrchestratorResult; attempts: number; retries: number; logs: any[] }> {
  let attempts = 0;
  let retries = 0;
  const logs: any[] = [];
  const scriptCopy = [...script];

  return runWithRetry({
    taskStartedAt: Date.now() - (opts.taskStartedAtOffset ?? 0),
    totalTimeoutMs: opts.totalTimeoutMs ?? 60_000,
    maxRetries: opts.maxRetries ?? 3,
    backoffMs: opts.backoffMs ?? [1, 1, 1],
    minRemainingMs: 100,
    isRetryable: (r) =>
      r === 'network_error' || r === 'bad_gateway' || r === 'server_error',
    runOnce: async () => {
      attempts++;
      const r = scriptCopy.shift() ?? 'done';
      return { reason: r };
    },
    onRetry: async () => {
      retries++;
    },
    log: (event, payload) => logs.push({ event, ...payload })
  }).then(result => ({ result, attempts, retries, logs }));
}

async function t1_retry_then_success(): Promise<void> {
  console.log('\nT1: network_error, then done');
  const { result, attempts, retries } = await freshRunWithRetry([
    'network_error', 'done'
  ]);
  check(result.reason === 'done', `result = ${result.reason} (expected done)`);
  check(attempts === 2, `attempts = ${attempts} (expected 2)`);
  check(retries === 1, `retries = ${retries} (expected 1)`);
}

async function t2_retries_exhausted(): Promise<void> {
  console.log('\nT2: four network_errors, budget exhausted');
  const { result, attempts, retries } = await freshRunWithRetry(
    ['network_error', 'network_error', 'network_error', 'network_error']
  );
  check(result.reason === 'network_error',
    `result = ${result.reason} (expected network_error)`);
  check(attempts === 4, `attempts = ${attempts} (expected 4)`);
  check(retries === 3, `retries = ${retries} (expected 3)`);
}

async function t3_non_retryable(): Promise<void> {
  console.log('\nT3: server_busy — not retryable');
  const { result, attempts, retries } = await freshRunWithRetry([
    'server_busy', 'done'
  ]);
  check(result.reason === 'server_busy',
    `result = ${result.reason} (expected server_busy)`);
  check(attempts === 1, `attempts = ${attempts} (expected 1)`);
  check(retries === 0, `retries = ${retries} (expected 0)`);
}

async function t4_done_immediate(): Promise<void> {
  console.log('\nT4: done on first attempt');
  const { result, attempts, retries } = await freshRunWithRetry(['done']);
  check(result.reason === 'done', `result = ${result.reason}`);
  check(attempts === 1, `attempts = ${attempts}`);
  check(retries === 0, `retries = ${retries}`);
}

async function t5_time_budget_exhausted(): Promise<void> {
  console.log('\nT5: no attempts — budget already gone');
  const { result, attempts, retries, logs } = await freshRunWithRetry(
    ['done'],
    { totalTimeoutMs: 60_000, taskStartedAtOffset: 100_000 }
  );
  check(result.reason === 'crash',
    `result = ${result.reason} (expected crash — the default)`);
  check(attempts === 0, `attempts = ${attempts} (expected 0)`);
  check(retries === 0, `retries = ${retries}`);
  const abort = logs.find(l => l.event === 'retry_abort');
  check(!!abort, 'retry_abort logged');
  check(abort?.reason === 'time_budget_exhausted',
    `abort reason = ${abort?.reason}`);
}

async function main(): Promise<void> {
  await t1_retry_then_success();
  await t2_retries_exhausted();
  await t3_non_retryable();
  await t4_done_immediate();
  await t5_time_budget_exhausted();

  console.log();
  if (failures === 0) {
    console.log('=== SUCCESS: retry loop works ===');
    process.exit(0);
  } else {
    console.log(`=== FAILURE: ${failures} check(s) failed ===`);
    process.exit(1);
  }
}

main().catch(e => {
  console.error('CRASH:', e);
  process.exit(2);
});

===== FILE: scripts/probe-return-to-original.ts =====
/**
 * Unit test for step 51b — HELP_RESPONSE wrap.
 *
 * Mocks ApiClient and Executor. No real API servers needed.
 *
 * Scenario:
 *   - Executor sends HELP: to Critic.
 *   - Critic replies HELP_RESPONSE:.
 *   - The message the orchestrator routes from Critic back to Executor
 *     must contain:
 *       * the "Return to your original task" preamble,
 *       * the Executor's original framing (the request it was working
 *         from when it sent HELP:),
 *       * the raw HELP_RESPONSE text from Critic.
 *
 * Run:
 *   npx ts-node --project scripts/tsconfig.json scripts/probe-return-to-original.ts
 */

import * as fs from 'fs';
import * as os from 'os';
import * as path from 'path';
import { ApiClient } from '../src/api';
import { Executor } from '../src/executor';
import { Logger } from '../src/log';
import { NullPanel, Orchestrator } from '../src/orchestrator';
import { AssistantResponse, ExecResult } from '../src/types';

let failures = 0;

function check(condition: boolean, label: string): void {
  if (condition) {
    console.log(`  ✓ ${label}`);
  } else {
    console.error(`  ✗ ${label}`);
    failures++;
  }
}

function freshTmp(name: string): string {
  const p = path.join(os.tmpdir(),
    `${name}-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8)}`);
  fs.mkdirSync(p, { recursive: true });
  return p;
}

type Step =
  | { kind: 'broken'; text: string }
  | { kind: 'tools'; calls: { name: string; args: any }[] };

class FakeApi {
  constructor(private who: string, private script: Step[]) {}
  private idx = 0;
  async newChat(): Promise<void> { /* no-op */ }
  async chat(): Promise<AssistantResponse> {
    if (this.idx >= this.script.length) {
      throw new Error(`FakeApi(${this.who}): script exhausted`);
    }
    const s = this.script[this.idx++];
    if (s.kind === 'broken') {
      return { text: s.text, tool_calls: [], raw: {} };
    }
    return {
      text: '',
      tool_calls: s.calls.map((c, i) => ({
        id: `call_${this.idx}_${i}`,
        name: c.name as any,
        args: c.args
      })) as any,
      raw: {}
    };
  }
}

class FakeExecutor {
  async run(call_id: string, script: string): Promise<ExecResult> {
    return {
      call_id, command: 'noop', exit_code: 0, duration_ms: 1,
      stdout: 'ok\n', stderr: '',
      stdout_truncated: false, stderr_truncated: false
    };
  }
}

function mkLog(cwd: string): Logger {
  return new Logger(cwd, { appendLine: () => { /* silent */ } });
}

async function runOrch(
  cwd: string,
  apiE: FakeApi,
  apiC: FakeApi
): Promise<void> {
  const log = mkLog(cwd);
  const orch = new Orchestrator(
    apiE as unknown as ApiClient,
    apiC as unknown as ApiClient,
    new FakeExecutor() as unknown as Executor,
    new NullPanel(),
    log,
    {
      cwd, name: 'probe-return-to-original', task: 'stub',
      deadlineAt: Date.now() + 30_000,
      executorPrompt: 'E', criticPrompt: 'C'
    }
  );
  await orch.run();
  log.close();
  await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 200));
}

function readLog(cwd: string): any[] {
  const logPath = path.join(cwd, '.pingis', 'session.log');
  if (!fs.existsSync(logPath)) return [];
  return fs.readFileSync(logPath, 'utf-8')
    .split('\n').filter(Boolean).map(l => JSON.parse(l));
}

async function t1_wrap_help_response(): Promise<void> {
  console.log('\nT1: HELP_RESPONSE wrapped with return-to-original');

  const cwd = freshTmp('probe-return-t1');
  fs.mkdirSync(path.join(cwd, '.pingis'), { recursive: true });
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(cwd, '.pingis', 'plan.md'), '# Plan\n');

  // Executor: execute, then HELP, then ALL DONE.
  // Critic: execute (reads files), HELP_RESPONSE, execute (verifies), finalize.
  const apiE = new FakeApi('executor', [
    { kind: 'tools', calls: [{ name: 'execute',
        args: { script: 'print(1)' } }] },
    { kind: 'tools', calls: [{ name: 'send_message',
        args: { to: 'critic', message: 'HELP:\nProblem: x\nTried: y' } }] },
    { kind: 'tools', calls: [{ name: 'send_message',
        args: { to: 'critic', message: 'ALL DONE: ok' } }] }
  ]);
  const apiC = new FakeApi('critic', [
    { kind: 'tools', calls: [{ name: 'execute',
        args: { script: 'print(1)' } }] },
    { kind: 'tools', calls: [{ name: 'send_message',
        args: { to: 'executor',
                message: 'HELP_RESPONSE: try X instead of Y' } }] },
    { kind: 'tools', calls: [{ name: 'finalize',
        args: { comment: 'done' } }] }
  ]);

  await runOrch(cwd, apiE, apiC);
  const lines = readLog(cwd);

  const routeCriticToExecutor = lines.find(
    e => e.event === 'route'
      && e.from === 'critic'
      && e.to === 'executor'
      && typeof e.message === 'string'
  );

  check(!!routeCriticToExecutor,
    'route critic → executor exists');
  const msg: string = routeCriticToExecutor?.message ?? '';

  check(msg.includes('Return to your original task'),
    'wrapped message contains the preamble');
  check(msg.includes('HELP_RESPONSE: try X instead of Y'),
    'wrapped message still contains the raw HELP_RESPONSE text');
  check(msg.includes('Original request:'),
    'wrapped message labels the original request section');
  check(msg.includes('Suggestion from critic:'),
    'wrapped message labels the suggestion section');
}

  await t1_wrap_help_response();

  console.log();
  if (failures === 0) {

    process.exit(0);
  } else {
    console.log(`=== FAILURE: ${failures} check(s) failed ===`);
    process.exit(1);
  }
}
